Bava Kamma 38a:5-12: Tanya name hachi: shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy – patur. shor shel goy shennagach shor shel yisrael – ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem, shenneemar: "amad vaymoded eretz, raa vayyatter goyim". veomer: "hofia mehar paran".

Vechi tema, hay "amad vaymoded eretz" – mibbaya leh lechidrav matna vechidrav yosef, ta shema: "hofia mehar paran" – mipparan hofia mamonan leyisrael. may derav matna? deamar rav matna: "amad vaymoded eretz, raa vechulei". ma raa – raa sheva mitzvot shennitztauu alehen bene noach velo kiyyeymum, amad vehigla otam meal admatam.
Umay mashma dehay "vayyatter" lishshana deiggalloye hu? ketiv hacha: "vayyatter goyim", uchetiv hatam: "lenatter bahen al haaretz" – umetargeminan: lekappatza behon al ara.
May derav yosef? deamar rav yosef: "amad vaymoded eretz, raa vechulei"; ma raa? raa sheva mitzvot shekkibbelu alehem bene noach velo kiyyeymum, amad vehittiran lahem.
Ittegore ittegur?! im ken, matzinu chote niskar! amar mar bereh deravna: lomar sheafillu mekayyeymin otan – en mekabbelin alehen sachar.

Vela?! vehatanya, rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu goy veosek battora – shehu kechohen gadol? talmud lomar: "asher yaase otam haadam, vachay bahem" – "kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim" lo neemar, ella "adam"; ha lamadta, sheafillu goy veosek battora – hare hu kechohen gadol!
Amri: en mekabbelim alehen sachar kimtzuvvev veose, ella kemi sheeno metzuvvev veose. deamar rabbi chanina: gadol hametzuvvev veose yoter mimmi sheeno metzuvvev veose.
Berakhot 28b:4-7: Gemara tanu rabbanan: bichnisato mahu omer? "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shello yeera devar takkala al yadi, velo ekkashel bidvar halacha, veyismechu bi chaveray, velo omar al tame tahor, velo al tahor tame. velo yikkashlu chaveray bidvar halacha, veesmach bahem".

Bitziato mahu omer? "mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shessamta chelki miyyoshve bet hammidrash velo samta chelki miyyoshve keranot. sheani mashkim, vehem mashkimim. ani mashkim ledivre tora, vehem mashkimim lidvarim betelim. ani amel vehem amelim. ani amel umekabbel sachar, vehem amelim veenam mekabbelim sachar. ani ratz vehem ratzim. ani ratz lechayye haolam habba vehem ratzim liver shachat".
Tanu rabbanan: keshechala rabbi eliezer nichnesu talmidav levakkero. amru lo: rabbenu lammedenu orchot chayyim venizke bahen lechayye haolam habba.

Amar lahem: hizzaharu bichvod chavrechem, uminu benechem min hahiggayon, vehoshivum ben birke talmide chachamim, uchesheattem mitpallelim — deu lifne mi attem omdim. uvishvil kach tizku lechayye haolam habba.
II Kings 4:1-6: Veishsha achat minneshe vene-hanneviim tzaaka el-elisha lemor avdecha ishi met veatta yadata ki avdecha haya yare et-Adonai vehannoshe ba lakachat et-shene yeladay lo laavadim
Vayyomer eleha elisha ma eese-lach haggidi li ma-yesh[lach] (lechi) babbayit vattomer en leshifchatcha chol babbayit ki im-asuch shamen
Vayyomer lechi shaali-lach kelim min-hachutz meet kol[shechenayich] (shakenakey) kelim rekim al-tamiti
Uvat vesagart haddelet baadech uvead-banayich veyatzakt al kol-hakkelim haelle vehammale tassii
Vattelech meitto vattisgor haddelet baadah uvead baneha hem maggishim eleha vehi (maytzaket) [motzaket]
Vayhi ׀ kimlot hakkelim vattomer el-benah haggisha elay od keli vayyomer eleha en od keli vayyaamod hashshamen
II Kings 4:11-15: Vayhi hayyom vayyavo shamma vayyasar el-haaliyya vayyishkav-shamma
Vayyomer el-gechazi naaro kera lashshunammit hazzot vayyikra-lah vattaamod lefanav

Vattaal vattashkivehu al-mittat ish haelohim vattisgor baado vattetze

Mishnah Bekhorot 1:6-2:2: Hammafrish pidyon peter chamor umet, rabbi eliezer omer, chayyavin beacharayuto, kachamesh selaim shel ben. vachachamim omrim, en chayyavin beacharayuto, kefidyon maaser sheni. heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok al pidyon peter chamor shemmet, sheen kan lakkohen kelum. met peter chamor, rabbi eliezer omer, yikkaver, umuttar bahanaato shel tale. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich lehikkaver, vehattale lakkohen:

Lo ratza lifdoto, orfo vekofitz meacharav vekovro. mitzvat pediyya kodemet lemitzvat arifa, shenneemar (Shemot 13), veim lo tifde vaarafto. mitzvat yeida kodemet lemitzvat pediyya, shenneemar (sham 21), asher lo yeadah vehefdah. mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza, barishona, shehayu mitkavvenin leshem mitzva. veachshav sheen mitkavvenin leshem mitzva, amru mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum. mitzvat geulla baadon hu kodem lechol adam, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), veim lo yiggael venimkar beerkech:

Hallokeach ubbar parato shel nachri, vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay, hammishtattef lo, vehamekabbel mimmennu, vehannoten lo vekabbala, patur min habbechora, shenneemar (Bamidbar 3), beyisrael, aval lo vaacherim. kohanim uleviyyim chayyavin. lo nifteru mibbechor behema tehora, (velo nifteru) ella mippidyon habben umippeter chamor:

Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan, venifdu, chayyavim babbechora uvammattanot, veyotzin lechullin liggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz patur, veen osim temura, veim metu yippadu, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser:
Mishnah Bekhorot 2:3-6: Kol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman, o mum over lehekdeshan, uleachar mikkan nolad lahem mum kavua (venifdu), peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot, veenan yotzin lechullin liggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav, veosin temura, veim metu yikkaveru:

Hamekabbel tzon barzel min hannachri, veladot peturin, uvalde veladot chayyavin. heemid veladot tachat immotehem, valde veladot feturin, uvalde valde veladot chayyavin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, afillu ad asara dorot, peturin, sheacharayutan lannachri:
Rachel sheyyalda kemin ez, veez sheyyalda kemin rachel, patur min habbechora. veim yesh bo miktzat simanin, chayyav:

Rachel shello vikkera veyalda shene zecharim veyatzu shene rashehen keechad, rabbi yose haggelili omer, shenehen lakkohen. shenneemar (Shemot 13), hazzecharim laAdonai. vachachamim omrim, i efshar, ella echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer, hakkohen borer lo et hayafe. rabbi akiva omer, meshammenim benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev. vechayyav bammattanot. rabbi yose poter. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer, yachaloku. rabbi akiva omer, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:
Mishnah Bekhorot 2:7-3:2: Shete rechelot shello vikkeru, veyaldu shene zecharim, noten shenehem lakkohen. zachar unekeva, hazzachar lakkohen. shene zecharim unekeva, echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer, hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe. rabbi akiva omer, meshammenim benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev. vechayyav bammattanot. rabbi yose poter. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer, yachaloku. rabbi akiva omer, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. shete nekevot vezachar, o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum:

Achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera veyaldu shene zecharim, echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer, hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe. rabbi akiva omer, meshammenin benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev. vechayyav bammattanot. rabbi yose poter, shehaya rabbi yose omer, kol shechalifav beyad kohen, patur min hamattanot. rabbi meir mechayyev. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer, yachaloku. rabbi akiva omer, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:

Yotze dofen vehabba acharav, rabbi tarfon omer, shenehem yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu vemuman labbealim. rabbi akiva omer, shenehen enan bechor, harishon mishshum sheeno feter rechem, vehashsheni mishshum shekkiddemo acher:

Hallokeach behema min hannachri veen yadua im bikkera veim lo vikkera, rabbi yishmael omer, ez bat shenatah vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach safek. rachel bat shetayim vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach safek. para vachamor benot shalosh vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach safek. amar lo rabbi akiva, illu bavvalad bilvad behema nifteret, haya chidvarecha, ella amru, siman havvalad bivhema dakka, tinuf. uvegassa, shilya. uveishsha, shefir veshilya. ze hakkelal, kol sheyadua shebbikkera, en kan lakkohen kelum. vechol shello vikkera, hare ze lakkohen. im safek, yeachel bemumo labbealim. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam, hare zo tikkaver, veniftera min habbechora:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hallokeach behema menika min hannachri, eno choshesh shemma venah shel acheret haya. nichnas letoch edro veraa et hammavkirot menikot veet sheenan mavkirot menikot, eno choshesh shemma venah shel zo ba lo etzel zo, o shemma venah shel zo ba lo etzel zo:
Mishnah Bekhorot 3:3-4:2: Rabbi yose ben meshullam omer, hashshochet et habbechor, ose makom bekofitz mikkan umikkan vetolesh hassear, uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo. vechen hattolesh et hassear lirot mekom hammum:

Sear bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho vachallon veachar kach shechato, akavya ben mahalalel mattir, vachachamim osrin, divre rabbi yehuda. amar rabbi yose, lo vaze hittir akavya, ella visar bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon veachar kach met, baze akavya ben mahalalel mattir, vachachamim osrin. hatztzemer hameduvlal babbechor, et shehu nire min haggizza, muttar. veet sheeno nire min haggizza, asur:

Ad kamma yisrael chayyavim lehittappel babbechor. bivhema dakka, ad sheloshim yom. uvaggassa, chamishshim yom. rabbi yose omer, baddakka shelosha chodashim. amar lo hakkohen betoch zeman ze tenehu li, hare ze lo yitteno lo. im haya vaal mum, amar lo ten li sheochlennu, muttar. uvishat hammikdash, im haya tamim, amar lo ten li sheakrivennu, muttar. habbechor neechol shana veshana ben tamim ben baal mum, shenneemar (Devarim 15), lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana:
Nolad lo mum betoch shenato, muttar lekayyemo kol shenem asar chodesh. leachar shenato, eno rashshay lekayyemo ella ad sheloshim yom:
Mishnah Bekhorot 4:3-6: Hashshochet habbechor umare et mumo, rabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi meir omer, hoil vehu nishchat shello al pi mumche, asur:

Mi sheeno mumche veraa et habbechor venishchat al piv, hare ze yikkaver, vishallem mibbeto. dan et haddin, zikka et hachayyav vechiyyev et hazzakkay, timme et hatahor vetiher et hattame, ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto. veim haya mumche levet din, patur milleshallem. maase vefara shennittela haem shellah, veheechilah rabbi tarfon lakkelavim, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruha. amar todos harofe, en para vachazira yotza mealekkesanderiyya ad shehem chotchin et haem shellah, bishvil shello teled. amar rabbi tarfon, halcha chamorcha tarfon. amar lo rabbi akiva, rabbi tarfon, patur atta, sheatta mumche levet din, vechol hammumche levet din patur milleshallem:

Hannotel secharo lihyot roe vechorot, en shochatin al piv, ella im ken haya mumche keila veyavne, shehittiru lo chachamim lihyot notel arbaa issarot bivhema dakka, veshishsha baggassa, ben tamim ben baal mum:

Hannotel secharo ladun, dinav betelim. lehaid, edutav betelin. lehazzot ulekaddesh, memav me meara veefro efer mikle. im haya chohen vetimmeahu mitterumato, maachilo umashko vesacho. veim haya zaken, markivo al hachamor. venoten lo secharo kappoel:
Mishnah Bekhorot 4:7-5:1: Hechashud al habbechorot, en lokchin mimmennu besar tzevaim velo orot sheenan avudin. rabbi eliezer omer, lokchim mimmennu orot shel nekeva, veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer mellubban vetzoi, aval lokchin mimmennu tavuy uvegadim:
Hechashud al hasheviit en lokchin mimmennu fishtan vaafillu serek, aval lokchin mimmennu tavuy vearig:
Hechashud lihyot mocher teruma leshem chullin, en lokchin mimmennu afillu mayim o melach, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheyyesh bo zikkat terumot umaasrot, en lokchin mimmennu:

Hechashud al hashsheviit, eno chashud al hammaasrot. hechashud al hammaasrot, eno chashud al hashsheviit. hechashud al ze veal ze, chashud al hattohorot. veyesh shehu chashud al hattohorot, veeno chashud lo al ze velo al ze. ze hakkelal, kol hechashud al haddavar, lo dano velo meido:

Kol pesule hammukdashin (hanaatan lahekdesh), nimkarin baitliz (venishchatin baitliz) venishkalin belitra, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser, shehanayatan labbealim. pesule hammukdashin hanayatan lahekdesh. veshoklin mane cheneged mane babbechor:
Mishnah Ketubot 2:1-5:
Haishsha shennitarmela o shennitgarsha, hi omeret betula nesatani, vehu omer, lo chi ella almana nesatich, im yesh edim sheyyatzat behinnuma veroshah parua, ketubbatah matayim. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, af chilluk kelayot reaya: 
Umode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero sade zo shel avicha hayta ulekachtiha hemennu, shehu neeman, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shehi shel aviv vehu omer lekachtiha hemennu, eno neeman: 
Haedim sheamru ketav yadenu hu ze, aval anusim hayinu, ketannim hayinu, pesule edut hayinu, hare ellu neemanim. veim yesh edim shehu chetav yadam o shehaya chetav yadam yotze mimmakom acher, enan neemanin: 
Ze omer ze chetav yadi veze chetav yado shel chaveri, veze omer ze chetav yadi veze chetav yado shel chaveri, hare ellu neemanin. ze omer ze chetav yadi veze omer ze chetav yadi, tzerichim letzaref immahem acher, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, enan tzerichin letzaref immahem acher, ella neeman adam lomar ze chetav yadi: 
Haishsha sheamra eshet ish hayiti ugerusha ani, neemenet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shehayta eshet ish vehi omeret gerusha ani, enah neemenet. amra nishbeti utehora ani, neemenet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shennishbet vehi omeret tehora ani, enah neemenet. veim mishshennisset bau edim, hare zo lo tetze:
Mishnah Ketubot 2:10-3:3:
Veelu neemanin lehaid begadlan ma sherau vekatnan. neeman adam lomar, ze chetav yado shel abba, veze chetav yado shel rabbi, veze chetav yado shel achi. zachur hayiti viflonit sheyyatzta vehinnuma, veroshah parua. veshehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol leechol batteruma. veshehaya cholek immanu al haggoren. vehammakom hazze bet happeras. vead kan hayinu vain beshabbat. aval en adam neeman lomar, derech haya lifloni vammakom hazze, maamad umisped haya lifloni vammakom hazze: 
Ellu nearot sheyyesh lahen kenas. habba al hammamzeret, veal hannetina, veal hakkutit. habba al haggiyyoret, veal hashshevuya, veal hashshifcha, shennifdu veshennitgayyeru veshennishtachreru pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad. habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda, yesh lahen kenas. af al pi shehen behikkaret, en bahen mitat bet din: 
Veellu sheen lahen kenas, habba al haggiyyoret veal hashshevuya veal hashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeru veshennishtachreru yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veyom echad. rabbi yehuda omer, shevuya shennifdet, hare hi vikdushshatah, af al pi sheggedola. habba al bitto, al bat bitto, al bat beno, al bat ishto, al bat benah, al bat bittah, en lahen kenas, mippene shemmitchayyev benafsho, shemmitato vide vet din. vechol hammitchayyev benafsho, en meshallem mamon, shenneemar (Shemot 21) velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh: 
Naara shennitarsa venitgarsha, rabbi yose haggelili omer, en lah kenas. rabbi akiva omer, yesh lah kenas, ukenasah leatzmah:
Mishnah Ketubot 2:6-9:
Shete nashim shennishbu, zot omeret nishbeti utehora ani, vezot omeret nishbeti utehora ani, enan neemanot. uvizman shehen meidot zo et zo, hare ellu neemanot: 
Vechen shene anashim, ze omer kohen ani veze omer kohen ani, enan neemanin. uvizman shehen meidin ze et ze, hare ellu neemanin: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, en maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad. amar rabbi elazar, ematay, bimkom sheyyesh orrin. aval bimkom sheen orrin, maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan, maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad: 
Haishsha shennechbesha vide goyim al yede mamon, mutteret levalah. al yede nefashot, asura levalah. ir shekkevashah karkom, kol kohanot shennimtzeu vetochah, pesulot. veim yesh lahen edim, afillu eved, afillu shifcha, hare ellu neemanin. veen neeman adam al yede atzmo. amar rabbi zecharya ven hakkatztzav, hammaon hazze, lo zaza yadah mittoch yadi mishshaa shennichnesu goyim lirushalayim vead sheyyatzau. amru lo, en adam meid al yede atzmo:
Mishnah Ketubot 3:4-8:
Hamefatte noten shelosha devarim, vehaones arbaa. hamefatte noten boshet ufegam ukenas. mosif alav ones, shennoten et hatztzaar. ma ben ones limfatte. haones noten et hatztzaar, vehamefatte eno noten et hatztzaar. haones noten miyyad, vehamefatte lichsheyyotzi. haones shote vaatzitzo, vehamefatte im ratza lehotzi, motzi: 
Ketzad shote vaatzitzo, afillu hi chiggeret, afillu hi suma, vaafillu hayta mukkat shechin. nimtza vah devar erva, o sheenah reuya lavo veyisrael, eno rashshay lekayyemah, shenneemar, (Devarim 22) velo tihye leishsha, ishsha haruya lo: 
Yetoma shennitarsa venitgarsha, rabbi elazar omer, hamefatte fatur, vehaones chayyav: 
Ezohi voshet, hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. pegam, roin otah keillu hi shifcha nimkeret, kamma hayta yafa vechamma hi yafa. kenas, shave vechol adam. vechol sheyyesh lo kitzba min hattora, shave vechol adam: 
Kol makom sheyyesh mecher, en kenas. vechol makom sheyyesh kenas, en mecher. ketanna yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas. naara yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher. habbogeret en lah lo mecher velo kenas:
Mishnah Ketubot 3:9-4:3:
Haomer pittiti et bitto shel peloni, meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo, veeno meshallem kenas. haomer ganavti vetavachti umacharti, meshallem et hakkeren al pi atzmo, veeno meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha. hemit shori et peloni o shoro shel peloni, hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo. hemit shori avdo shel peloni, eno meshallem al pi atzmo. ze hakkelal kol hameshallem yater al ma shehizzik, eno meshallem al pi atzmo: 
Naara shennitpatteta, bashtah ufegamah ukenasah shel aviha, vehatztzaar battefusa. amda vaddin ad shello met haav, hare hen shel av. met haav, hare hen shel achin. lo hispika laamod baddin ad shemmet haav, hare hen shel atzmah. amda vaddin ad shello vagra, hare hen shel av. met haav, hare hen shel achin. lo hispika laamod baddin ad shebbagra, hare hen shel atzmah. rabbi shimon omer, im lo hispika ligbot ad shemmet haav, hare hen shel atzmah. maase yadeha umetziatah, af al pi shello gavta, met haav, hare hen shel achin: 
Hameares et bitto, vegershah, ersah venitarmela, ketubbatah shello. hissiah vegershah, hissiah venitarmela, ketubbatah shellah. rabbi yehuda omer, harishona shel av. amru lo, mishshehissiah, en leaviha reshut bah:

Mishnah Ketubot 4:4-7:
Haav zakkay vevitto vekiddusheha, bakkesef bashshetar uvabbia, vezakkay bimtziatah, uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha. umekabbel et gittah, veeno ochel perot bechayyeha. nisset, yater alav habbaal sheochel perot bechayyeha, vechayyav bimzonoteha, befirkonah, uvikvuratah. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu ani shebbeyisrael, lo yifchot mishshene chalilim umekonanet: 
Leolam hi virshut haav, ad shettikkanes lirshut habbaal lannissuin. masar haav lishluche habbaal, hare hi virshut habbaal. halach haav im sheluche habbaal, o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal, hare hi virshut haav. masru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal, hare hi virshut habbaal:

Mishnah Peah 3:7-4:2: Hakkotev nechasav shechiv mera, shiyyer karka kol shehu, mattenato mattana. lo shiyyer karka kol shehu, en mattenato mattana. hakkotev nechasav levanav, vechatav leishto karka kol shehu, ibbeda chetubbatah. rabbi yose omer, im kibbela aleha, af al pi shello chatav lah, ibbeda chetubbatah:

Mishnah Peah 4:3-7:
Natal miktzat pea uzerakah al hashshear, en lo vah kelum. nafal lo aleha, uferes tallito aleha, maavirin otah hemennu. vechen beleket, vechen beomer hashshichcha:

Shalosh avayot bayyom, bashshachar uvachatzot uvammincha. rabban gamliel omer, lo amru ella kede shello yifchatu. rabbi akiva omer, lo amru ella kede shello yosifu. shel bet namer hayu melakketin al hachevel, venotnim pea mikkol umman veumman:

Hikdish kama ufada kama, chayyav. omarin ufada omarin, chayyav. kama ufada omarin, petura, shebbishat chovatah hayta fetura:
Mishnah Peah 4:8-11:
Kayyotze vo, hammakdish perotav ad shello vau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. mishshebbau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. hikdishan ad shello nigmeru ugemaran haggizbar, veachar kach pedaan, peturim, shebbishat chovatan hayu feturim:

Chore hannemalim shebbetoch hakkama, hare hen shel baal habbayit. shelleachar hakkotzrim, haelyonim laaniyyim, vehattachtonim shel baal habbayit. rabbi meir omer, hakkol laaniyyim, shessefek leket, leket:
Mishnah Peah 5:1-4:
Gadish shello lukkat tachtav, kol hannogea baaretz hare hu shel aniyyim. haruach sheppizzera et hoomarim, omdim otah kamma leket hi reuya laasot, venoten laaniyyim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, noten laaniyyim bichde nefila: 
Shibbolet shebbakkatzir veroshah maggia lakkama, im niktzera im hakkama, hare hi shel baal habbayit, veim lav, hare hi shel aniyyim. shibbolet shel leket shennitarva vaggadish, measser shibbolet achat venoten lo. amar rabbi eliezer, vechi heach heani hazze machalif davar shello va virshuto. ella mezakke et heani bechol haggadish, umeasser shibbolet achat venoten lo: 
En megalgelin betofeach, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim mattirin, mippene sheefshar: 
Baal habbayit shehaya over mimmakom lemakom, vetzarich littol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani, yittol, uchesheyyachazor leveto yeshallem, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ani haya beotah shaa:
Mishnah Peah 5:5-6:1:
Hammachalif im haaniyyim, beshello patur, uveshel aniyyim chayyav. shenayim shekkibbelu et hassade baarisut, ze noten laze chelko masar ani, veze noten laze chelko masar ani. hamekabbel sade liktzor, asur beleket shichcha ufea umasar ani. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shekkibbel mimmennu lemechetza, lishlish velirvia. aval im amar lo shelish ma sheatta kotzer shellach, muttar beleket uveshichcha uvefea, veasur bemasar ani: 
Hammocher et sadehu, hammocher muttar vehallokeach asur. lo yiskor adam et happoalim al menat sheyyelakket beno acharav. mi sheeno manniach et haaniyyim lilkot, o shehu manniach et echad veechad lo, o shehu mesayyea et echad mehen, hare ze gozel et haaniyyim. al ze neemar (Mishlei 22) al tasseg gevul olim: 
Haomer sheshshechachuhu foalim velo shechacho vaal habbayit, shechacho vaal habbayit velo shechachuhu foalim, amdu aniyyim befanav o shechippuhu vekash, hare ze eno shichcha: 
Hameammer lechovaot ulechumsaot, lacharara veloomarim, en lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, yesh lo shichcha. hameammer laggadish, yesh lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, en lo shichcha. ze hakkelal, kol hameammer lemakom shehu gemar melacha, yesh lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, en lo shichcha. lemakom sheeno gemar melacha, en lo shichcha. mimmennu velaggoren, yesh lo shichcha: 
Bet shammay omrim, hevker laaniyyim, hevker. uvet hillel omrim, eno hefker, ad sheyyufkar af laashirim, kashshemitta. kol amre hassade shel kav kav veechad shel arbaat kabbin ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha:
Mishnah Peah 6:2-5:
Haomer shehu samuch laggafa velaggadish, labbakar velakkelim, ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha: 
Rashe shurot, haomer shekkenegdo mochiach. haomer shehechezik bo leholicho el hair, ushechacho, modim sheeno shichcha: 
Veellu hen rashe shurot. shenayim shehitchilu meemtza hashshura, ze panav latztzafon veze panav laddarom, veshachchu lifnehem uleacharehem, et shellifnehem shichcha, veet shelleacharehem eno shichcha. yachid shehitchil merosh hashshura, veshachach lefanav uleacharav, shellefanav eno shichcha, veshelleacharav shichcha, mippene shehu beval tashuv (Devarim kad). ze hakkelal, kol shehu beval tashuv, shichcha. vesheeno beval tashuv, eno shichcha: 
Shene omarim, shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. shene tzibbure zetim vecharuvin, shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. shene hutzene fishtan, shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. shene gargerim, peret, ushelosha enan peret. shene shibbolim, leket, ushelosha enan leket. ellu kedivre vet hillel. veal kullan bet shammay omrim, shelosha, laaniyyim, vearbaa, levaal habbayit:
Niddah 12a:11-12b:1: Tanu rabbanan: chammarin ufoalin, vehabbain mibbet haevel umibbet hammishte — neshehem lahem bechezkat tohora, uvain veshohin immahem, ben yeshenot ben erot. bamme devarim amurim? shehinnichan bechezkat tohora, aval hinnichan bechezkat tumea — leolam hi temea, ad shettomar lo "tehora ani".

Shabbat 49a:6-8: Gemara amar rabbi yannay: tefillin tzerichin guf naki keelisha "baal kenafayim". may hi? abbaye amar: shello yafiach bahen. rava amar: shello yishan bahen.

Veammay kare leh "baal kenafayim"? — sheppaam achat gazra malchut romi harshaa shemad al yisrael shekkol hammanniach tefillin yenakkeru et mocho, vehaya elisha mannicham veyotze lashshuk. raahu kasdor echad ratz mippanav veratz acharav. vechevan shehiggia etzlo netalan merosho vaachazan beyado. amar lo: ma ze beyadcha? amar lo: kanfe yona. pashat et yado venimtzeu kanfe yona. lefichach korin oto "elisha baal kenafayim".

Umay shena kanfe yona mishshear ofot? mishshum deimmetil keneset yisrael leyona, shenneemar: "kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef vegomer" — ma yona kenafeha meginnot aleha, af yisrael mitzvot meginnot alehen.
Shulchan Arukh, Choshen Mishpat 227:1-4:
Asur lehonot et chavero, ben bemikkacho ben bemimkaro. veeze mehem sheinna, ben lokeach ben mocher, over belav. 
Kamma tihye haonaa veyihye chayyav lehashiv, shetut beshave. ketzad, hare shemmachar sheve shesh bechamesh o sheve sheva beshesh, o sheve chamesh beshesh, o sheve shesh besheva, hare zo onaa venikne hammikkach, vechayyav hameanne leshallem haonaa ulehachazirah kullah lammitanne. 
Hayta haonaa pachot mizze bechol shehu, kegon shemmachar sheve shivim beshishshim uferuta, eno chayyav lehachazir kelum, shekkol pachot mishshetut derech hakkol limchol bo. 
Hayta haonaa yetera al hashshetut kol shehu, kegon shemmachar sheve shishshim bachamishshim pachot peruta, batel hammikkach, vehammitanne yachol lehachazir hachefetz velo yikne kelal, aval hameanne eno yachol lachazor, im ratza ze vekibbel. <small>veyesh omrim deaf hameanne yachol lachazor bo, ella im ken nitratza hammitanne paam achat, o sheshshatak yoter min hashshiur sheyyitbaer besamuch saif 7 <small><small>(tur beshem 215 veharosh)</small>.</small> machar lo sheve 60 53 o lehefech, delekka chan onaa shetut, ulegabbe echad have bittul mekkach ulegabbe sheni mechila, azlenan batar hammikkach hen leinyan bittul mekkach hen leinyan mechila, detau inshe bemikkach velo bemaot <small><small>(mardechay perek hazzahav)</small>.</small> </small>

Asur ligzol o laashok afillu kol shehu, ben miyyisrael ben miggoy; veim hu davar delekka man dekappid be, shari; kegon littol mehachavila o mehaggader lachatzotz bo shinnav; veaf ze oser bayrushalmi, mimmiddat chasidut.

Shulchan Arukh, Choshen Mishpat 87:16-17:
Tzarich lishshava bashshem o beechad mikkol hakkinnuyyim, umeummad. veim nishba meyushshav, eno chozer venishba. vetalmid chacham, afillu lechattechilla meyushshav, ben shel tora ben shel divrehem, ben al taanat vadday ben al taanat safek. shenayim shennitatztzemu baddin, venishbeu shello yitanu ella haemet, veachar kach nitchayyev echad mehem shevua lachavero, yesh omrim sheeno niftar bashshevua harishona. <small>hagga: veyesh omrim deim nishbeu techilla binkitat chefetz uchedin shevua, en tzerichin lachazor velishava, ella mazkirin lo otah shevua <small><small>(mardechay resh perek haddayyanim uteshuvat harosh kelal 102 60 7)</small>.</small> veayyen lekamman saif 34.</small>

Hatztzedaka, hare hi bichlal hannedarim. lefichach haomer: hare alay sela litzdaka o hare hasela zo tzedaka, chayyav littenah laaniyyim miyyad. veim icher, over beval teacher <small><small>(devarim 23, 22)</small>.</small> shehare beyado litten miyyad, vaaniyyim metzuyim hem. veim en sham aniyyim, mafrish umanniach ad sheyyimtza aniyyim. <small>hagga: vechol ze bitzdaka sheyyesh beyado lechallekah beatzmo, aval keshennodrin tzedaka bevet hakkeneset littenah leyad gabbay, o shear tzedaka sheyyesh lo litten laggabbay, eno over aleha af al gav daaniyyim metzuyim. ella im ken tevao haggabbay veaz over aleha miyyad i kayyme aniyyim vehaggabbay haya mechallek lahem miyyad. veim en yadua laggabbay, tzarich hu lehodia laggabbay ma shennadar, kede sheyyuchal letavo. <small><small>(mardechay 180 8 186 209)</small>.</small> velo mikre aniyyim metzuyim ella aniyyim hatztzerichim lechallek lahem, aval im en derech lechallek lahem miyyad, lo mikre aniyyim metzuyim. <small><small>(gam ze bemardechay 6)</small>.</small> veim amar: etten sela litzdaka lifloni, eno over ad sheyyavo oto ani, af al gav dishar aniyyim metzuyim <small><small>(10 sham)</small>.</small> </small> vedavka bemafrish tzedaka setam, aval kol adam yachol lehaferish maot litzdaka sheyyihyu munnachim etzlo littenam meat al yad al yad, kemo sheyyerae lo. <small><small>(tur beshem harosh)</small></small> vechen im hitna beshaa shennadar bitzdaka o hitnaddev otam sheyyihyu hagabbaim rashshaim leshannotah uletzarfah bezahav, hare elu muttarim. <small><small>(rambam)</small></small>

En mevakkerin hachole beg shaot rishonot shel yom, mippene shekkol chole, mekel alav chalyo babboker, velo yachush levakkesh alav rachamim. velo beg shaot acharonot shel yom, sheaz machbid alav chalyo, veyityaesh millevakkesh alav rachamim. <small>vechol shebbikker velo bikkesh alav rachamim, lo kiyyem hammitzva <small><small>(bet yosef beshem haramban)</small>.</small> </small>
Yevamot 39b:8-23: Tenan hatam: mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza. barishona, shehayu mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva. achshav sheen mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva, amru: mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum.
Amar rav: en kofin. ki ato lekammeh derav, amar lehu: i baet — chalotz, i baet — yaybem. bedidach tela rachamana: "veim lo yachpotz haish", ha im chafetz, i bae — chaletz, i bae — yeyabbem.

Veaf rav yehuda savar en kofin. middeatken rav yehuda begitta dachalitza: ech pelonit bat peloni akrivat yat peloni yevama kodamana leve dina, veishtemodinhu daachu demitana meabba nihu, veamri leh: i tzavet leyabbem — yabbem, vei la — aytla la riglaych deyammina.
Veaytla la rigla deyammina, usherat seneh maal raglohi, virakat beanpohi rukka demitchazya leve dina al ara.
Verabbi chiyyay bar avya mesayyem ba mishshemeh derav yehuda: veakrinhu ma dichtiv bisfar orayyta demoshe.
Ishtemodinhu, peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: beedim, vechad amar: afillu karov, afillu ishsha. vehilcheta: galloye milleta vealma hu, vaafillu karov vaafillu ishsha.
Barishona, shehayu mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva — mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza. veachshav sheen mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva, amru: mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum.
Amar rame bar chama amar rabbi yitzchak: chazru lomar mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak: ikkashshur dare?
Meikkara savri la keabba shaul, ulevassof savri la kerabbanan.

Detanya, abba shaul omer: hakkones et yevimto leshem noy, uleshum ishut, uleshum davar acher — keillu pogea beerva. vekarov ani beenay lihyot havvalad mamzer. vachachamim omrim: "yevamah yavo aleha", mikkol makom.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: "yevamah yavo aleha" — mitzva! shebbattechilla hayta alav bichlal hetter. neesra, vechazra vehuttera, yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon — talmud lomar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva.

Man tanna? amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: abba shaul hi. vehachi kaamar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva. shebbattechilla hayta alav bichlal hetter. ratza leshem noy — konsah, ratza leshum ishut — konsah.
Neesra, chazra vehuttera. yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon — talmud lomar: "yevamah yavo aleha", lemitzva.
Rava amar: afillu tema rabbanan, vehachi kaamar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva. shebbattechilla hayta bichlal hetter. ratza konsah, ratza eno konsah.
Neesra, chazra vehuttera. yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon, ratza — konsah, ratza — eno konsah. ratza eno konsah?
Ha agida beh, bichdi tippok? ella ema: ratza — konsah, ratza — choletz lah, talmud lomar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva.
Zevachim 54b:3-9: Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "vayyelech david ushemuel vayyeshvu benoyot barama"? vechi ma inyan noyot etzel rama? ella shehayu yoshvin barama veoskin benoyo shel olam.
Amri, ketiv: "vekamta vealita el hammakom" – melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoah mikkol eretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael gevoha mikkol aratzot. la havo yadi ducheteh hecha;
Ayyto sefer yehoshua, bechullehu ketiv: "veyarad (veala) haggevul", "vetaar haggevul"; beshevet binyamin "veala" ketiv, "veyarad" la ketiv. amri, shema minna: hacha hu mekomo.
Sevur lemivneyeh been etam – demiddele; amri: nitatte beh kallil, kedichtiv: "uven ketefav shachen".
Veibbaet ema: gemiri desanhedrin bechelko dihuda ushechina bechelko devinyamin, vei medallinan leh – mitpeleg tuva; mutav denitatte beh pureta, kedichtiv: "uven ketefav shachen".

Veal davar ze nitkanne doeg haadomi bedavid, kedichtiv: "ki kinat betcha achalatni", uchetiv: "zechor Adonai ledavid et kol unnoto asher nishba laAdonai vegomer, im avo beohel beti vegomer, im etten shenat leenay leafappay tenuma ad emtza makom laAdonai vegomer".
"Hinne shemaanuha veefrata metzanuha bisde yaar"; "beefrata" – ze yehoshua, dekaate meefrayim. "metzanuha bisde yaar" – ze binyamin, dichtiv: "binyamin zeev yitraf".
Zohar, Bereshit 78: Ta chaze, kad itkaddash yoma bemaale shabbatta sukkat shalom sharya veitperisat bealma. man sukkat shalom, da shabbatta, vechol ruchin veilulin veshedin vechol sitra dimsaave kulhu temirin vealin beena derechayyay denukeva dithoma rabba. deha kevan deitar kedushata al alma, ruach mesaava la itar bahadeh. veda arik mikkammeh deda.

Ucheden alma bintiru illaa vela baenan letzallaa al netiru kegon shomer et ammo yisrael laad amen. deha da beyoma dechol ittakkan dealma baya netiru. aval beshabbat sukkat shalom itperisa al alma veitnetir bechol sitrin. veafillu chayyayve gehinnom netirin innun, vecholla bishlama ishtakkecha illain vetattain, ubbegin kach bekiddusha deyoma mevarchinan happores sukkat shalom alenu veal kol amo yisrael veal yerushalam.

Ammay al yerushalam, ella da hi medora dehahi sukka. uvaena lezammena lehahi sukka deitperasat alana ulemeshra immana ulemeheve (davar acher mageynea) alana keimma desharyay al benin, uvegin da la dachalin mikkol sitrin, veal da happores sukkat shalom alenu.

Ta chaze, beshaata deyisrael mevarchin umezammenin lehay sukkat shalom ushepiza kadisha veamre happores sukkat shalom, keden kedushata ilaa nachata uferisat gadfaha alayyhu deyisrael umechasya lon keimma al benin, vechol zinin bishin itkannishu mealma, veyatve yisrael techot kedushata demarehon, ucheden da sukkat shalom yahiv nishmatin chadtin livnaha, may taama begin debeh nishmatin sharyayn (sefer acher dichden zeman ziuuga venittelet nishmatin uvah sharyayn) uminneh nafkin. vechevan desharya uferisat gadfaha al benaha. arikat nishmatin chadtin lechol chad vechad.

Tu amar rabbi shimon al da tanenan shabbat dugema dealma deate ihu, hachi hu vadday, veal da shemita veyovel dugema da beda. veshabbat vealma deate hachi hu. vehahu tosefet denishmeta meraza dezachur ka atya al hay sukkat shalom denatil mealma deate veda tosefet yahavat lealmma kaddisha. uvehahu tosefet chadan veyitneshe minnayyhu kol millin dechol vechol tzaarin vechol akin kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom haniach Adonai lecha meatzbecha umeragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha vegomer.

Uvelelya deshabbatta bae bar nash leatama mikkolla, begin leachazaa dehay sukkat shalom mikkolla itkelilat, uvilvad dela yafgim mechla chada leyoma, veit deamre teren, litren seudate ochoranin deyoma, veshappir. vechol shekken i salik yattir leyoma veyachil lemitam mimmechlin ochoranin velizire bitre tavshilin sagya, veukemuha chavraya.

Ner shel shabbat linshe amma kaddisha ityeyhivat leadlaka, vechavrayay ha amru deihi kibbeta botzina dealma veachashichat leh kulei veshappir. aval raza demilla. hay sukkat shalom matronita dealma hi venishmatin deinnun botzina illaa bah sharyayn. veal da matronita baaya leadlaka, deha beduchetaha itachdat vaavadat ovada.

Veitteta baaya bechedva delibba ureuta leadlaka botzina deshabbat, deha yekara illaa hi lah uzechu rav legarmah lemizke livnin kaddishin dihon botzina dealma beorayyta uvedachalta, veyisgon shelama beara, vihevat levaalah orka dechayyin, begin kach baaya leizdahara bah.

Ta chaze, shabbat lelya veyoma zachor veshamor ihu kechada, veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekadsho uchetiv shamor et yom hashshabbat, zachor lidchura shamor lenukeva vecholla chad. zakkain innun yisrael chulakeh dekudesha berich hu adveh veachasanteh alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elokav.
Zohar, Vayera 10: Kevan deitbassar avraham beyitzchak, ma ketiv vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al peni sedom. rabbi elazar amar ta chaze, kamma anhag kudesha berich hu tivu im kol beriyayn vechol shekken leinnun deazle bearchoy, deafillu bezimna devae lemedan alma, ihu garim leman derachim leh lemizke bemilla ad la yete hahu dina lealma.

Detaninan beshaata dekudesha berich hu rachim leh lebar nash, meshadder leh dorona, uman ihu, missekena, begin deyizke beh. vechevan dezache beh, ihu amshich aleh chad chuta dechesed deitmeshach missetar yamina ufaris aresheh verashim leh, begin dechad yete dina lealma hahu mechabbela yizdehar beh, vezakef enoy vechama lehahu reshimu ucheden istallak minneh veizdehar beh. begine chach akdim leh kudesha berich hu bemma deyizke.

Veta chaze, kad bae kudesha berich hu leaytaa dina al sedom, azke kodem leavraham veshaddar leh dorona lemizke immehon begin leshezava lelot bar achuha mittamman, hada hu dichtiv vayyizkor elohim et avraham vayshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha. vela ketiv vayyizkor elohim et lot, deha bizchuteh deavraham ishteziv. umay vayyizkor, dedachir leh may deazke kodem im innun telat malachin.

Kegavvna da bar nash deyizke bitzdaka im bene nesha, beshaata dedina sharya bealma kudesha berich hu adkar leh lehahi tzedaka deavad. begin debchol shaata dezache bar nash hachi achtiv aleh leela, veafillu beshaata dedina sharya aloy kudesha berich hu idkar leh lehahu tivu deavad vezacha im bene nasha. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 11:4) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet. begine chach akdim leh kudesha berich hu leavraham begin deyizke visheziv lelot.

Vayyashkifu al pene sedom. ta chaze, vayyakumu mishsham haanashim. mehahi seuda deatkin lo avraham vezacha behu. af al gav demalachin havu, zacha behu, vechol hahu mechla la ishtaar minneh kelum, begine deavraham, ulemizke beh, deha ketiv vayyochelu beesha dilhon (120 1) itachil.

Vei tema ha telat malachin havu. hay esha. vehay maya. vehay rucha. ela kol chad vechad kalil bechavreh uvegine chach vayyochelu. kegavvna da (Shemot 24:11) vayyechezu et haelohim vayyochlu vayyishtu. achila vaddait achlu deitzanu min shechinta, uf hacha vayyochelu garmu (nusach acher nirmaz ramaz) leitzena (minneh) mehahu sitra deavraham itdevak beh, uvegin kach la asharu mimma deyahiv lon avraham kelum.

Kegavvevna da bae leh lebar nash lemishte mehahu kassa divracha, begin deyizke lehahi beracha dilela. uf innun achlu mimma deatkin lon avraham begin deyizkun leitzena missitra deavraham. deha mehahu sitra nafik mezona lechulhu malache illae.
Vayyashkifu, itaruta derachame leshezava lelot. ketiv hacha vayyashkifu uchetiv hatam (Devarim 26:15) hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha. ma lehallan lerachame uf hacha lerachame.

Veavraham holech immam leshallecham. lemebad lon levaya. amar rabbi yesa i tema deavraham yada demalachin innun ammay aavid lon levaya. ella amar rabbi elazar af al gav dehava yada (ragil hava lameaked lechullehu bene nasha dizminin immeh lameaked lon leviyya) (nusach acher ma dehava ragil lemebad im bene nasha eved behu vaalavey lon) begin dechach itzterich leh lebar nash lemebad levaya leushepizin deha kolla behay talya,

Uveod deihu hava azil immehon itgeli kudesha berich hu aleh deavraham dichtiv vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham asher ani ose. vaAdonai hu uvet dineh, begin dekudesha berich hu hava azil immehon.

Ta chaze kad bar nash avid levaya (levar nash) lechavreh ihu amshich (aleh) lishchinta leitchabbera bahadeh ulemehach immeh bearcha leshezava leh. uvegin kach bae leh lebar nash lelavuye leushepiza begin dechabbar leh lishchinta veamshich aleh leitchabbera bahadeh.
Zohar, Vayera 16: Vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma baerev vegomer. amar rabbi yose ta chaze ma ketiv leela vayyelech Adonai kaasher killa ledabber el avraham. deha kevan deitperash shechinta meavraham, veavraham tav leatreh, keden vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma baerev, deha chad istallak bishchinta, veishtaaru innun teren.
Kevan dechama lot lon, rahat batrayyhu. may tama, vechi kol innun dehavu atyayn ihu ail lon leveteh veyahiv lon lemechal ulemishte uveni mata hech la katlin leh, deha livratteh avdu dina.
Umay hu. divratteh delot yahavat pitta denahama lechad anya, yadu bah, shafuha duvesha veotvuha berish igra ad deachluha tzire.
Ella begin dehava belelya chashiv dela yistakkelun leh bene mata, veim kol da kevan daaalu leveta itkenashu kulhu veascharu leveta.

Amar rabbi yitzchak ammay rahat lot abbatrayyhu, (ella begin) dichtiv vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam. rabbi chizkiyya verabbi yesa. chad amar diukena deavraham chama imhon. vechad amar shechinta atya alayyhu. ketiv hacha vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam, uchetiv hatam vayyaratz likratam mippetach haohel. ma lehallan chama shechinta, uf hacha chama shechinta.

Vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam vayyomer hinne na adonay beAlef dalet nun yod. suru na, geshu na mibbae leh, may suru na. ella leahadara lon sacharaneh deveta begin dela yechomun lon bene mata, vela yealun beorach meshar leveta, uvegin kach suru na.

Rabbi chizkiyya patach (iyyov 28:24) ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit tachat kol hashshamayim yire. kamma it lon livne nasha leistakkala beovadoy dekudesha berich hu, uleishtaddala beorayyta yemama velele, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, kudesha berich hu ishtabbach beh leela, veishtabbach beh letatta, begin deorayyta ilana dechayye ihi lechol innun deaskin bah lemehav lon chayyin bealma den ulemehav lon chayyin bealma deate.

Ta chaze, ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit. lemehav lon mezona ulesappaka lon mikkol ma deitzterichu, begin deihu ashgach bah tadir, dichtiv, (Devarim 11:12) tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah merishit hashshana vead acharit shana.

Begin deeretz da ma ketiv bah (Mishlei 31:14) mimmerchak tavi lachmah, ulevatar ihi yehavt mezona vetarfa lechol innun chevan bera dichtiv (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha.

Veal da ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit tachat kol hashshamayim yire. lechulhu bene alma lemehav lon mezona vesippuka lechol ma deitzterich kol chad vechad dichtiv (Tehillim 145:16) poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon.
Davar acher ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit. leistakkala ovadoy devar nash uleashgacha bechol ma deavde bene nasha bealma. tachat kol hashshamayim yire. mistakkel vechame lechol chad vechad.

Ta chaze, kevan dechama kudesha berich hu ovadin disdom vaamora, shaddar lon leinnun malachin lechabbala lisdom. ma ketiv vayyar lot chama lishchinta. vechi man yachil lemechome shechinta, ela chama zahara chad denahir deka salka al reshayyhu. ucheden vayyomer hinne na adonay beAlef dalet kema deittemar, uvegin shechinta hahu nehiru denahir kaamar, suru na el bet avdechem velinu verachatzu raglechem.

La avad hachi avraham, ella bekadmita amar verachatzu raglechem ulevatar veekcha pat lechem vegomer. aval lot amar suru na el bet avdechem velinu. ulevatar verachatzu raglechem vehishkamtem vahalachtem ledarkechem. begin dela yishtemodun behu bene nasha.
Vayyomru lo ki varchov nalin. begin dechach havu avde orchin dealin tamman la hava bar nash deyichnosh lon leveta, veal da amru lo ki varchov nalin. ma ketiv vayyiftzar bam meod vegomer.

Ta chaze kad kudesha berich hu avid dina bealma, shelicha chada avid leh, vehasheta chamenan tere sheluche, ammay vechi la sagge bechad. ela chad hava, uma deamar tere (hachi hu vadday begin dechad) chad hava leappaka leh lelot uleshezava leh, vechad lemehpach lekarta ulechabbala ara, uvegin kach ishtaar chad:
Zohar, Vayera 18: VaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora vegomer. rabbi chiyyay patach (Yeshayahu 13:9) hinne yom Adonai ba achzari vegomer. hinni yom Adonai ba, da be dina letatta. ba kema deittemar. (106 1) habbaa elay (asu). begin dela avid dina ad deal venatil reshu, kegavvna da ketz kol basar ba lefanay.
Davar acher hinne yom Adonai ba. da hu mechabbela letatta kad natil nishmata, begine kach achzari veevra. lasum haaretz leshamma, da sedom vaamora. vechattaeha yashmid mimmennah. illen yatve ara.

Ma ketiv batreh ki kochve hashshamayim uchesilehem vegomer. deha min shemaya amtar alehon esha, veaavar lon min alma. levatar ma ketiv okir enosh mippaz vegomer. da avraham dekudesha berich hu salik leh al kol bene alma.

Rabbi yehuda okim lon lehanne kerae beyoma deitcharav be makdesha, divhahu yoma itchashchu illae vetattae, veitchashchan shemaya vechochvaya. rabbi elazar mokim lehanne kerae beyoma deyokim kudesha berich hu lichneset yisrael meafra, vehahu yoma yityeda leela vetatta, dichtiv, (zecharya 14:7) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai. vehahu yoma yoma denokma ihu, dezammin kudesha berich hu lenakma mishshear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot.

Vechad kudesha berich hu yaavid nukemin bishar amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, keden okir enosh mippaz da malka meshicha deyistallak veyityaykar al kol beni alma, vechol bene alma yiflechun veyisgedun kammeh dichtiv, (Tehillim 72:9) lefanav yichreu tziyyim vegomer malche tarshish vegomer.

Ta chaze, af al gav dinvua da ittemar al bavel, becholla ittemar. deha chamenan behay parshata dichtiv (230 samuch 110 shellemala 320 bah okir enosh vegomer veulay ladaat 123 chad 280 hi) ki yerachem Adonai et yaakov. uchetiv ulekachum ammim vehevium el mekomam.

VaAdonai himtir al sedom. da darga deve dina letatta denatil reshu meela. rabbi yitzchak amar deavid dina berachame. dichtiv meet Adonai min hashshamayim. begin leishtakkacha dina berachame. vei tema may rachame hacha dichtiv vayhi beshachet elohim et are hakkikkar vayyizkor elohim et avraham vegomer. ulevatar nafku minneh teren umin shelemin, vezacha denafik minneh david ushelomo malka.

Chame ma ketiv vayhi kehotziam otam hachutza vayyomer vegomer. ta chaze (63 1) beshaata dedina share bealma, ha ittemar dela libbae lebar nash leishtakkacha beshuka, begin dechevan desharya dina la ashgach ben zakkaa vechayyayva, vela vae (leistakkela) leishtakkacha tamman. veha ittemar divgin kach istim noach batteva vela yishgach bealma beshaata dedina yitavid. uchetiv (Shemot 12:22) veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker ad deyitavid dina. uvegin kach vayyomer himmalet al nafshecha al tabbit acharecha vegomer.

Rabbi yitzchak verabbi yehuda havu azle bearcha. amar rabbi yehuda lerabbi yitzchak dina deavid kudesha berich hu bammabbul vedina disdom, tarvavyyhu dinin degehinnom havu begin dechayyayve gehinnom itdanu bemaya uveesha.

Amar rabbi yitzchak sedom bedina degehinnom itdan, dichtiv vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim. da missitra demayay veda (ayyen sof hassefer siman b) missitra deesha. da veda hu dina degehinnom, vechayyayvin degehinnom bitren dinin illen itdanu.

Amar leh dina dechayyayve degehinnom teresar yarche, vekudesha berich hu salik lon miggehinnom, vetamman mitlabbenin veyatvin letara degehinnom, vechaman innun chayyayvin dealin vedanin lon tamman, veinnun tave rachame alayyhu. ulevatar kudesha berich hu chayyis alayyhu veail lon leducheta deitzterich lon. mehahu yoma ulehala gufa ishtechach beafra venishmata yarta atrah kidchaze lah. (58 69 1).

Ta chaze deha ittemar deafillu innun bene tofana la itdanu ella beesha umayya. mayyay keriran nachate milleela, umayyay retichan salke mittatta keesha. veitdanu bitre dinin, begin dedina dilela hachi hava, vegin kach bisdom gafrit vaesh.

Amar leh i yekumun leyom dina. amar leh ha ittemar. aval illen disdom vaamora la yekumun, ukera ochach dichtiv, (Devarim 29:22) gafrit vamelach serefa chol artzah lo tizzara velo tatzmiach vegomer. asher hafach Adonai beappo uvachamato. asher hafach Adonai, bealma den. beappo, bealma deate. uvachamato, bezimna dezammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayyay. amar leh ta chaze, kamma deara dilhon itavid lealam ulealme almaya, hachi name itavidu innun lealam ulealme almaya.
Veta chaze, dina dekudesha berich hu dina lokovel dina. innun la hava tayyvin nafsha demiskena bemechla uvemishtayya, uf hachi kudesha berich hu la ativ lon nafshayyhu lealma deate.

Veta chaze, innun itmenau mitztzedaka deikre chayyim, uf kudesha berich hu mana minnayyhu chayyim bealma den uvealma deate. vechamma deinnun manu archin ushevilin mibbene alma, hachi name kudesha berich hu mana minnayyhu orchin ushevilin derachame lerachama alayyhu bealma den uvealma deate.

Rabbi abba amar kulhu bene alma yekumun, vikumun ledina vealayyhu ketiv, (Daniel 12:2) veelle lacharafot ulederaon olam. vekudesha berich hu mari derachamin ihu, kevan dedan lehu behay alma vekabbilu dina, la itdanu bechulhu dinin.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ketiv vayshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha vegomer. (105 1) mahu bahafoch et hearim asher yashav bahen lot. ela bechulhu avad diyyureh lot, dichtiv velot yashav beare hakkikkar vayyeehal ad sedom. Sitre tora toseppeta keture rammay, huremne (ayyen sof hassefer 70 b) divdure. (nusach acher dabevareyrey 57 dabevareyynay) chakkimin besuchletanu, yistakkelun leminda, beshaatta deresha chivvavra attekin kurseyay al gabbe samchin deavnin demargelitan tavan.
Ben innun avnin itt chad margalita shappira bechezu yaa bereva kumetra dekantara (nusach acher dakeyteraa) dimlahata be gevavnin, innun 70 gevavnin melahatan lechol setar.

Illen 70 mitteparshan miggo 3 gevavnin. illen zikin bezikin dintztzitztzin led sitre alma, hacha itta zika takkippa distar semala deitteachid bishmaya. innun gevavnin shivin (Daniel 7:10) dina yattiv vesipperin petichu.

Mehacha nappeke girin useyaypin veromchin veesha dekusetra. veitteachid esha takkippa denappeka mishamayim beh, vechad itteachad eshsha illaa beillen diltatta, lett man deyachil leittebar rugeza vedina.

Ayynin lahatin ketisin denura, nachitt behu lealma. vavy man deiara beh, chagir chartztzin (sefer acher charevin), ihu charba shinnena bideh, la chayis al tav veal bish. deha (sefer acher paska) pitteka deinnun shivin birshu deitteachid hahu sitra dishmaya nachitt bida semala bechamma dinin,

Ittehappecha bechamma gevavnin, happucha bechol yoma, ihu ikre kerum zellutt dimtakkena legabbe bene adam. kol gevavnin dichle zaamo dekudesha bericha hu beh ittechazzeyayn. veinnun yattevin berume dealma, uvene nasha besichlutta dilhon la mashgeche behon.

Sittera desitterin lachachimin ittemasar. shema da deikkere shamayim minneh ittebre sittera deikkere adam. chashvan shayype guppa deinnun chusheban mattan vearbein uttemanya shayypin.

Chashvan attevohi mattan veshitt sare, shema da deihu raza vesittera kelala dechol orayyta bechv attevavn veeser amiran, begin deha shema da mattan veshitt sare attevavn uttelattin utteren shevilin deitteklilan beh, ha mattan vearbain uttemanya shayypin deguppa

Raza deikre adam deshallit al kurseyay. raza deshivin diltatta, vesittera da dichtiv (yechezkel 1:26) veal demutt hakkisse demutt kemare adam alav millemala, veda hu sittera dichtiv vaAdonai himtir al sedom vegomer meett Adonai min hashamayim. vecholla chad umilla chada, vesittera chada lachachime libba ittemasar, zakkaa (davar acher 33 ihu) chulakhon bealma den uvealma deatte.

Sedom gezar dina dilhon al demanu tzedaka minnayyhu, kema deat amer, (yechezkel 16:49) veyad ani veevyon lo hechezika. uvegin kacha dina la hava ella min shamayim. tzedaka veshamayim kolla chad uchetiv, (Tehillim 108:5) ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha, uvegin detalya tzedaka bishmeh (nusach acher besamim) dina hu mishamayim dichtiv mott Adonai min hashamayim.

Dina deyisrael mehay attar dichtiv, (Eicha 4:6) vayyigdal avon batt ammi mechatatt sedom. veikre yerushalem achott lisdom kema deat amer, (yechezkel 16:49) hinne ze haya avon sedom achottecha, vedinhon hava min shemaya dina chada kisdom al demanu tzedaka minnayyhu. bar deda ittehappacha veda ittecharav, da itt lah tekuma, veda lett lah tekuma, (ad kan sitre tora).
Zohar, Vayera 36:509-513: Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 63:9) bechol tzaratam lo tzar umalach panav hoshiam vegomer. ta chaze, bechol tzaratam deyisrael kad izdamman lon akan, ketiv lo beAlef ukeri beVav, begin dekudesha berich hu immehon beaku. lo beAlef, atar illaa yattir, af al gav delav behahu atar rugeza veaku, lehatam leela mata akta deyisrael. lo beAlef kema deat amer, (tehillim 100) hu asanu velo anachnu. ketiv beAlef ukeri beVav.

Umalacha panav hoshiam. veha ihu imhon behahu aku, veat amart hoshiam. ella moshiam lo ketiv, ella hoshiam mikkadmat dena deihu zammin behahu aku lemisbal immehon. ta chaze, bechol zimna deyisrael innun begaluta, shechinta immehon begaluta, veha ukemuha, dichtiv (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha verichamcha vegomer.

Davar acher umalach panav hoshiam, da shechinta. deihi immehon begaluta veat amart deihu hoshiam. ella hachi hu vadday, deillen innun mishkenotav dekudesha berich hu begaluta, uvegin dishchinta immehon kudesha berich hu adkar lon leotava lon velafaka lon min galuta, dichtiv, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vaezkor et beriti bekadmita, ulevatar veatta hinne tzaakat bene yisrael baa elay.

Vegam raiti. leasgaa reiya ochora deihu kadmaa decholla, uchetiv, (Shemot 2:24) vayyizkor elohim et berito da shechinta. et avraham leavraham mibbae leh, ella et avraham da hu chavruta veziuuga dilah baavahan. et avraham (Bamidbar 120 1) da hu maaravit deromit. et yitzchak da hu tzefonit maaravit. veet yaakov da hu ziuuga chada, kelala chada, ziuuga shelim kedka yaot.

Kegavvna da et hashshamayim da hu kelala middat layla bayyom. veet haaretz da middat yom belayla kechada. uf hacha bechullehu et, uveyaakov veet, lemeheve kolla ziuuga chada dela mitparshin dechar venukeva lealmin. vezammin kudesha berich hu leachraza bechol alma uleashmaa kal deyema (Yeshayahu 63:8-9) vayyomer ach ammi hemma banim lo yeshakkeru vyhi lahem lemoshia. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen: (ad kan parashat vayyar)
Zohar, Vayera 7: Vayyomer shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya. amar rabbi yitzchak shov ashuv, shov yashuv mibbae leh, deha maftecha da lemifkad akarot bida dekudesha berich hu ihu vela bida dishlicha ochora.

Kema detaninan telat maftechan innun dela itmesaru bida dishlicha. dechayya utechiyyat hammetim ugeshamim. vehoil dela itmesaru bida dishlicha ammay ketiv shov ashuv. ella vadday kudesha berich hu dehava kaim alayyhu amar (leh) milla, vegin kach ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha.

Veta chaze, bechol atar dichtiv vayyomer setam o vayyikra setam hu malacha divrit vela ochora. vayyomer dichtiv, (Shemot 15:26) vayyomer im shamoa tishma vegomer vayyomer vela kaamar man hu. vayyikra dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:1) vayyikra el moshe vela kaamar man hava. amar dichtiv, (Shemot 24:16) veel moshe amar vegomer vela amar man hava. (uf hachi dichtiv vayyomer shuv ashuv vayyomer setam velo kaamar man hava) ella bechol hanne malacha divrit hava vecholla bekudesha berich hu ittemar. uvegin kach ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha vegomer. vehinne ven vegomer:

rashi: Hinne artzi lefanecha. aval paro amar lo hinne ishtecha kach valech, lefi shennityare, shehammitzriyyim shetufe zimma:
Al taazveha vegomer ehaveha. ehov otah:
targum: Vela tishbakya vetintaryach rachamah detugavyach:

rashi: Ki lo uchal laasot. ze anshan shel malachim al sheamru ki mashchitim anachnu, vetalu haddavar beatzman, lefichach lo zazu mishsham ad shehuzkeku lomar sheen haddavar birshutan:
Ki lo uchal. leshon yachid; mikkan atta lamed shehaechad hofech vehaechad matztzil, sheen 2 malachim nishlachim ledavar 1:
Al ken kara shem hair tzoar. al shem vehiv mitzar:
Elohim immecha. lefi sherau sheyyatza mishshechunat sedom leshalom, veim hammelachim nilcham venaflu veyado, venifkeda ishto lizkunav:

Yamim rabbim. merubbim al shel chevron. bechevron asa 25 shana vechan 26, shehare ben 75 shana haya betzeto mecharan, otah shana vayavo vayyeshev beelone mamre, shello matzinu kodem lachen shennityashshev ella sham, shebbechol mekomotav haya keoreach chone venosea veholech, shenneemar vayyaavor avram, vayyatek mishsham, vayhi raav baaretz vayyered avram mitzrayma (Bereshit 12), uvemitzrayim lo asa ella shelosha chodashim shehare shelacho faro miyyad, vayyelech lemassaav ad vayyavo vayyeshev beelone mamre asher bechevron (sham 13), sham yashav ad shennehefcha sedom, miyyad vayyissa mishsham avraham mippene vusha shel lot uva leeretz pelishtim, uven 99 shana haya, shehare vashshelishi lemilato bau etzlo hammalachim, hare 25 shana, vechan ketiv yamim rabbim, merubbim al harishonim, velo va hakkatuv listom ella lefaresh, veim hayu merubbim alehem shete shanim o yoter haya mefarsham, veal karchacha enam yeterim yoter mishshana, hare 26 shana; miyyad yatza mishsham vechazar lechevron, veotah shana kadma lifne akedato shel yitzchak 12 shanim, beseder olam:
Vattabbet ishto meacharav. shel lot:
Vattehi netziv melach. bemelach chata uvemelach lakta; amar lah teni meat melach laorchim hallalu, amra lo af hamminhag hara hazze atta va lehanehig bammakom hazze (Bereshit Rabba):

Vayyiggash avraham. matzinu haggasha lammilchama, vayyiggash yoav vegomer (Shmuel 2 10), vehaggasha lefius vayyiggash elav yehuda, vehaggasha litfilla, vayyiggash eliyyahu hannavi (Melachim 1 18), ulechol elle nichnas avraham ledabber kashot ulefiyyus velitfilla:
Haaf tispe. hagam tispe. uletargum shel unkelos, shettirgemo leshon rogez, kach perusho, haaf yassiacha shettispe tzaddik im rasha:
ohc: Vayyiggash avraham vegomer. leheyot sheamar Adonai "hakketzaakatah vegomer asu kala", mashma keshettihye machraat middat haddin kala lakkol, vahagam sheyyeshnam liktzat mehem tzaddikim, laze amar "haaf tispe" vegomer. velu yihye shekkavvanatcha lomar shettaase ofen lemallet hattovim shebbahem kemo sheasa lelot shehotzio hachutza, odenni toen al ze ulay yesh shiur chamishshim tzaddikim, haaf tispe harshaim velo tissa baavur hachamishshim, velo totzi harshaim mikkirbah, vehu sheddikdek lomar asher bekirbah. veamro chalila lecha vegomer mehamit tzaddik keneged chalukka rishona sheamar "haaf tispe", aval chalukka sheniyya shebbikkesh lehatztzil tzaddik verasha eno ella bakkashat rachamim ulay yitashshet Adonai lo velo yaamid kav haddin ad katze haacharon.
Veamro vehaya chatztzaddik vegomer, perush: keshettamit tzaddik yihye behashevaa etzel hannivraim yachad, katztzaddik karasha behaderaga achat, velo yishtaddelu lehitztaddek.

Uma sheamar paam sheniyya "chalila lach" keneged chalukka sheniyya, im lo yitratztze lissa lammakom baavur chamishshim viabbed kol harshaim, "chalila" vegomer. perush acher, shekkevar nishba meavor me noach, gilla dato ki lo yaamid kav haddin ad katze haacharon. veayyen befarashat noach (Bereshit 9:11) ma shekkatavti beferush pasuk "vahakimoti", umishsham taskil kavvanat avraham betaanato.

rashi: Vehinne ayil. muchan haya lechach mishsheshet yeme vereshit:
Achar. achare sheamar lo hammalach al tishlach yadcha, raahu keshehu neechaz, vehu shemmetargeminan uzekaf avraham yat enohi batar illen:
Bassevach. ilan:
Bekarnav. shehaya ratz etzel avraham, vehassatan sovcho umearbevo vailanot:

Tachat beno. meachar shekkatuv vayyaalehu leola, lo chaser hammikra kelum, mahu tachat beno? al kol avoda sheasa mimmennu haya mitpallel veomer yehi ratzon shettehe zo keillu hi asuya bivni, keillu beni shachut, keillu damo zaruk, keillu hu mufshat, keillu hu niktar venaase deshen:

Reshit chachma kene chachma. techillat chachmatcha lemod meacherim, kene lecha shemua mippi harav, veachar kach bechol kinyancha kene vina, titbonen bah meatzmecha lehasekil hatteamim, davar mittoch davar:
targum: Resh chachmeta kene chachmeta uvechol kinyanach kene veyuna:

rashi: Meeretz mitzrayim. mimmekom gidduleha, shenneemar velah shifcha mitzrit vegomer (Bereshit 16:1), hayenu deamri inashe zerok chutera laavira, aikkereh kae:
Vayyera elav. levakker et hachole. amar rabbi chama bar chanina, yom shelishi lemilato haya, uva hakkabba veshaal bishlomo (bava metzia 86):
Baalavenay mamre. hu shennatan lo etza al hammila, lefichach nigla alav bechelko (Bereshit Rabba):

Yoshev. yoshev ketiv, bikkesh laamod, amar lo hakkabba shev vaani eemod, veatta siman levanecha sheatid ani lehityatztzev baadat haddayyanim vehen yoshvin, shenneemar elohim nitztzav baadat el (Tehillim 82) (Bereshit Rabba):
Petach haohel. lirot im yesh over vashav veyachnisem beveto:
Kechom hayyom. hotzi hakabba chamma minnartikah, shello lehatericho beorchim, ulefi sheraahu mitztaer shello hayu orchim baim, hevi hammalachim alav bidmut anashim (bava metzia sham):
ohc: Vayyera elav Adonai. yesh ladaat lamma shinna hakkatuv lehakedim haroe kodem hannire shehitchil ledabber bo, shehaya lo lomar "vayyera Adonai elav", uchemo chen matzinu sheddibber bechol hammekomot hakkodmot (Bereshit 12:7) "vayyera Adonai el avram vegomer lezaracha" vegomer, "vayyera Adonai el vegomer ani el shadday" (Bereshit 17:1).
Od tzarich ladaat ma neemar leavraham binvua zo. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (bava metzia 86:) ki ba levakkero mikkeev milato, ella shello huzkar remez ledavar ze bakkatuv.

Venire ki kavvanat hakkatuv hu shebba lehodia shehishra Adonai shechinato alav venaasa merkava lashshechina, vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 47:6) shehaavot merkava lashshechina. vehu amro vayyera elav Adonai sheggilla Adonai shechinato elav, velaze hikdim tevat "elav" lehazekarat Adonai lomar shennitgallet alav hashshechina, ma shello nishma beamro "vayyera Adonai elav" ki Adonai yafsik ben haggilluy lammitgalle bo, vehaven. velaze timtza shello neemar od "vayyera" bechol hannevuot hanneemarot leavraham achare zot ella "vayyomer Adonai", ki matzuy hu lefanav atara lerosho.

Od yirtze lomar ki achar shemmal avraham, az nigla bivsaro yod reshimu kaddisha (tanchuma tzav), vehu amro vayyera elav Adonai, vehu maamar hazzohar (Zohar 1:95) veze leshono: vechol man desharya beh reshima kaddisha sharya beh shechinta.

Od yirtze ki beemtzaut hammila nira Adonai elav bishlemut kelalut or elyon, ki yesh bivchinat reiyya 7 haderagot zo lemala mizzo, uma shehissig achar hammila hi nevua shelema. veze hodianu hakkatuv beamro vayyera elav Adonai, velo amar "vayyera Adonai elav", shennitkavven lomar ki ma shehiggia mehariyya elav hi kol bechinat havaya shem hannichbad, velaze hikdim "elav" veachar kach hizkir hammussag, ma shello haya nishma im haya makdim lehazekir hashshem kodem sheyyazkir tevat "elav", vedok:

Od yirtze lomar vayyera elav – perush: letzarko shel avraham ba haelohim, vechan ramaz ma sheamru zichronam livracha levakkero. veze leshon rabbotenu bemassechet bava metzia (86:): amar rabbi chama bar chanina yom shelishi lemilato haya uva Adonai veshaal bo, ad kan leshono. vetzarich ladaat tamo mi higgid lo ki yom shelishi haya, veim mimma sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 34:25) "bayyom hashshelishi bihyotam" vegomer, vahalo middivre rabbotenu bemassechet shabbat (daf 134) mashma beferush ki yom rishon vesheni hu mesukkan yoter miyyom shelishi. vahagam shechillek sham ben gadol lekatan, shehaggadol lo salik bisra hayyay, ze davka leinyan yom hashshelishi, aval yom rishon vesheni lakkol hu mesukkan beyoter miyyom hashshelishi.

Veal yikshe lecha mibbene yaakov shello bau al hachalalim beyom rishon vesheni, ki sham lo natnu lev lazzeman hammesukkan bo yoter, ella lazzeman shehem chalushim yoter shello yaamdu kenegdan, uveerech ze yom shelishi hem yoter chalushim bo miyyom rishon vesheni. aval beinyan habbikkur, kevan sheyyom rishon vesheni hem bechozek hassakkana yoter miyyom shelishi, ulefachot shavim elav, mi yomar ki lo ba hakkadosh baruch hu bayyamim harishonim. veraiti begirsat hattur (tur, yore dea 335, Adonai) shello katav yom shelishi, ella melammed shebba hakkadosh baruch hu levakker et hachole, ella battalmud shellefanenu garsinan yom shelishi vechulei:

Vehinne lefi ma shekkatav haran ki yom rishon hu hammesukkan veyom shelishi, aval yom sheni heela sheen mechallelin alav hashshabbat, yesh taam baddavar. kevan deyom sheni en bo michush sakkana, dan bo Adonai mishpat shalosh shaot rishonot shebbayyom sheen mevakkerin bahem, veyom rishon gam ken lo bikkero mittaam ma sheamru bindarim (daf 40.) veze leshono: rava yoma kamma dechalish amar lehu la tegallu leinish ki hechi dela litra mazzaleh, uferesh Rashi ki hechi dela lishtae mille illaveh, ad kan. vehu hattaam shello amar rav chama shebbikkero Adonai beyom rishon kede shello yishtau vechulei, uma gam bevo melech gadol avvsha milleta befirsum kol haolamot. vahagam sheamru birushalmi defea (perek 3) ki hakkerovim nichnasim miyyad levakkero, ufesako maharik siman 335 yeuyyan sham devarav, vehattaam hu ki hakkerovim la avvsha milleta, vechen katvu haacharonim, en lehakeshot ki Adonai elohenu karov lanu meod, sheal kol panim yeshno befirsum veavvsha milleta. ella lisvarat haomer sheen hefresh bo ben yom rishon veyom sheni vechullan mesukkanim miyyom shelishi, tzarich ladaat lamma amar yom shelishi, veulay ki hassovrim ken gorsim kegirsat hattur.

rashi: Vattashkena vegomer. yayin nizdammen lahen bammeara lehotzi mehen shene ummot:

Vattishkav et aviha. uvatztzeira chetiv vattishkav immo? tzeira, lefi shello patcha viznut ella achotah limmedatta chasach aleha hakkatuv velo peresh genutah; aval bechira sheppatcha viznut pirsemah hakkatuv bimforash.
Uvekumah. shel bechira nakud, lomar, shebbekumah yada, veaappche lo nishmar layil sheni millishtot. amar rabbi levi kol mi shehu lahut achar bulemus shel arayot lassof maachilim oto mibbesaro:
Chatanav. shete vanot nesuot hayu lo bair:
Lokche benotav. sheotan shebbabbayit arusot lahem:

Vayyomru elav. nakud al 17 shebbeelav, vetanya rashi ben elazar omer kol makom shekketav rabbe al hannekudda, atta doresh hakketav; vechan hannekudda rabba al hakketav atta doresh hannekudda, sheaf lesara shaalu ayyo avraham, lamadnu sheyyishal adam beachsanya shello laish al haishsha velaishsha al haish. bevava metzia omrim yodim hayu malache hashsharet sara immenu hechan hayta, ella lehodia shetztzenua hayta, kede lechabbevah al baala. amar rabbi yose bar chanina, kede leshagger lah kos shel beracha:
Hinne vaohel. tzenua hi:
ohc: Vayyomru elav ayye vegomer. perush: leheyot shebbesora shebba aleha hammevasser haya levasser sara, veratzu legallot leavraham shellevasser lesara bau velo lo, laze amru lo ayye sara perush: sheeleha banu levasser, veheshiv avraham hinne hi baohel lishmoa kol asher tomru lah.

rashi: Vayhi kaasher hitu vegomer. unkelos tirgem ma shettirgem; veyesh leyashshevo od davar davur al afnav, keshehotziani hakkabba mibbet avi lihyot meshotet venad mimmakom lemakom, yadati sheeevor bimkom reshaim vaomar lah ze chasdech:

Kaasher hitu. leshon rabbim. veal titma, ki harebe mekomot leshon elohut uleshon marut karuy bilshon rabbim, asher halchu elohim (Shmuel 2 7), elohim chayyim (Devarim Adonai), elohim kedoshim (Yehoshua 24), vechol leshon adnut leshon rabbim; vechen vayyikkach adone yosef (Bereshit 39), vaadone haadonim (Devarim 10), adone haaretz (Bereshit 42), vechen bealav immo (Shemot 22), vehuad bivalav (sham 21). veim tomar mahu leshon hitu? kol haggole mimmekomo veeno meyushshav karuy toe, kemo vattelech vatteta (Bereshit 21), taiti kese oved (Tehillim 119), yitu livli ochel (Iyov 38) – yetzu veyitu levakkesh achlam:
Imri li. alay, vechen vayyishalu anshe hammakom leishto (Bereshit 26), al ishto, vechen veamar paro livne yisrael (Shemot 14), kemo al bene yisrael; pen yomru li ishsha haragathu (Shoftim 9):
ohc: Vayhi kaasher vegomer. kan ba latet taam lidvaro harishon sheamar "en yirat elohim", ki yomar elav avimelech: ma raita bammakom shechashadta otam sheen lahem yirat elohim? laze amar ki takkana zo shettikken lomar "achoti" – lo lesibbat hammakom hahu levad, ella bederech kelal tikken ze lachashash makom sheen bo yirat elohim, vesafek ze lo yatzta mimmennu gerar, shehagam sheen lah chezkat "en yirat elohim", yode sheen leavraham bah chazaka sheyyesh bah yirat elohim. umeatta nistattemu taanot avimelech.

rashi: Vayyasuru elav. ikkemu et hadderech letzad beto:
Umatztzot afa. pesach haya:
ohc: Vayyaas lahem mishte umatztzot vegomer. perush ki hu asa mishte lichvodam, aval hem lo achlu ella mehammatztzot, ki lot lo kiyyem hattora keavraham, laze lo ratzu leechol mizzivche mishtehu kemo sheachlu mibben habbakar asher asa avraham, zulat mehammatztzot. veyodim hayu hammalachim shehotzi terumotav umaasrotav. o leheyot sheadayin lo hayu kohanim baolam, naasu hem kohanim veachlu teruma aval lo tevel. ulefi divre chachamenu zichrono livracha (midrash haggadol) yom 16 benisan haya veheechilam matztzot, veleheyot shetztzerichin shemira hutzrach leefotam beyado leshamram, vehu amro umatztzot afa:

rashi: Hachazek bammusar al teref. echoz battora, kemo "vehachaziki et yadech bo" (Bereshit 21:18), "vayyishlach yado vayyachazek bo" (Shemot 4:4):
targum: Titchazak bemarduta vela tirpe netarya metul dehi chayach:

rashi: Umishshoat. keshettavo al harshaim:
targum: La tidchal min dachalaya umin shilya umin chaysa derashie kad yete:

ohc: Ki mashchitim vegomer. hagam sheen mashchit ella echad, letzad shehayu shenehem yachad hayu omrim leshon rabbim, shello yihye nire ki ma shellefanav eno ella shammash bealma.
O efshar sheal gavriel hu omer hu utzevao, o letzad sheen gavriel yachol laasot davar ad sheyyotzi refael et lot, hare sheggam refael gorem raa lisdom veen bedavar ze shete shelichuyot.

rashi: Pen tidbakani haraa. keshehayiti etzel anshe sedom haya hakkabba roe maasay umaase vene hair, vehayiti nire tzaddik ucheday lehinnatzel, uchesheavo etzel tzaddik ani cherasha, vechen amra hatztzarfit leeliyyahu bata elay lehazekir et avoni (Melachim 1 17), ad shelo vata etzli haya hakkabba roe maasay umaase ammi, vaani tzaddeket benehem, umishshebbata etzli, lefi maasecha ani reshaa:

Vesaadu libbechem. battora, vanneviim uvakketuvim matzinu defitta saadata delibba. battora vesaadu libbechem, banneviim sead libbecha pat lechem (Shoftim 19), bakketuvim velechem levav enosh yisad (435 104). amar rabbi chama, levavchem en ketiv kan ella libbechem, maggid sheen yetzer hara sholet bammalachim (Bereshit Rabba):
Achar taabaverav. achar ken telchu:
Ki al ken avartem. ki haddavar hazze ani mevakkesh mikkem meachar sheavartem alay lichvodi:

Ki al ken. kemo al asher, vechen kol ki al ken shebbammikra, ki al ken bau betzel korati (Bereshit 19), ki al ken raiti fanecha (Bereshit 33:10), ki al ken lo netattiha (sham 38), ki al ken yadata chanotenu (Bamidbar 10):
ohc: Ki al ken vegomer. perush, kede shello yomru ech mazminam leechol achar shehikkir bahem heyotam mesharte elyon. ki hagam shepperashnu sheyyechavven bidvarav el haruchaniyyut, im kol ze happeshat eno neekar, vegam bammaachol yesh sodot muflaim kaamur (Mishlei 13:25) "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho" lifnimiyyut haruchaniyyut. laze amar lahem ki vegomer, perush ki taam lidvaray al ken avartem, perush ken beseder ze bidmut anashim sheyyeshnam bammazon haggashmi gam ken. vayyomru ken, perush ken hu kidvarav, sheal ken avru alav bidmut anashim, vehiskimu elav laasot kaasher dibber. od ramzu lo sheyyaase kadderech haamur bidvarav lehateimam ruchaniyyut hannaot lahem karamuz bidvarav kemo shepperashti.

rashi: Bayyom hashshelishi. lama echar milleharoto miyyad? kede shello yomru hamamo veirbevo pitom vetaraf dato, veilu haya lo shahut lehimmalech el libbo lo haya ose:
Vayyar et hammakom. raa anan kashur al hahar:
Erda na. limmed laddayyanim shelo yifseku dine nefashot ella viriyya, hakkol kemo shepperashti vefarashat happallaga. davar acher, erda na lesof maasehem:
Hakketzaakatah. shel medina:

Habbaa elay asu. vechen omdim bemirdam, kala ani ose vahem, veim lo yaamdu vemirdan eda ma eese lehippara mehen beyissurin velo achalle otan. vechayyotze vo matzinu bemakom acher, veatta hored edyecha mealecha veeda ma eese lach (Shemot 33); ulefichach yesh hefsek nekuddat pesik ben asu lechala, kede lehaferid teva mechavertah. verabbotenu darshu hakketzaakatah – tzaakat riva achat shehargu mita meshunna al shennatna mazon leani, kammeforash bechelek:
ohc: Erda na vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro leshon yerida, veod lamma yitztarech Adonai laredet, vahalo kol haolam kegargir shel chardal lefanav, veod amro hakketzaakatah vegomer vechi haadon baruch hu yistappek bidia? verashi zichrono livracha peresh ki lelammed ba shello yifseku bet din lematta mishpat ella biraya. vekashe lidvarav lamma lo hispik laze ma sheamar hakkatuv befarashat dor happallaga dichtiv (Bereshit 11:5) "vayyered Adonai" vegomer, umatzinu lerashi atzmo shepperesh ken sham?

Achen hakkavvana hi ki hodia Adonai hasseder asher yitnaheg bo im hannivraim letzad hachesed veharachamim. hinne shurat haddin notenet ki hakkol kefi hammevayyesh vehammitbayyesh, uchesheyyaavor haadam al achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai veyamre pi elyon letzad maalat hael haggadol, yitchayyev leheaved hu vechol sevivav, ki et hammelech Adonai tzevaot hichis vechol shehu mehahamraa yitchayyev aleha. veyachshov haadam ki haadon yadin et olamo bemishpat ze vehu mishpat tzedek, uleolam im yavo Adonai bemishpat bederech toen venitan lehishshafet im hannivraim efshar shello yitchayyevu, vegam dor hammabbul efshar shello haya nishpat mishpat mavet. laze amar Adonai kan behodaat derachav el avraham erda na, perush: lo yishpot beerech maalato ella behashevaa lannivraim, kederech amro hannavi (Yeshayahu 43:26) "nishshafta yachad" behashevaa lannivraim happechutim, uveerech ze yishpot veyire im hu beerech hatztzeaka shebbaa elay. perush: ki hatztzoek vetovea mishpat meAdonai yitba hammishpat lefi erech gedullat habbore. laze amar Adonai: veim achar sheaarich hammishpat beerech shelilat maalati adayin shiur shettihye teviat middat haddin lechayyevam – kala, veim lo – edaa im reuyim lishpot bederech zo o lo. umeatta en perush erda na ella haderaga baddin, uleolam mimmekomo yashkif ladaat veyavchin levavot bene adam.

Od yirtze shehagam shetztzaakatam baa, im kol ze ratza lehavechin bahem im beet hammishpat lo chazru vahem veodam machazikim berisham, velaze shalach hammalachim bidmut anashim baale tzura vetoar yafe livchon bahem, vehu amro erda na perush atta veere hakketzaakatah asu od kala, veim lo vegomer, vehem harshaim ketzaakatam asu sheratzu laasot od maase bilti hagun, velaze techef umiyyad hechlitu hammalachim veamru lelot (Bereshit 19:13) "mashchitim anachnu" vegomer, aval kodem lachen lo amru kelum. ha lamadta im lo hayu mevakshim lishloach yad bammalachim, efshar shehaya Adonai ose lahem arichut zeman bemiddat erech appayim. veulay naga Adonai bedin ze middin moredet sheamru bichtubbot (daf 63:) sheafilu achar sheavru arba shabbatot behacheraza, bishat gemar din modiin otah ulay tashuv, velaze shalach Adonai hammalachim bidmut anashim al daat shello yashchitu ad sheyyiru vahem ki odam berisham. velaze samach pasuk "vayyifnu mishsham" vegomer leerda na" vehaven:

rashi: Varech avarechcha. achat laav veachat labben:
Vehareba arbe. achat laav veachat labben:

Ki yedativ. leshon chibba, kemo moda leishah (Rut 2), halo voaz modatanu (sham 3), vaedaacha beshem (Shemot 33). veamnam ikkar leshon kullam eno ella leshon yedia, shehamechabbev et haadam mekarvo etzlo veyodo umakkiro, velamma yedativ?
Lemaan asher yetzavve. lefi shehu metzavve et banav alay lishmor derachay. veim tefarshehu chetargumo, yodea ani vo sheyyetzavve et banav vegomer, en lemaan nofel al hallashon:
Yetzavve. leshon hove, chemo kacha yaase iyyov (Iyov 1):
Lemaan havi. kach hu metzavve levanav, shimru derech Adonai kede sheyyavi Adonai al avraham vegomer; al bet avraham lo neemar ella al avraham, lamadnu, kol hammaamid ben tzaddik keilu eno met:
Bekirbah. mistakkelet bemeeha veamra efshar hakkeravayim hallalu teunin valad? hashshadayim hallalu shetztzamku moshchin chalav? tanchuma:
Edna. tzichtzuach basar, uleshon mishna mashshir et hassear umeadden et habbasar. davar acher leshon iddan; zeman veset niddut:

ohc: Vayyomer avimelech. leheyot sheppasuk rishon hu tochacha vekavlanut, vedibbur ze hu sheela ladaat tamo, ki vadday lo nitkavven lehara ella tamo kamus immo, laze yiched amira bifne atzmo sheshshealo "ma raita" vegomer:

rashi: Avraham avraham. leshon chibba hu, shekkofel et shemo:
Mi millel leavraham. leshon shevach vachashivut, reu, mi hu vechamma hu shomer havetachato hakkabba mavtiach veose.
Millel. shinna hakkatuv velo amar dibber – gimatriyya shello 100, kelomar lesof mea leavraham:
Henika vanim sara. umahu vanim leshon rabbim? beyom hammishte heviu hassarot benehen immahen vehenika otam, shehayu omrot lo yalda sara, ello asufi hevia min hashshuk:

Vayyashov avraham biver shava. lo yeshiva mammash, shehare bechevron haya yoshev, 12 shanim lifne akedato shel yitzchak yatza mibbeer sheva vehalach lo lechevron, kemo shenneemar vayyagar avraham beeretz pelishtim yamim rabbim, merubbim mishshel chevron harishonim, vehem 26 shana, kemo shepperashnu lemala:
Vayyahafoch et hearim vegomer. arbatam yoshvot besela echad vahafachan milmala lematta, shenneemar bachallamish shalach yado vegomer (Iyov 20):
Hoalti. ratziti kemo vayyoel moshe (Shemot 2):
Veanochi afar vaefer. uchevar hayiti rauy lihyot afar al yede hammelachim, veefer al yede nimrod, lule rachamecha asher amdu li:
Hoalti. ratziti, kemo vayyoel moshe (Shemot 2):
ohc: Vayyomer hinne vegomer el adonay ulay vegomer. bikkesh sheyyagen Adonai bead esrim uzechuto shel avraham bead asara kishelato hakkodemet, velo amar "al yichar" keamro beshoolo im yimmatzun sheloshim shehem yoter meesrim, mittaam shello hosif davar bitfillato lehagen bizchuto yoter mimma sheshshaal kodem, velaze dikdek lomar el adonay perush ki tefillato hi letzad haganat haadon baruch hu sheyyagen bead esrim.

rashi: Terem yishkavu veanshe hair anshe sedom. kach nidrash bivra terem yishkavu veanshe hair hayu befihem shel malachim, shehayu shoalim lelot ma tivam umaasehem vehu omer lahem rubbam reshaim; odam medabberim bahem veanshe sedom vegomer. ufeshuto shel mikra veanshe hair anshe resha, nasabbu al habbayit; al shehayu reshaim nikraim anshe "sedom", kemo sheamar hakkatuv veanshe sedom raim vechattaim:
Kol haam mikkatze. mikketze hair ad hakkatze, sheen echad mehem moche veyadam, sheafillu tzaddik echad en bahem:
ohc: Terem yishkavu. velo amar "achar achlam veanshe" vegomer, maggid shehaya devarim benehem baemtza, vehu amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 50:5) shehaya lot melitz tov bead sedom. vetaam shello hafchu sedom az techef umiyyad, kevar perashti (Bereshit 18:21) ki hem adayin odam besafek hatztzala, keamro "erda na veere". vechen gam ken amru bammidrash (Bereshit Rabba 50:5) veze leshonam: haya lot mevakkesh rachamim al sedom vehayu mekabbelim mimmennu, vechevan sheamru "hotziem vegomer veneda" vegomer amru lo "od" vegomer. od taam shello hishchitu sedom beotah shaa, shehimtinu ad hashekamat habboker kede sheyyihye zeman hameyuchad lerachamim lehatztzil et lot, ma sheen ken ballayla shettigboret haddinim lo yimmalet lot. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bereshit Rabba 50:5) lefi shehayu ovdim lachamma velallevana, hilku otam leene hashshemesh vehayyareach beyom 16 benisan.

Hinnecha met al vegomer. perush: chayyav atta mita asher lakachta vehi vechulei, perush achar sheani modiacha shehi beulat baal. aval im lo hodio, hagam shehaya ose maase, lo yitchayyev mita, ki ben noach shebba al eshet ish beshogeg bechashvo ki hi penuya patur, uchemo shekkatav rambam beferek 10 mehilchot melachim.

Od yisbol hakkatuv al ze hadderech: hinnecha met vegomer asher lakachta vehi beulat baal – perush, hagam sheyyadata shehi beulat baal, uchefi ze yitchayyev kefi haddin. ella sheachar haemet mehaamur bainyan nire ki lo yada shehi beulat baal.

rashi: Al tacharosh al reacha. al tachshov. veeno zaz mimmashmaut charisha: ma derech hachoresh – mechin makom lizman hazzeria, af hachoshev raa mechin makom tachbulot belibbo, ech yaamod veyaasenna:
targum: La techashev al chavrach bishta vehu yatev imach beshalva:
