rashi: Hayippale. ketargumo hayitkassi? vechi shum davar mufla umufrad umechusse mimmenni millaasot kirtzoni:
Lammoed. leoto moed hameyuchad shekkavati lecha etmol, lammoed hazze bashshana haacheret:
ohc: Lammoed ashuv vegomer. taam shechazar lomar hahavtacha, leval yachshov avraham ki letzad hakepadat Adonai al sara yashuv Adonai middevaro hattov asher dibber elav, laze amar elav ki havetachato yishmor kaet chayya vegomer:

rashi: Vayyashkifu. kol hashekafa shebbammikra leraa chutz mehashekifa mimmeon kadshecha (Devarim 26), sheggadol koach mattenot aniyyim shehofech middat harogez lerachamim:
Leshallecham. lelauotam; kassavur orchim hem:
Minneged. merachok:

Kimtachave keshet. kishte tichot (Bereshit Rabba), vehu leshon yeriyyat chetz, bilshon mishna shehetiach veishto, al shem shehazzera yore kachetz; veim tomar haya lo lichtov kimtache keshet, mishpat havvav likkanes lechan, kemo bechagve hassela (Shir HaShirim 2), miggizrat vehayta admat yehuda lemitzrayim lechagga (Yeshayahu 19), umiggizrat yachoggu veyanuu kashshikkor (Tehillim 107), vechen katzve eretz (Tehillim 65), miggizrat katze:
Vatteshev minneged. kevan shekkarav lamut hosifa lehitrachek:
Ulesara amar. avimelech lichvodah kede lefayyesah, hinne asiti lach kavod ze, natatti mamon leachich sheamart alav achi hu, hinne hammamon vehakkavod hazze lach kesut enayim:

Lechol asher ittach. yechassu enehem shello yekilluch, sheillu hashivotich rekanit, yesh lahem lomar leachar shennitallal bah hechezirah; achshav shehutzrachti levazbez mamon ulefayyesech, yodim yihyu sheal karchi hashivotich veal yede nes:
Veet kol. veim kol bae olam:

Venochachat. yehi lach pitchon pe lehitvakkeach uleharot devarim nikkarim hallalu; uleshon hochacha bechol makom berur devarim 115 asheparevabeyr, veunkelos tirgem befanim acherim, uleshon hammikra kach hu nofel al hattargum, hinne lach kesut shel kavod al haenayim shelli sheshshaltu bach uvechol asher ittach, veal ken tirgemo vachazet yatich veyat kol deimmach. veyesh mia aval yishshuv leshon hammikra perashti:
Himmalet al nafshecha. dayyecha lehatztzil nefashot, al tachus al hammamon:
Al tabbit acharecha. atta hirshata immahem uvizchut avraham atta nitztzal; encha keday lirot befuranutam veatta nitztzal:
Bechol hakkikkar. kikkar hayyarden:

Hahara himmalet. etzel avraham berach, shehu yoshev bahar, shenneemar vayyatek mishsham hahara (Bereshit 12), veaf achshav haya yoshev sham, shenneemar el hammakom asher haya sham oholo battechilla, veaappi shekkatuv vayyeehal avraham vegomer (sham 13), ohalim harebe hayu lo venimshechu ad chevron:

Himmalet. leshon hashemata, vechen kol hamelata shebbammikra 647 109 vechen vehimlita zachar (Yeshayahu 66), shennishmat haubbar min harechem, ketzippor nimleta (Tehillim 124), lo yachlu mallet massa (Yeshayahu 46), lehashemit massa hari shebbenikvehem:
ohc: Al tabbit acharecha vegomer. hattaam letzad ki hakkarat pene haadam taane bo ma paal, laze lo yachzir panav lemul hair, ki sham hammashchitim veyakkiru bo siman hattiuv, veen lo zechut lehinnatzel mehem. vetze ulemad ma alta leishto.

rashi: Vehinne shelosha anashim. echad levasser et sara veechad lahafoch et sedom veechad lerappeot et avraham, sheen malach echad ose shete shelichuyyot (Bereshit Rabba). teda lecha, shekken kol happarasha hu mazkiran bilshon rabbim vayyochelu, vayyomru elav, uvabbesora neemar vayyomer shov ashuv elecha, uvahafichat sedom hu omer ki lo uchal laasot davar levilti hafki, urefael sherippe et avraham halach mishsham lehatztzil et lot; hu shenneemar vayhi chehotziam otam hachutza vayyomer himmalet al nafshecha, lamadta shehaechad haya matztzil (Bereshit Rabba):
Nitztzavim alav. lefanav, aval lashon nekiyya hu kelappe hammalachim:

Vayyar. mahu vayyar vayyar shete feamim? harishon kemashmao vehashsheni leshon havana, nistakkel shehayu nitztzavim bemakom echad vehevin shello hayu rotzim lehatericho, veaf al pi sheyyodim hayu sheyyetze likratam amdu vimkomam lechvodo, lehareoto shello ratzu lehatericho, vekadam hu veratz likratam, bevava metzia, chetiv nitztzavim alav, uchetiv vayyaratz likratam? kad chazyuhu dahava share veasar pershu hemennu, miyyad vayyaratz likratam:
ohc: Vayyissa enav vegomer. tzarich lanu ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar vehinne, gam lamma hutzrach lomar nitztzavim – min hassetam nitztzavim hayu, uma yatza lanu mehodaa zo? od amro alav en lah mashmaut, veim lomar shessemuchim elav, yachchish ze amro "vayyaratz likratam". od kashe amro paam sheniyya "vayyar" velo hispik barishona. od leeze inyan hishtachava laorchim avraham kodem yado mehem ki malachim hayu, velamma lo chash learviyyim vechulei?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu lefi ma shennitgalla besof hainyan ki malachim hayu, uvau bidmut anashim lehitachsen etzel avraham lesibbot yeduot. laze amar vayyar vehinne vegomer, perush: ma shehu nire hu anashim veenam ken, veim haya omer "vayyar shelosha anashim" yihye dover shekarim chas veshalom.

Veamro nitztzavim lomar, ki avraham lehakkarato bimsharte elyon hikkir bahem shehayu memunnim al davar, perush: hikkir bahem shehayu sheluchim el avraham letzarko, kemo shekken haya – echad lerappeoto, veechad levasser "kaet chayya" vegomer, veechad, hagam shehaya holech lahafoch et sedom, af al pi chen lechibbat avraham haya omed meukkav millechet ad asher dibber Adonai elav vehaya ma shehaya, veaz pana vehalach lo. hare ki kol haamadato hayta alav.

Od yirmoz al ze hadderech: anashim nitztzavim perush omdim bidmut anashim, alav perush al sibbato letzorech hachenasat orchim, vehikkir bahem ki malache elohim hem ki tzurat hammalach lo titallem. vetze ulemad meeshet manoach (Shoftim 13:13) umikkol shekken avraham shemmakkiram haya lesheavar. veamro vayyar haya nire lomar sheriyya zo shenit hi hakkaratam heyotam malachim, ella sheen tzorech laze uchevar ramaz hakkatuv shehikkiram, ella shemmodia hakkatuv shebbiriyya sheraa otam nitrappe mimmachovo veamad veratz likratam, ki hammalach yerae merachok, veen hevdel livchinat haruchaniyyut limnoa harfua, vetechef umiyyad asa shelichuto refael vayrappeehu. uletzad haregasha zo vayyishtachu artza limsharte elyon.

rashi: Petach. hu hechalal shebbo nichnasin veyotzin:
Bassanverim. makkat ivvaron:
Mikkaton vead gadol. hakketannim hitchilu baavera techilla, shenneemar minnaar vead zaken, lefechach hitchila happuranut mehem (Bereshit Rabba):

Lammoed asher dibber oto. di mallil yate, et hammoed dibber vekava kesheamar lo lammoed ashuv elecha (sham 18), sarat lo serita bakkotel, amar lo keshettaggia chamma lisrita zo bashshana haacheret, teled:
ohc: Vattahar vatteled sara leavraham ben. amar "vattahar" yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 53:5) bet matrin lo haya lah, laze modia ki haya nes gam baherayon. veamro leavraham ramaz ben ze leavraham velo yishmael leavraham, ki lo yikkare shemo ben avraham, dichtiv (Bereshit 21:12) "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara". vahagam shemmatzinu sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 16:15) "vatteled hagar leavram ben", sham nikra shemo avram, aval achar shenneekar shem avram shello yizzacher od shem ze alav ella avraham, yishmael en lo likkare ben avraham. veulay ki laze hakkore leavraham avram over baase (berachot 13), taam hakepadato yitbarach ki kesheyyikkare lo avram meyaches elav yishmael leven, vaAdonai amar "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara", veen ze ella kesheyyeaker shem avram. vetaam ze eno beyaakov, laze hagam shennikra yisrael en kefeda sheyyikkare yaakov. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Bereshit 35:10) "lo yikkare" vegomer vetimtza taam acher:

Lizkunav. taam hahodaa, gam amro lizkunav velo amar leziknato, lema shekkatavnu ki haya chaser beet halleda nefesh meolam haelyon leholid, velo hayta lo ella mealma denukeba. yechavven hakkatuv ki yalda az, vegam yalda bo hachanat leda acheret lezikna shenit shel avraham, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki min hahechlet hu lehassig adam baolam hazze davar chadash im lo yakdim hachanat hamekabbel, kayyadua lechachme emet. veim lo hayta leyitzchak ella hannefesh shemmealma denukeba vehaya chaser hachanat hakkabbalat nefesh mealma didchura, lo toil lo haakeda. veze hu sheddikdek lomar vatteled vegomer, hodia sheyyalda lishne zemanne ziknato: ha hu et ledato, vehav hi hachana leet zikna acheret shel avraham shehu zeman haakeda.
O yirmoz lizkunav – ziknato veziknat ishto, al derech amro "achare veloti vegomer vadoni zaken" (Bereshit 18:12).

rashi: Baavur tihye li. zot:
Leeda. leshon edut shel nekeva, kemo veeda hammatztzeva (Bereshit 31):
Ki chafarti et habbeer. merivim hayu aleha roe avimelech veomrim anachnu chafarnuha, amru benehem kol mi sheyyitrae al habbeer veyaalu hammayim likrato, shello hi, vealu likrat avraham:

Eshel. rav ushemuel, chad amar pardes lehavi mimmenu perot laorchim basseuda, vechad amar pundak leachsanya uvo kol mine perot. umatzinu leshon netia beohalim, shenneemar veyitta ohole appadno (Daniel 11):

Vayyikra sham vegomer. al yede oto eshel nikra shemo shel hakkabba eloah lechol haolam, leachar sheochlim veshotim omer lahem barchu lemi sheachaltem mishshello, sevurim attem shemmishshelli achaltem? mishshel mi sheamar vehaya haolam achaltem (sota 10):
Ki yare lashevet betzoar. lefi shehayta kerova lisdom:

Hammaachelet. sakkin, al shem sheochelet et habbasar, kema detema vecharbi tochal basar (Devarim 32), veshemmachsheret basar laachila. davar acher zot nikret maachelet al shem sheyyisrael ochlim mattan secharah:
Vayyelchu shenehem yachdav. avraham shehaya yodea sheholech lishchot et beno haya holech beratzon vesimcha keyitzchak, shello haya margish baddavar:
Veshachavta vearva shenatecha. vetinam shenatcha keshettishan, shello tira mippachad pitom:
targum: Im tishkov vetidmuch la tidchal vetishkav vetivsam shintach:

rashi: Ulay yimmatzun sham arbaim. veyimmaltu 4 hakkerakkim vechen 30 yatztzilu 3 mehem o 20 yatztzilu 2 mehem o 10 yatztzilu echad mehem:
ohc: Vayyosef od ledabber elav. taam amro "vayyosef", gam amro tevat "elav". perush: hosif lehitpallel baggeder harishon atzmo shehaadon hu hammashlim, ella sheyyihye hatztzeruf beminyan hakkerachim ki hu yashlim kerach echad mehem, velaze diyyek lomar elav ki hahagana zo hu bahaganato yitbarach.

rashi: Vayyissa mishsham avraham. kesheraa shecharvu hakkerakkim ufasku haovrim vehashshavim, nasa lo mishsham. davar acher lehitrachek millot, sheyyatza alav shem ra, shebba al benotav:

Achar haddevarim haelle. yesh merabbotenu omrim (sanhedrin 89) achar devarav shel satan, shehaya mekatreg veomer mikkol seuda sheasa avraham lo hikriv lefanecha par echad o ayil echad; amar lo kelum asa ella bishvil beno, illu hayiti omer lo zevach oto lefanay lo haya meakkev; veyeo achar devarav shel yishmael, shehaya mitpaer al yitzchak shemmal ben 13 shana velo micha, amar lo yitzchak beever 1 atta meyareni? illu amar li hakkabba zevach atzmecha lefanay, lo hayiti meakkev.
Hinneni. kach hi aniyyatam shel chasidim, leshon anava hu uleshon zimmun:
ohc: Vayhi achar haddevarim vegomer. perush haddevarim haamurim lemala mehainyan, shekkamma harepatke sheavru alav ad shennifkad beven leet ziknato, vegam hivticho Adonai "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara", veachar shehaya yitzchak gadol keamro "vayyagar avraham beeretz pelishtim yamim rabbim", uveshana rishona sheyyarad liflishtim nolad yitzchak, ha lamadta ki gadol haya. uveemtzaut hakkodem yihye godel hannissayon mufla, ben bivchinat avraham sheachar kamma harepatke kadmu lo ad shennifkad, veachar kamma havetachot meAdonai ki beyitzchak yikkare zaro, hu omer lo sheyyakrivehu velo hirher belibbo, ben bivchinat yitzchak shehagam shehaya gadol kannishma mippasuk hassamuch "vayyagar" vegomer ha lamadta sheggadol haya velo ikkev. gam nitkavven lomar achar haddevarim shebbaze yutzdak lomar lo "et bincha et yechidcha" velo kodem haddevarim hanneemarim besamuch, shehare haya lo yishmael veeno yechido.
Vehaelohim nissa vegomer. amar "vehaelohim" betosefet vav vetosefet hei, lomar millevad nisyonot shekkadmuhu, hosif lenassoto bigvurat haddin nissayon atzum.
Vayyomer elav avraham. taam hakkeria, lehodio kodem ki ba haelohim lishol mimmennu davar gadol, vehevin avraham veamar elav hinneni, perush hareni muchan lechol asher tomar elay:

rashi: VaAdonai pakad et sara vegomer. samach parasha zo lelammedcha, shekkol hamevakkesh rachamim al chavero vehu tzarich leoto davar, hu naane techilla (bava kamma 92), shenneemar vayyitpallel vegomer, usemich leh vaAdonai pakad et sara, sheppekadah kevar kodem sherippe et avimelech:
Pakad et sara kaasher amar. beherayon:

Kaasher dibber. beleda. vehechan hi amira, vehechan hu dibbur? amira vayyomer elohim aval sara ishtecha vego '(Bereshit 17), dibbur haya devar Adonai el avram bivrit ben habbetarim, vesham neemar lo yirashcha ze vegomer (sham 15), vehevi hayyoresh missara:
Vayyaas Adonai lesara kaasher dibber. leavraham:
ohc: VaAdonai pakad vegomer kaasher amar. perush: lo letzad shehitpallel al avimelech umittaam kol hammitpallel al chavero vechulei, vezulat ze lo haya nifkad, veze yemaet chas veshalom hahavtacha sheamura bitchillat happarasha, ella kaasher amar.

Od leolam, ki tefillato al avimelech hu davar hammaamid lifkidat sara, vehavetachato yitbarach hayta sheyyitten lo ben, vehizmin lo hashshem mitzva shessegullatah sheyyippaked, uvaze nitkayyema havetachato. vehu amro kaasher amar, perush: uletzad haamira sheamar hashshem hu shennizdammen lo haddavar venifkeda, ki kesheyyirtze hashshem lehetiv yazmin hammitzva shessegullatah hi hattova hamevukkeshet. vetimtza shekkodem havetachat happekida kevar nizdammen leavraham maase paro shehu bedome lemaase avimelech, velo atzaro hashshem lefaro kede sheyyitpallel alav avraham, veze lecha haot lema shepperashnu.

Vayyaas Adonai vegomer kaasher dibber. taam shekkafal lomar "vayyaas" vegomer, yechavven lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma) befasuk "kaet chayya", shessarat lah hammalach serita bakkotel kesheyyaggia hashshemesh lemakom ze ulesara ben, vehu shehodia hakkatuv shennitkayyem maamar hammalach haddover eleha bedikduk hazzeman.

Od yechavven hakkatuv al pi ma shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 18:10) "ben lesara ishtecha" shebba mitztzad hannekeva, ulesibba zo hutzrach laakeda. veyadua hu ki zo hi sibbat mitat sara, ulefi ma shekkatavti ki hikpid Adonai al tzechikat sara vekiyyem haggezera shello teled sara ella ben missitra denukeva, keamro (Bereshit 17:19) "aval sara ishtecha yoledet". laze amar vayyaas Adonai lesara kaasher dibber, veyadua hu ki haddibbur kashe, vehu shello yeladatto shalem bashshelemut hatztzarich, venitgalgelu haddevarim veniftera sara missibba zo. ulederech ze kiyyum hahavtacha al hasserita shessarat lah hammalach nirmeza bappasuk sheachare ze dichtiv "lammoed asher dibber oto" vegomer.

rashi: Lechem vechemat mayim. velo chesef vezahav, lefi shehaya sono al sheyyatza letarbut raa:
Veet hayyeled. af hayyeled sam al shichmah, shehichnisa vo sara ayin raa vaachazattu chamma velo yachol lelech beraglav (Bereshit Rabba):
Vattelech vatteta. chazra legillule vet aviha (pirki derabbi eliezer 80 30):
ohc: Al shichmah veet hayyeled. perush: gam oto sam al shichmah, leheyot shello haya rotze latzet mibbet aviv, laze akado keyeled vesamo al shichmah vegershah.

Beno hannolad lo asher vegomer. perush: leheyot sheyyesh lo ben acher shehu yishmael, laze amar "hannolad lo" ledavar hannaot lo lehikkarot alav letachlit taavato, ma shello amar hakkatuv ken beledat yishmael. veomer asher yalda lo sara, ramaz lema shehayu mitpallelin tamid: avraham haya omer, kol hazzera shelli yihye mitztzaddeket zo, vesara gam hi vechulei, keneged tefillatah amar "yalda lo", ucheneged tefillato amar "sara".
Od yirtze latet taam likriat shemo yitzchak, letzad sheyyalda hazzekena lazzaken, vechen hu omer (Bereshit 21:6) "tzechok asa li" vegomer:

rashi: Veavraham hayo yihye. mia: zecher tzaddik livracha, hoil vehizkiro – bercho. ufeshuto: vechi mimmennu ani maalim, vahare hu chaviv lefanay lihyot legoy gadol ulehitbarech bo kol goye haaretz.
ohc: Veavraham hayo yihye vegomer. perush, vetzarich ani lehodio maalat hatztzaddikim asher hatztzel yatztzilu atzman uvene iran, hefech mimma shechashav uchemo shekkatavnu besamuch, vehu amro yihye legoy gadol venivrechu vo kol goye haaretz sheyyagennu hem baadam, vetevat "bo" chozeret el "goy gadol".

Veim tomar: ma yoil hodaa zo laggoy habba acharav?, laze amar ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve vegomer, perush: yada Adonai avraham ki yishtaddel im banav lehetiv, laze modio lemaan yetzavve et banav veyodia otam maasav yitbarach, uvaze veshamru derech Adonai.

Veamro lemaan havi Adonai al avraham, kan hodia ki ikkar hachibbuv lo lezaro shel avraham, ella chibbat avraham hi haikkar, vechol machshevotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu hem lehavi al avraham asher dibber lehetiv oto veet zaro ad olam, ki im lo yishmeru derech Adonai lo yimtza hammetiv lehashelim havetachotav lidido lehetiv levanav.

rashi: Hatashchit bachamishsha. vahalo hen 9 lechol kerach, veatta tzaddiko shel olam titztaref immahem:
ohc: Ulay yachserun vegomer. perush, ki hu tzaddiko shel olam mitztaref laasara hatztzerichim lechol kerach ucherach.

rashi: Vayyaitzu. ketargumo udechiku – miharuhu:
Hannimtzaot. hamezummanot lecha babbayit lehatztzilam. umia yesh veze yishshuvo shel mikra:
Tissafe. tihye kale, ad tom kol haddor (Devarim 2) meturgam ad desaf kol dara:
Belechtecha lo yetzar tzaadecha. mi sheeno marchik raglav, karov lippol:
targum: Kad tezel la titteuk archach vein tirhat la titkal:

rashi: Al odot beno. sheshshama sheyyatza letarbut raa (Bereshit Rabba), ufeshuto al sheamra lo leshallecho:
ohc: Al odot beno. perush: leval yetze letarbut raa veyishtakka beemunot raot betzeto mibbet aviv, vesof kol sof beno hu.

Od yirtze al odot beno – asher yichasa oto sara lehagar, keamrah "haama veet benah vegomer ben haama". uva hakkadosh baruch hu vehitzdik divre sara veamar lo "kol asher vegomer shema bekolah", veal tachshov oto bincha. vehu amro al hannaar vegomer, akar lo shem beno veamar lo "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha" vegomer uven ze al shem immo yikkare, vehu amro vegam et ben haama vegomer. vetimtza shechazar avraham vehoda lidvareha, dichtiv "vayyashkem avraham vegomer veet hayyeled" vegomer velo amar "veet beno", ki heid hakkatuv al avraham.

Vayyomer al na yichar vegomer. taam shechash lacharon af, ki ratza sheyyagen hu vechash lehakepadat habbore veamar "al yichar" vegomer. vedikdek lomar na, perush: lema sheomer bappaam hazzot shemmevakkesh shezzechuto yagen ulay yimmatzun sheloshim, shehaadon yagen bead kerach echad veavraham bead kerach echad.

rashi: Ulay yimmatzun sham asara. al happachut lo vikkesh, amar dor hammabbul hayu 8, noach uvanav uneshehem, velo hitztzilu al doram; veal 9 al yede tzeruf kevar bikkesh velo matza:
ohc: Al na yichar vegomer ach happaam. kan higdil gam ken sheyyagen zechuto bead esrim, laze amar "al yichar", ki mitpallel sheyyagen zechuto, veod shehishva yad eved keyad rabbo, velaze timtza sheamar "vaadabbera" velo amar "el adonay", lomar ki tefilla zo hi bead zechuti. veamro tevat ach miet shello yachzor lehitpallel ulay yechsar echad mehaasara kemo sheshshaal ulay yechserun hachamishshim chamishsha. o letzad sheechad lo yeakkev kemo shemmatzinu sheamar Adonai (Devarim 25:3) "arbaim yakkennu" veatu rabbanan uvatzre chada (makkot 22:).

rashi: Vayyichlu hammayim. lefi shedderech cholim lishtot harebe:
Et kol hannaar. mikkan sheyyafa tefillat hachole mittefillat acherim alav vehi kodemet lehitkabbel (Bereshit Rabba):

Baasher hu sham. lefi maasim shehu ose achshav hu niddon, velo lefi ma shehu atid laasot (rosh hashshana 16), lefi shehayu malache hashsharet mekatregim veomrim ribbono shel olam, mi sheatid zaro lehamit banecha batztzama atta maale lo beer, vehu meshivam achshav ma hu, tzaddik o rasha? amru lo tzaddik, amar lahem lefi maasav shel achshav ani dano, vezehu baasher hu sham. vehechan hemit et yisrael batztzama? kesheheglam nevuchadnetztzar, shenneemar massa barav vegomer likrat tzame hetayu mayim vegomer (Yeshayahu 21), keshehayu molichin otam etzel arviyyim, hayu yisrael omrim leshovehem bevakkasha mikkem holichunu etzel bene dodenu yishmael virachamu alenu, shenneemar orchot dedanim (sham) – al tikre dedanim ella dodim – veellu yotzim likratam umeviin lahem basar vedag maluach venodot nefuchim, kisvurim yisrael shehem meleim mayim, ucheshemmachniso letoch piv ufotcho, haruach nichneset begufo umet:
Gam hiv. lerabbot avadim vegammalim vechammarim shellah, et kullam shaalti veamru li achiha hiv:
Betom levavi. shello dimmiti lachato:
Uvenikyon kappay. naki ani min hachet, shello nagati vah:
ohc: Veamro betam levavi vegomer. nitkavven lehashiv lachashashat shehi eshet ish uvalah hiv adam acher, uma hirviach beamro avraham aleha "achoti hi"? laze amar betam levavi vegomer, chashavti sheppenuya hi veen li mishpat mavet. veamro uvenikyon kappay nitkavven lishlol mishpat mavet middin gazel, deamrinan besanhedrin (sanhedrin 57.) ufesakah rambam beferek 9 veze leshono: ben noach chayyav al haggazel vechulei veechad haggozel vechulei o gonev nefesh, ad kan. velav davka gonev vehu haddin gozel, devifat toar neemar din gonev nefesh babberayta (sham), vifat toar gezula hi lo genuva, velirvuta katav rambam gonev, vechen katav hakkesef mishne. veim ken meet shellekachah avimelech nitchayyev mita, laze amar uvenikyon kappay ki birtzonam chashavti sheyyihye haddavar ulemaala techashev leachiha shennesaah melech.

rashi: Hael. kemo haelle:
Ki al ken bau. ki hattova hazzot taasu lichvodi al asher bau betzel korati; targum bitlal sharute, targum shel kora – sharuta:
Adonai yire. peshuto ketargumo, Adonai yivchar veyire lo et hammakom hazze lehasherot bo shechinato ulehakriv kan karbanot:
Asher yeamer hayyom. sheyyomru lime haddorot alav behar ze yerae hakkabba leammo:

Hayyom. hayyamim haatidin, kemo ad hayyom hazze shebbechol hammikra, shekkol haddorot habbaim hakkorim et hammikra hazze omrim ad hayyom hazze al hayom sheomdim bo. umia Adonai yire akeda zo lisloach leyisrael bechol shana ulehatztzilam min happuranut, kede sheyyeamer hayyom hazze – bechol haddorot habbaim – behar Adonai yerae efro shel yitzchak tzavur veomed lechappara:
Vattaharena vegomer. aappi sheen haishsha mitabberet mibbia rishona, ellu shaltu veatzman vehotziu ervatan lachutz venitabberu mibbia rishona:
Uvetuel yalad et rivka. kol hayyichusin hallalu lo nichtevu ella bishvil pasuk ze:
Bead kol rechem. keneged kol petach:
Al devar sara. al pi dibburah shel sara:
ohc: Ki atzor vegomer al devar vegomer. perush shello yomru meavimelech nitabbera sara, hare sheakar haya bayyamim hahem. vegam legallot ki toil tefillat avraham lifkod akarot, vehoila gam al atzmo venifkad. gam lehodia, kol hammitpallel al chavero vehu tzarich vechulei hu naane vechulei, velaze samach lefasuk ze pasuk "vaAdonai pakad et sara". vahagam shekkevar kadma hahavtacha, im eno inyan hassemichut legufo tenehu leinyan lezulat, veayyen beferush pasuk sheachar ze:

rashi: Ulenini ulenechdi. ad kan rachame haav al habben:
Kachesed asher asiti immecha taase immadi. sheamarti lecha hinne artzi lefanecha (Bereshit Rabba):
Kach na. en na ella leshon bakasha, amar lo bevakkasha mimmecha, amod li beze hannissayon, shello yomru harishonot lo haya vahen mammash:

Et bincha. amar lo shene vanim yesh li, amar lo et yechidcha; amar lo ze yachid leimmo veze yachid leimmo, amar lo asher ahavta; amar lo shenehem ani ohev, amar lo et yitzchak (sanhedrin 89). velamma lo gilla lo mittechilla? shello learbevo pitom vetazuach dato alav vetittaref, uchede lechabbev alav et hammitzva velitten lo sachar al kol dibbur vedibbur:

Eretz hammoriyya. yerushalayim, vechen bedivre hayyamim livnot et bet Adonai birushalam behar hammoriyya (divrei hayamim 2 3). verabbotenu pershu al shem shemmishsham horaa yotza leyisrael. veunkelos tirgemo al shem avodat hakketoret sheyyesh bo mor nerd ushear besamim:
Vehaalehu. lo amar lo shechatehu, lefi shello haya chafetz hakkabba leshochoto ella lehaalehu lahar laasoto ola, umishsheheelahu amar lo horidehu:

Achad heharim. hakkabba mathe hatztzaddikim veachar kach megalle lahem; vechol ze kede leharebot secharan, vechen el haaretz asher arekka (Bereshit 12), vechen beyona ukera aleha et hakkeria (Yona 3 2):
ohc: Kach na. perush techef umiyyad belo sheelat zeman, veaf ze mehannissayon shello yishal mimmennu zeman, kemaase bat yiftach (Shoftim 11:37) sheratza aviha lehaalotah ola veshaala mimmennu shenayim chodashim vegomer.

Od ramaz lo sheyyikkach et sara bidvarim lehitratztzot elav leholicho immo, vechen amru zichronam livracha (tanchuma 22) ki chol oto hallayla haya avraham mefayyes lesara lehasekim immo sheyyolichennu lilmod tora ad or habboker:
Od yirmoz al yitzchak sheyyikkachehu bedivre ritztzuy, shehare lo nitnassa kol yamav, vetzivva Adonai sheyyikkachehu bedivre taam ulehachnis belibbo maalat haddavar im yikrav ola laAdonai.

Et bincha vegomer. kan ramaz leshalosh ahavot shechiyyeva tora lechol ish yisrael leehov habbore baruch hu bechol lev uvechol nefesh uvechol meod (Devarim 6:5). bechol lev – en lecha davar shechaviv belev adam keahavat habbanim, vehu amro et bincha. ucheneged "bechol nafshecha" amar et yechidcha, vechevan sheen lo ella hu, hu hannefesh, ki mi sheen lo banim chashuv kemet. ucheneged "uvechol meodecha" amar asher ahavta, perush: oto ahavta yoter mikkol kinyanecha vechol kinyanav kenegdo ayin, veaf al pi chen haalehu li vegomer. venitkavven Adonai lefaret kol ze lehodio shehagam sheyyeshno etzlo bechol hahadragot, af al pi chen chafetz Adonai sheyyakrivehu lo leola.

rashi: Shema bekolah. lamadnu shehaya avraham tafel lesara binviut:
Vayyaakod. yadav veraglav meachorav; hayyadayim veraglayim beyachad hi akida (shabbat 54), vehu leshon akuddim, shehayu karsulehem levanim, makom sheokdin otan bo haya nikkar:
Al tishlach. lishchot; amar lo im ken lechinnam bati lechan, eese bo chabbala veotzi mimmenu meat dam, amar lo al taas lo meuma – al taas bo mum:

Ki atta yadati. amar rabbi abba, amar lo avraham afaresh lefanecha et sichati, etmol amarta li ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara, vechazarta veamarta kach na et bincha, achshav atta omer al tishlach yadcha el hannaar? amar lo hakkabba, lo achallel beriti umotza sefatay lo ashanne (Tehillim 89); kesheamarti lecha "kach", motza sefatay lo ashanne – lo amarti lecha shechatehu ella haalehu, assakteh, achteh.
Ki atta yadati. meatta yesh li ma lehashiv lassatan velaummot hattemehim ma hi chibbati etzlecha; yesh li pitchon pe achshav, sheroim ki yere elohim atta:
Chalila lecha. chullin hu lecha, yomru chach hu ummanuto, shotef hakkol, tzeddikim ureshaim, kach asita ledor hammabbul uledor happallaga:
Kaddavar hazze. lo hu velo kayyotze vo:
Chalila lecha. laolam habba:
Hashshofet kol haaretz. nakud bachataf pattach hei shel hashofet, leshon temiha, vechi mi shehu shofet lo yaase mishpat emet:

Achare haddevarim haelle vayyuggad vegomer. beshuvo mehar hammoriya haya avraham mehareher veomer illu haya veni shachut kevar, haya holech belo vanim, haya li lehassio ishsha mibbenot aner eshkol umamre, bissero hakkabba shennolda rivka vat zugo, vezehu haddevarim haelle, hirhure devarim shehayu al yede akeda:
Gam hi. af hi hishvat mishpechoteha lemishpechot avraham 12, ma avraham 12 shevatim sheyyatzu miyyaakov, 8 bene haggevirot 10 bene shefachot, af ellu 8 bene gevirot ved bene pilegesh:
ohc: Vayhi achare haddevarim haelle vayyuggad vegomer. taam sippur ze, gam taam amro achare haddevarim ki en lo kesher ledat haamurim mitztzad ma shekkadam, ze hiv lehodia shennolda rivka bat zugo shel yitzchak. vetaam ad atta velo kodem kevar hikdamnu ki haya missitra denukeba velo haya lo nukeba ad achar haakeda shennitabbera bo nefesh hazzachar, achar haddevarim haelle vayyuggad leavraham vegomer, uvetuel yalad et rivka vegomer, ze hiv ikkar hassippur. vetaam shehutzrach hakkatuv lichtov kol seder hannoladim minnachor gam mippilagsho reuma lelo davar, da ki keshettitnotzetz nefesh tzaddik muflaa baolam hazze o tzaddeket kerivka em kol zera hakkedushsha, letzad ma shekkadam mehattaarovet mibbechinot hara missibbat chet adam harishon asher davak bo ra vetov baavonot, yimmatzun bishchunatah nefashot gedolot mechelek hakkelippa, uveamdah yaamdu immah uvetzetah laolam yetzu kullam bishchunatah, vechol echad hikkir bechinato, rivka heir orah bikdushsha vezulatah kemotz yesoer, velaze hodia hakkatuv kol haummot sheyyatzu minnachor, shebbetocham hayta margalit tova rivka immenu aleha hashshalom:
Chassalat parashat vayyar

rashi: Metzachek. leshon aza, kemo shenneemar vayyakumu letzachek (Shemot 32), davar acher leshon gilluy arayot, kema detema letzachek bi (Bereshit 39), davar acher leshon retzicha, kemo yakumu na hannearim visachaku lefanenu vegomer (Shmuel 2 2), shehaya meriv im yitzchak al hayerushsha veomer ani bechor venotel pi shenayim, veyotzim bassade venotel kashto veyore vo chitztzim, kema detema kemitlahleah hayyore zikkim vegomer veamar halo mesachek ani (Mishlei 26):

Salseleha. chappeseha, heye chozer aleha ledakdek bah. kemo "kevotzer al salsillot" (Yirmeyahu 6:9) – hachozer veholech bakkerem umeshiv yado levakkesh et haolelot. uvilshon chachamim (tanchuma, vayyeshev 8): mesalsel bisaro:
targum: Chabbivyah di teromminach vechabbekeyah dityakrach:

rashi: Shimu vanim musar av. hakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: Shemau venaya marduta deav veatzitu lemeda veyuna:

rashi: Vayyomar adonay im na vegomer. laggadol shebbahem amar ukeraam kullam adonim velaggadol amar al na taavor, vechevan shello yaavor hu yaamdu chaverav immo, uvelashon ze hu chol (shavuot 35). davar acher kodesh hu, vehaya omer lehakkabba lehametin lo ad sheyyarutz veyachnis et haorchim veaappi shekkatuv achar vayyaratz likratam, haamira kodem lachen hayta, vederech hammikraot ledabber ken, kemo shepperashti etzel lo yadon ruchi vaadam, shennichtav achar vayyoled noach, vei efshar lomar ella shehayta haggezera kodem lalleda 20 shana, ushete halleshonot bivra:
ohc: Vayyomar adonay im na vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lo ritztza lishlashtam yachad. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bereshit Rabba 48:10) laggadol, vehu derech derash, ki bamme yivvada ki mazmin hu et kullan?

Achen taam avraham hu, leheyot shehirgish shehashshenayim hayu mechavvenim penehem lehikkanes etzlo, ki elav bau – echad lerappeoto veechad levassero, usheluchim hem elav, asher lo chen hashshelishi vehu gavriel shebba lahafoch sedom, lo haya lo shayyachut etzel avraham. laze chilla fanav shello yaavor mealav vesheyyikkanes etzlo im hashshenayim, venitratztza lidvarav.

rashi: Chadal lihyot. pasak mimmena:
Orach kannashim. orach niddot:
Rak en yirat elohim. achsenay shebba lair, al iske achila ushetiyya shoalin oto o al iske ishto shoalin oto? ishtecha hi o achotcha hi? (bava kamma sham):
ohc: Ki amarti vegomer. zo teshuva leamro "ma raita", veomer rak vegomer letzad sheamar elav avimelech: veim chashashta lahem sheen lahem yirat elohim, im ken lo tachush sheyyahargu otcha veyikchu et ishtecha mimmecha velo yachushu leissur eshet ish? laze amar "rak" – miut, lomar shechoshshim hem leyirat elohim lehakel chomer haddavar al yede sheyyaharguni. perush, ki im lo yaharguhu al kol bia uvia yitchayyevu mita veyesh onesh merubbe, vegam yamutu kol habba aleha. laze yitchakkemu laharog et avraham veen kan ella onesh avon echad veadam echad. uma gam im yaharguhu harebe bene adam keechad yesh baze tzad petor. velaze chash veamar "achoti". uvaze heshiv al shello hodio shehi ishto.

rashi: Yire lo hasse. kelomar yire veyivchar lo hasse, veim en se, leola beni. veaf al pi shehevin yitzchak shehu holech lehishshachet,
Vayyelchu shenehem yachdav. belev shave:
Vechen al tomar lereacha. leani:
Veyesh ittach. ma shettitten lo. verabbotenu pershu (bava metzia 110:): lech vashuv; al "sechar sachir" (Devarim 15:18):
targum: La temar lechavrach ezal vetuv velimchar etten veit gabbach:

rashi: Hashev eshet haish. veal tehe savur shemma titganne veenav velo yekabbelenna o yisnaacha velo yitpallel alecha:
Ki navi hu. veyodea shello nagata vah, lefichach veyitpallel baadcha (bava kamma 92):
ohc: Veatta hashev eshet vegomer. amro ki navi hu perush ki navi hu haish shezzo ishto, ki adayin lo yada beferush sheeshet avraham hayta, ki bedivrehem lo huzkar habbaal uchemo shekkatavnu lemala, uveamro "navi hu" yadua shehu avraham, ki en navi zulato bayyamim hahem.
Od yirtze ki navi hu veyada shehagam shennistera hi, lo nitmea.
Od yirtze al ze hadderech: ki navi hu uvaze yitpallel baadcha vetoil tefillato, vehu amro vechye.

rashi: Kemach solet. solet leugot, kemach laamilan shel tabbachim, lechassot et hakkedera lishov et hazzuhama:
VaAdonai himtir. kol makom shenneemar vaAdonai – hu uvet dino:

Himtir al sedom. baalot hashshachar, kemo shenneemar uchemo hashshachar ala, shaa shehallevana omedet barakia im hachamma, lefi shehayu mehem ovdin lachamma umehem lallevana, amar hakkabba im eppara mehem bayyom, yihyu ovde levana omrim illu haya vallayla, keshehallevana moshelet, lo hayinu charevin, veim eppara mehem ballayla, yihyu ovde hachamma omrim illu haya bayyom, keshehachamma moshelet, lo hayinu charevin; lechach ketiv uchemo hashshachar ala, venifra mehem beshaa shehachamma vehallevana moshlot:
Himtir gofrit vaesh. battechilla matar, venaasa gafrit vaesh:

Meet Adonai. derech hammikraot ledabber ken, kemo neshe lemech, velo amar nashay; vechen amar david kechu immachem et avde adonechem (Melachim 1 1), velo amar meavaday; vechen achashverosh amar beshem hammelech, velo amar bishmi; af kan amar, meet Adonai velo amar meitti:

Min hashshamayim. hu sheamar hakkatuv ki vam yadin ammim vegomer (Iyov 36), keshebba leyasser hebberiot mevi alehem esh min hashshamayim, kemo sheasa lisdom, ucheshebba lehorid hamman min hashshamayim hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim (Shemot 16):
Al timna tov mibbealav. im raita chavercha chafetz lehetiv laaniyyim, al timnaehu:
Bihyot leel yadcha. lehachadilo. davar acher: al timna tov mibbealav, al timna tzedaka min heani, bihyot leel yadcha laasot tzedaka, shemma yavo yom veen leel yadcha:
targum: La titkele lemebad shappir kad it chela vidach lemebad:

rashi: Vayyelech Adonai vegomer. kevan shennishtattek hassanegor halach lo haddayyan:
Veavraham shav limkomo. nistallek haddayyan nistallek hassanegor, vehakkategor mekatreg ulefichach vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma, lehashechit:
ohc: Vayyelech Adonai kaasher killa vegomer. perush: samuch ligmar divre teshuvato leavraham "lo ashchit baavur haasara" halach Adonai, velo natan lo makom lehitpallel al pachot mishshiur ze, letzad shekkevar amar avraham "vaadabbera ach happaam" velo yosif dabber od baddavar hazze, o letzad sheyyodea Adonai ki lo tihye hagana befachot measara. vahagam shemmatzinu leharashbi (zohar chelek 1 82:) sheamar "vetzaddik yesod olam", efshar shezze yihye kesheyyihye tzaddik mufla, veefshar sheim haya avraham bekirbah shel sedom haya memallet kol hair.

rashi: Ben bakar rach vatov. 3 parim hayu, chede lehaachilan 3 leshonot bechardal (bava metzia 87):
El hannaar. ze yishmael, lechannecho bemitzvot (Bereshit Rabba):
Veneda otam. bemishkav zachar kemo asher lo yadu ish (Bereshit Rabba):
Vehochiach. nitvakkeach immo al kach:

Vayyizkor elohim et avraham. mahu zechirato shel avraham al lot? nizkar shehaya lot yodea shessara ishto shel avraham veshama sheamar avraham bemitzrayim al sara achoti hi, velo gilla haddavar, shehaya chas alav, lefichach chas hakkabba alav (Bereshit Rabba):
Ki Adonai yihye vechislecha. bemivtachacha. davar acher: baddevarim sheatta kesil bahen. kach matzati birushalmi (pea 1:1):
targum: Metul deelaha yehe vesadach veyintar riglach vela tittzed:

rashi: Vayyomru gesh hala. kerav lehala, kelomar, hitkarev latztzedadin vehitrachek mimmennu, vechen kol hala shebbammikra leshon richuk, kemo zere hala (Bamidbar 17), hinne hachetzi mimmecha vahala (Shmuel 1 20), gesh hala, (Yeshayahu 49) – himmashech lehallan, bilshon laaz tareyteydenavesh, udevar nezifa hu, lomar – en anu choshshin lecha. vedome lo kerav elecha al tiggash bi (Yeshayahu 65), vechen gesha li veesheva (sham 49) – himmashech latztzedadin baavuri veeshev etzlecha; atta melitz al haorchin, ech melaacha libbecha? al sheamar lahem al habbanot, amru lo gesh hala, leshon nachat; veal shehaya melitz al haorchim – haechad ba lagur, adam nachri yechidi atta venenu, shebbata lagur, veyishpot shafot, venaaseta mochiach otanu?
Haddalet. hi hassovevet linol veliftoach:
Od mi lecha fo. peshuto shel mikra mi yesh lecha od bair hazzot chutz meishtecha uvenotecha shebbabbayit:
Chatan uvanecha uvenotecha. veim yesh lecha chatan o vanim uvanot hotze min hammakom:
Uvanecha. bene benotecha hannesuot. umia od – meachar sheosin nevala kazot, mi lecha pitchon pe lelammed sannegorya alehem? shekkol hallayla haya melitz alehem tovot, keri veh mi lecha fe:

Moav. zo shello hayta tzenua persha shemmeaviha hu, aval tzeira keraattu velashon nekiyya, vekibbela sachar bime moshe, shenneemar bivne ammon al titgar bam (Devarim 2) – kelal, uvemoav lo hizhir ella shello yillachem bam, aval letzaaran hittir lo:
Hinne na adonay. hinne na attem adonim li achar sheavartem alay. davar acher hinne na tzerichim attem latet lev al harshaim hallalu shello yakkiru vachem vezo hi etza nechona:
Suru na. akkemu et hadderech leveti derech akallaton shello yakkiru sheattem nichnasin sham, lechach neemar suru (Bereshit Rabba):

Velinu verachatzu raglechem. vechi darkan shel bene adam lalun techilla veachar kach rochetz? veod, shehare avraham amar lahem techilla rachatzu raglechem? ella kach amar lot, im kesheyyavou anshe sedom veyiru shekkevar rachatzu raglehem yaalilu alay veyomru kevar avru shene yamim o shelosha shebbau levetcha velo hodatanu, lefichach amar, mutav sheyitakkevu kan baavak raglehem sheyyihyu nirin kemo shebbau achshav; lefichach amar linu techilla veachar kach rachatzu:
Vayyomru lo. uleavraham amru ken taase, mikkan shemmesarvin lekatan veen mesarvin legadol (Bereshit Rabba):
Ki varchov nalin. hare ki meshammesh bilshon ella, sheamru lo nasur el betcha ella birchovah shel ir nalin:
ohc: Vehishkamtem vegomer. ramaz lahem shetztzerichin lehitallem meanshe hair ulehashkim babboker lalechet, ki chash al kevodam shello yedu mehem veyihye ma shehaya.

rashi: Al tekanne beish chamas. laasot kemaasav, im tirehu matzliach:
targum: La titan begavra chatufa vela titzve bechulhon archateh:

rashi: Im emtza visdom vegomer lechol hammakom. lechol hakkerakkim; ulefi shessedom hayta metroppolin vachashuva mikkullam, tala vah hakkatuv:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai im emtza vegomer. heshiv al sheela acharona, umikkol shekken shello yamit tzaddik, vetze ulemad mishshelichut lot, hagam shello haya tzaddik ella lemaan avraham kerovo.

rashi: Lo karav eleha. hammalach menao, kemo shenneemar lo netatticha lingoa eleha:

Hagoy gam tzaddik taharog. af im hu tzaddik tahargennu, shemma chach darkecha leabbed haummot chinnam? kach asita ledor hammabbul uledor happallaga, af ani omer sheharagtam al lo davar, kemo sheatta omer lehargeni:
ohc: Vaavimelech lo karav eleha vegomer. yitbaer al derech ma shekkatav rambam beferek 9 mehilchot melachim: ben noach shebba al eshet chavero shello kedarkah patur, veal eshet yisrael afillu shello kedarkah chayyav. laze nitchakkem mechashash sheyyihye din sara din eshet yisrael, velo karav kol ikkar.
Hagoy gam tzaddik vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro hagoy, od amro gam tzaddik, od amro taharog, velo chen mashma middivre Adonai, sheim yashiv haishsha velo yikrav aleha eno ben mavet.

Achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot sad.) befasuk (Melachim 1 22:17) "yashuvu ish leveto beshalom", sheamar "beshalom" keamro al hammet, vahagam shello met adam zulat achav melech yisrael veamar leshon mita al kol haam, hareta ladaat ki tzarat hammelech hi tzarat kol haam, umin harauy letzadded shello tavo raa al hammelech hagam sheyyitchayyev al maasehu letzad haggaat hara lichlalut haam. vehu ma shemmatmiah beamro "hagoy", perush yiches atzmo legoy lattaam hannizkar, "gam tzaddik", shebbeerech heyoto tzaddik afillu perat echad lo yeavvet hael mishpat laharog tzaddik echad. vetaam amro ken, leheyot shehevin bedivre Adonai ki nechleta haggezera alav lamut keamro "hinnecha met" behechlet "al haishsha asher lakachta", perush shekkevar lakachta, al hallekicha levad. vetaan halo hu tzaddik ki eno chayyav mita al hallekicha kevan shello karav eleha vaafillu shello kedarkah kemishpat arayot yisrael, hare hu tzaddik vetzaddik bedino. vehosif od lomar shehagam shehaya ba aleha hu patur, shehare ben noach shebba al eshet ish shogeg patur, vehu shogeg hu keamro "halo hu amar li achoti hi".
O efshar shehevin bemaamar Adonai ki hu yada shehi beulat baal, veamar ki lo chen hu, "halo hu amar li" vegomer:

rashi: Yadati ki vetom levavcha vegomer. emet shello dimmita mittechilla lachato aval nikyon kappayim en kan:
Lo netatticha. lo mimmecha haya shello nagata vah, ella chasachti ani otcha mechato velo natatti lecha koach, vechen velo netano elohim (Bereshit 31:7), vechen velo netano aviha lavo (Shoftim 15):
ohc: Vayyomer elav haelohim vegomer. hiskim lo al devarav ki lo nitchayyev mita al asher asa ki betom levavo, ach al nikyon kappayim lo hiskim. veulay shehagam shehu lo gazal, im kol ze allamut hammalchut haya baemtzaut, vahagam sheenah gezela sheyyitchayyev aleha, im kol ze nikyon kappayim eno. o letzad shebbedivre Adonai lo haya makom litot bo, ella avimelech haya metzadded kol tzidde hassefekot, laze lo hutzrach lomar lo "uvenikyon" vegomer.

Veamro vaechsoch vegomer. nitkavven lefaresh lo kavvanato, ki ma sheamar lo "hinnecha met" vegomer lo al ma sheavar, ella im lo yachzir veyikrav eleha yamut, velaze hitra bo kodem vechasach oto bema shehodio ki hi beulat baal.

Mechato li. uferush li shehagam sheim lo haya modio vehaya nichshal lo haya hachet mechayyevo mita laavimelech, af al pi chen legabbe haelohim yesh lo devar hakepada, ben lesibbat hammaase sheyyishkav eshet ish vehi zimma, veod letzad sara veavraham sheggenay hu lahem vehem yedide elyon, laze dikdek lomar tevat li.

Veamro al ken vegomer, perush: letzad heyot haddevarim beseder ze hu shebbati lehodiacha limnoa atzmecha mimmenna, aval zulat ze peresh sheim hayita yodah beulat baal velakachta otah hayiti horegcha, shehakkadosh baruch hu dan al machshevet goyim haraa umetzarfah lemaase. uledivrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 52:13) sheamru malach dechafo mealeha, yeduyyak hakkatuv al nachon amro lo netatticha lingoa eleha.

rashi: Haaf umnam. hagam emet eled?
Vaani zakanti shinna hakkatuv mippene hashshalom, shehare hi amra vadoni zaken:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai el avraham vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro tevat ze, od lamma amar tevat lemor. gam kol hakkatuv meyuttar, shello haya lo lomar ella "lamma tzachaka".

Achen hakkavvana hi leheyot shemmatzinu bapparasha hakkodemet ki avraham gam ken tzachak kesheamar lo Adonai besorat hazzera, dichtiv (Bereshit 17:17) "vayyippol avraham vegomer vayyitzchak", velo rainu shehikpid Adonai al shetztzachak avraham. veyomar haomer: "ma nishtannet tzechikat sara mitztzechikat avraham?" umatzinu leuneklos shennitkavven letaretz ze bema shettirgem tzechikat avraham "vachadi" utzechikat sara "vechayyechat", aval al mi samach hakkadosh baruch hu lehavin shene perushim meshunnim beteva achat?

Achen hannachon hu ki hakkadosh baruch hu dikdek bidvarav taam hakepadato al sara velo al avraham, vetimtza ki avraham beet habbesora tzachak, ma sheen ken sara lo tzachaka beet shennitbassera ella beet sheraata edna, keamro "vattitzchak sara vegomer achare veloti hayta li edna", hare ze maggid ki lo nitammet etzlah havetachat halleda ad sheraata hashshinnuy, veal ze hikpid Adonai, vehu amro lamma ze tzachaka, perush: al tzechok ze ani makpid velo al tzechok shellecha, vehattaam ki tzechok ze kavvanatah lomar "haaf umnam" shennitammet etzlah achar maase shetteled, veze yaggid ki lo heemina velo samcha datah al havetachati otah ki hu devar pele, "hayippale meAdonai davar" vegomer:

Vaani zakanti vegomer. kashe ech yotzi Adonai davar mippiv yitbarach ma shello haya. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (bava metzia paz.) ki mikkan shemmeshannim mippene hashshalom, af al pi chen leerech rommut amittut yitbarach ki mimmennu totzaot emet lo yedabber chas veshalom ma shello haya. ulefi ma shepperashnu shehahakpada hayta al shello heemina shetteled letzad ziknatah keamro "achare veloti" ad sheraata sheshshava lime alumeha Adonai emet udevarav emet. vediyyek lomar taam shehikpid aleha shello heemina kodem shennitaddena, vahagam shessara hosifa od lomar "vadoni zaken", ze haya achar shehitzdika bahavetacha ki hayta lah edna, tzachaka perush samcha, veamra shir veshevach leel elyon sheachar belotah hayta lah edna, shezze yaggid ki shava lime alumeha laledet, vehosifa lehagedil chesed el beamrah "vadoni zaken", veaf al pi chen nisse el nossu aleha, ki peshita sheachar sheraata edna lo tefakpek baddavar, velo amra "vadoni zaken" ella lehodot al nifleotav:

rashi: Hamechasse ani. bitmiha:

Asher ani ose bisdom. lo yafe li laasot davar ze shello middato. ani natatti lo et haaretz hazzot, vachamishsha kerakkin hallalu shello hen, shenneemar: gevul hakkenaani mitztzidon boacha sedoma vaamora vegomer (Bereshit 10). karati oto avraham – av hamon goyim, veashmid et habbanim velo odia laav, shehu ohavi?
ohc: VaAdonai amar hamechasse vegomer. taam amro lashon ze "hamechasse", leheyot ki raa avraham malach hashshelishi ki va al davar laolam velo noda lo haddavar, kemo sheyyada bifullot shene hammalachim: haechad ba lerappeot veechad levasser sara. veod belechtam meimmo raa ki shenayim mehem samu penehem derech sedom veavraham holech immam leshallecham, hare ze roe sheyyesh lahem asot davar umechusse mimmennu hammaase. laze amar Adonai hamechasse ani meavraham asher ani ose, perush: kodem asoto. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (tanchuma) shehaya belev avraham al me hammabbul, lamma lo tala Adonai lahem bizchut hatztzaddikim shehayu bahem. ulefi divrehem yechavven lomar asher ani ose, perush: asher ani ragil laasot, ki en ani meabbed umma ella im en bah tzaddikim.

Od yirtze amro hamechasse vegomer, leheyot sheavraham hitztzil hassedomiyyim becharbo uvekashto im lot kaamur bapparasha hakkodemet, nogea haddavar elav ladaat ma sheyyaase bahem, velo yihye haddavar mechusse mimmennu leshon kissuy, ki hu bedato haam asher hitztzil odennu lavetach vaAdonai hu meabbedam mibbeli yediato, laze amar "hamechasse" vegomer, velo hutzrach lefaresh taam ze ki hu davar yadua:

rashi: Rove kashshat. yore chitztzim bekeshet:
Kashshat. al shem haummanut, kemo chammar, gammal, tzayyad, lefichach hashshin mudgeshet. haya yoshev bammidbar umelastem et haovrim, hu shenneemar yado vakkol vegomer:
Shene. 1 lehashechit et sedom 7 lehatztzil et lot, vehu oto shebba lerappeot avraham, vehashshelishi shebba levasser et sara, kevan sheasa shelichuto nistallek lo:

Hammalachim. ulehallan keraam anashim? keshehayta shechina immahem keraam anashim; davar acher etzel avraham shekkocho gadol vehayu hammalachim tedirin etzlo kaanashim keraam anashim, veetzel lot keraam malachim (Bereshit Rabba):
Baerev. vechi chol kach shahu hammalachim mechevron lisdom? ella malache rachamim hayu umamtinim shemma yuchal avraham lelammed alehem sannegorya:
Velot yoshev beshaar sedom. yoshev ketiv, oto hayyom minnuhu shofet alehem (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayyar lot vegomer. mibbet avraham lamad lachazor al haorchim:
ohc: Vayyavou vegomer baerev. taam haddavar limtzo hachana lelot lehachenisam velizkot behatztzalato, vahagam sheamru (Bereshit Rabba 50:11) ki bizchut avraham nitztzol, aval tzarich limtzo lo zechut kol shehu, veim hayu baim bayyom efshar shello hayu mannichim oto bene hair lehachenisam kol ikkar:

Vayyar lot (vayyaratz) [vayyakam] vegomer. perush: hikkir bahem ki hem mehammukkarim etzlo limsharte elyon bihyoto bishchunat avraham, vehu amro vayyar, velaze masar nafsho alehem im bene hair (vayyaratz) [vayyakam] likratam. veamro lahem verachatzu raglechem ki chen haya minhag avraham im orchav vehalach leraglav. venichtav battora lehodienu hefresh shebben avraham lelot, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 50:4) ze hikdim rechitza veze hikdim lina kodem rechitza, ki lo haya makpid al kenisatam beveto avoda zara ma sheen ken avraham vegomer:

rashi: Gam laddavar hazze. lo dayyecha sheatta nitztzal, ella af kol hair atztzil biglalcha:
Hofki. hofech ani, kemo ad boi (Bereshit 48), achare roi (Bereshit 16:13), midde dabberi bo (Yirmeyahu 31):

ohc: Vayyomer avraham anochi vegomer. perush: yesh lahashivcha al taanatcha sheamarta "kachesed" vegomer, ella sheani chafetz baddavar – ishshava.

Od yirtze, leheyot sheratza lehochicho al odot beer hammayim kaamur besamuch (Bereshit 21:25), chash sheyyachshov shemmeshivo listor chasdo ulevilti yishshava, laze hikdim lomar anochi ishshavea veachar kach hochicho al vegomer.
Od yechavven lomar anochi ishshavea, perush: al atzmo, lo ara lecha vegomer, venitkavven lishlol chiyyuv beno.
O yirtze ki hu yishshava veyashbia banav al shelosha dorot ellu, vehannikkud yochiach:

rashi: Ki toavat Adonai naloz. meuvvat bidrachav:
Veet yesharim sodo. veim yesharim sodo:
targum: Metol dimrachak avta min kodam Adonai veim teritzaya shuiteh:

rashi: Vayyikkach chema vegomer. velechem lo hevi, lefi sheppersa sara nidda, shechazar lah orach kannashim oto hayyom, venitmet haissa (bava metzia sham):
Chema. shumman hechalav shekkoltin meal panav:
Uven habbakar asher asa. asher tikken; kamma kamma shettiken amti veayyti kamayhu:
Vayyochelu. niru chemi sheachlu, mikkan shello yeshanne adam min hamminhag (bava metzia sham):

Hair hazzot kerova. kerova yeshivatah, nityashsheva mikkarov, lefichach lo nitmallea seatah adayin (shabbat 10). uma hi kerivatah? middor happallaga shennitpallegu haanashim vehitchilu lehityashshev ish ish bimkomo, vehi hayta bishnat mot peleg, umishsham vead kan 52 shana, sheppeleg met bishnat 48 leavraham. ketzad? peleg chay achare holido et reu 209 shana, tze mehem 32 keshennolad serug, umisserug ad shennolad nachor 30, hare 62, uminnachor ad shennolad terach 29, hare 91, umishsham ad shennolad avraham 70, hare 161, ten lahem 48 hare 209, veota shana hayta shenat happallaga, ucheshennechreva sedom haya avraham ben 99 shana, hare middor happallaga ad kan 52 shana; vetzoar ichara yeshivatah achare yeshivat sedom vechavroteha shana achat, hiv shenneemar immalta na, na begimatriyya nusach acher:
Halo mitzar hi. vahalo avonoteha muatin veyachol atta lehannichah:
Utechi nafshi bah, zehu midrasho. ufeshuto shel mikra halo ir ketanna hi vaanashim bah meat, en lach lehakepid im tannichenna, utechi nafshi vah:
ohc: Hinne na hair hazzot. kashe, mimma nafshach: im nitchayyeva hair, ma yoil bakkashato mehem? veod, roani ki shamu lekolo veamru nasati fanecha vegomer, veim lo nitchayyeva, mibbeli bakkashato shel lot en lahem reshut lehashechitah.

Achen yitbaer hainyan al derech amram bemassechet shabbat (10.) yeshivatah shel tzoar chamishshim veachat shana veshel sedom chamishshim ushetayim vechulei ad kan. uchefi ze dan lot lifnehem ki adayin lo nishlema seatah. vehen emet ki yishtanne haddin (bava kamma 60.) ben kodem shennittan reshut lamchabbel leachar shennittan vechulei, shehagam sheadayin lo nishlema seatah af al pi chen kevan shennittan reshut lammashchit en lah zechut lehimmalet mehaddin, uchefi ze haddavar taluy beyad hammashchit, laze nitchakkem lot veshaal haddavar mimmennu, vekibbel devarav veamar nasati fanecha vegomer, vetimtza shettechef halach lo lot mitztzoar ki yare shehiggia zeman tashlum pureanutah.

rashi: Ad ko. kelomar derech muat lammakom asher lefanenu. umia ere hechan hu ma sheamar li hammakom ko yihye zarecha:
Venashuva. nitnabbe sheyyashuvu shenehem:
Avinu zaken. veim lo achshav ematay? shemma yamut o yifsok meholid:
Veish en baaretz. sevurot hayu shekkol haolam necherav kemo bedor hammabbul: (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayyifnu mishsham. mimmakom sheavraham livvam sham:

Veavraham odennu omed lifne Adonai. vahalo lo halach laamod lefanav, ella hakkabba ba etzlo veamar lo, zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba, vehaya lo lichtov "vaAdonai odennu omed al avraham"? ella tikkun sofrim hu ze (asher hafachuhu razili lichtov ken) (Bereshit Rabba):
Im beni im yitzchak. mikkevan shehu veni afillu im eno hagun keyitzchak, o hagun keyitzchak afillu eno veni, en ze cheday lirash immo, kava im beni im yitzchak, sheshshetehen bo (Bereshit Rabba):
Kitor. timmur shel ashan, 316 109:
Hakkivshan. chafira shessorfin ba et haavanim lesid, vechen kol kivshan shebbattora:

Vayyoreni. al kach vayyochicheni vayyomer li yitmach devaray libbecha. ulefi shehochicheni bidvarim ellu, lechach ani mazhirchem al kach (rabbi yosef kera). davar acher: ki ven hayiti leavi, hannavi omer: ben hayiti lehakkadosh baruch hu, shehishra rucho alay. umatzinu shekkerao hakkadosh baruch hu lishlomo ben, shenneemar "ani ehye lo leav vegomer" (Shmuel 2 7:14):
Rach veyachid lifne immi. leummati ani nivchar vechaviv keven rach veyachid, lechach vayyoreni avi:
targum: Vealfani vaamar li (Adonai) yekamet milay libbach netar pikuday vechye:

rashi: Al na adonay. rabbotenu amru (shavuot 32) sheshshem ze kodesh, shenneemar bo lehachayot et nafshi – mi sheyesh beyado lehamit ulehachayot; vetargumo bevau chean Adonai:
Al na. al tomru elay lehimmalet hahara:
Na. leshon bakkasha:
Natatti lachem. hannavi mitnabbe umedabber bishlichuto shel hakkadosh baruch hu, vahare hu kefiv:
targum: Metul deyulefana tava yahavet lechon venimosi la tishbekun:

rashi: Vayyiggamal. lesof 24 chodesh (gittin 75):
Mishte gadol. shehayu sham gedole haddor shem vaever vaavimelech (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayyomer Adonai. el avraham sheasa kaasher amar, shello yechasse mimmennu:

Ki rabba. kol rabba shebbammikra hattaam lematta babbet, lefi shehen meturgamin gedola, o gedela veholechet, aval ze taamo lemala baresh, lefi shemmeturgam gadla kevar kemo shepperashti vayhi hashshemesh baa, hinne shava yevimtech:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai zaakat vegomer. taam amro ki, velo hispik lomar zaakat sedom rabba vegomer vechattatam kavda. gam kefel amro "zaakat" "vechattatam" veen zeaka ella mehachet. gam amro chavda meod, nitkavven lomar shebbazzeman hahu kol haummot gam ken machisim hayu bemaasehem, ella sheellu hifliu laasot, velaze amar ki rabba perush: taam hakepadati lo letzad ki hem levad alta zaakatam lefanay ella ki rabba zaakatam mikkol haummot. vechafal "zaakatam" "vechattatam" keneged shete rishayot: haachat shehayu raim labberiyyot uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kat:) uchemaase shel riva, vehashsheniyya raim lashshamayim uchemo sheggillu maasehem sheratzu achar mishkav zachur im hammalachim shebbidmut anashim, vehutzrach Adonai lehodio hafelagat risham leheyotam maase yadav.

Od nitkavven Adonai lehafig tzinnat daagato, ki yomar shennishtaddel lehatztzil umma reshaa kol kach. laze amar elav ki rabba ki chavda vegomer, perush: mechadash haya haresha shealav mitchayyevim, umikkodem lo hayu kol kach reshaim keshehitztzalta otam.

Vayyomer avimelech vegomer vegam anochi vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma chazar lomar "vegam anochi". veyerae bedikduk od amro lo yadati mi asa vegomer, lamma lo hispik lomar "lo yadati" vehaddavar muvan shechozer ledivre avraham?

Achen hakkavvana hi shehu yada sheggazlu meavraham beer hammayim, aval lo yada mi vami haggozlim. umeatta yomar avraham shealav haya levakkesh mi vami ose risha, laze heshiv sheggam avraham asa shello kahogen shello hodia haddavar lammelech, vehaya yoshev umetzappe kabbalat avraham veaz haya ose lo din. uletzad sheavraham lo hechshivo gam hu lo yada, vehu amro vegam anochi lo shamati vegomer, perush: lo bikkashti ladaat venishar meshullal hayedia ad hayyom shehodatani atta.

rashi: Vayyomer avraham. kan lo natal reshut ella al karchah shello vetovatah, lefi shekkevar lukkecha levet paro al yede chen:
El sara ishto. al sara ishto, kayotze vo el hillakach aron vegomer veel mot chamiha (Shmuel 1 4), shenehem bilshon al:
ohc: Vayyomer avraham el sara. kan lo tzivva lah shettakdim lomar hi, kemaasehu beridto lemitzrayim, ki sham mekom hakkiur vehi pele benehem beyafyah, ma sheen ken bigrar. velaze timtza sheamar lo avimelech "ma raita ki asita et haddavar hazze", ma shello shealo beseder ze paro, ki mekomo shel avimelech lo hayu keurim veyesh benehem yofi velo titpale sara beyafyah kol kach, velaze timtza shehiskim alav sheyyagur bimgurato, ma sheen ken paro.

rashi: Achoti vat avi hiv. uvat av mutteret leven noach, sheen avhut legoy, uchede leammet devarav heshivam ken. veim tomar vahalo bat achiv hayta? bene vanim hare hen kevanim, vahare hi vitto shel terach vechach hiv omer lelot ki anashim achim anachnu (Bereshit 13:8):
Ach lo vat immi. haran meem acheret haya:
ohc: Vegam amna achoti vegomer. kan chiyyev avraham laavimelech umillet atzmo gam mehattaromet shennitraem vekaval alav "me asita lanu" vegomer, veamar vegam amna achoti vegomer, vechi amarti sheenah ishti lehitraem alay shehiteti yire elohim? ani amarti achoti, vichola lihyot achoti veishti, vaalechem lishol im hi ishti hagam sheamarti achoti, sheyyachol ani likro lah achoti veen baze hechlet sheenah ishti lemi sheyyihye yare vechared mechato lelohim. veulay letzad taana zo hirgish avimelech ki haemet im avraham vayyitten lo mattanot tovot. gam nitkavven leval yachsheduhu bemotzi sheker mippiv, vehatztzaddikim choshshin lakkiur veladdome lo.

rashi: Vayyitten leavraham. kede sheyyitpayyes veyitpallel alav:
Vayyeledu. ketargumo veitrevachu, niftechu nikvehem vehotziu, vehi leda shellahem:
Al tariv im adam. lehitlonen alav:
Im lo gemalcha raa. sheavar al hammitzva hakketuva battora "veahavta lereacha kamocha" (Vayikra 19:18). umi shehu rasha, rashshay atta lesano:
targum: La tintze im bar nasha magan im la avad lach bisha:

rashi: Vayyitmahmah. kede lehatztzil et mamono:
Vayyachaziku. echad mehem haya shaliach lehatztzilo vachavero lahafoch sedom, lechach neemar "vayyomer" himmalet, velo neemar vayyomru (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyachaziku haanashim. hagam sheechad mehem hu hammatztzil et lot, aval haacher shebba lahafoch en lo laasot shete shelichuyot. efshar lomar ki leheyot shehammatztzil shehu refael hu hammatztzil vegavriel eno ella mesayyea, lo mikri ze ose shete shelichuyot. vetaam gavriel shessiyyea en ze ella machshire hashechatat sedom, shello yitakkev kol od shehaya lot betochah, vehaya refael mono measot davar ad sheyyetze lot.

rashi: Ki yarea vegomer ki tzachakt. harishon meshammesh leshon deha, shennoten taam laddavar vattechachesh sara – lefi sheyyara; vehashsheni meshammesh bilshon ella, vayyomer lo chidvarech hu ella tzachakt, sheamru rabbotenu ki meshammesh bearba leshonot, i, dilma, ella, deha:
ohc: Vattechachesh sara vegomer. taam amro lemor, gam amro "ki yarea" – lehodia tzidkat sara immenu hatztzaddeket, shello amra beferush "lo tzachakti" shello totzi mippiha devar sheker, ella amra inyan shemmimmennu muvan shekkavvanatah lomar lo tzachaka. velaze lo amar "vattomer lo tzachakti". uletzad sheyyomar haomer veheach haya lah panim shettechachesh bedivre Adonai, laze amar ki yarea – perush: yesh lecha ladaat ki haeved hanneeman hayyare et rabbo veshagag veasa davar bilti metukkan veyochichennu rabbo al asher asa, kesheyyigdal belibbo hafelagat hammora al asher avar retzon adono, lo yaatzor koach lehodot al asher asa lehafelagat hammora veyachchish, uvehachchashato atzmah yaggid ki emet haya haddavar, ella letzad hafelagat hammora eno otzer koach lehaez panav ki chen asa. vehu ma shehodia hakkatuv "ki yarea", vehaven. veamar lah avraham lo ki tzachakt – perush: hayyoter naot hu shettode ki tzachakt, ki baze chafetz Adonai sheyyitvadde haadam befiv beferush. vechen hochichu nevienu alav hashshalom sheddavar hammerutztze hu, "umode veozev yerucham" (Mishlei 28:13).

rashi: Titten leroshcha livyat chen. chevrat chen, kemo "livyat chen hem leroshecha" (Mishlei 1:9):
targum: Utesim bereshach yaayuta dechisda kelila deshavhora alach:

rashi: Ulay yesh chamishshim tzaddikim. asara tzaddikim lechol kerach ucherach, ki Adonai mekomot yesh. veim tomar: lo yatztzilu hatztzaddikim et harshaim, lamma tamit hatztzaddikim?
Yukkach na. al yede shaliach, vehakkabba shillem levanav al yede shaliach, shenneemar vayyarem moshe et yado vayyach et hassela (Bamidbar 20):

Verachatzu raglechem. kassavur shehem arviyyim shemmishtachavim laavak raglehem vihikpid shelo lehachenis aza leveto; aval lot shello hikpid, hikdim lina lirchitza, shenneemar velinu verachatzu raglechem:
Tachat haetz. tachat hailan:
ohc: Yukkach na meat vegomer. ulay shello ratza leshannot keminhag hallakuach baorchim shehayu makdimin lirchotz raglehem lechashshashat avoda zara keamram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 86), veamro meat ze minhago lomar laorchim lehareot ki en torach harebe alehem shello levayyesham:

Od yirmoz inyan hannogea lammalachim sheyyikchu meat mayim shehi hattora, veleheyot ki hattora yesh bah bechinat happeshat uvechinat happenimiyyut, vehinne hammalachim shebbau bidmut anashim hu guf shebbara lahem Adonai ruchani mehageladat haavirim (zohar chelek 1 58), uveerech atzmut hammalach yechashev guf veyityaches elav bechinat regel kayyadua hattaam leyode chen, veramaz lahem sheyyikchu meat mayim mippeshate hattora vitaharu bo raglehem shehu bechinat guf hannikkar alehem. veyishshaanu tachat haetz, shehi hattora shennikret etz chayyim, velaze amar haetz beHei hayedia. gam amar lahem sheyyikchu pat lechem hi bechinat penimiyyut hattora, veyisadu bo penimiyyutam vehu amro "libbechem". vedikdek lomar pat lechem pat sheyyesh bivchinato lechem shehem shalosh havayot shehem bechinat chayyut haolamot.

rashi: Beorach reshaim al tavo veal teashsher. veal tidroch, kemo "baashuro achaza ragli" (Iyov 23:11), vechen "venavon yavin laashuro" (Mishlei 14:15):
targum: Bearcha derashie la tezel vela titan bearcha devishin:

rashi: Maasim asher lo yeasu. makka asher lo hurgela lavo al beriya baa lanu al yadcha, atzirat kol nekavim shel zera veshel ketannim urei veaznayim vechotem:
ohc: Vayyomer lo me asita vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro me asita, veim rotze lomar ma hammaase hara sheasita lanu haya lo lehakedim "me chatati lach". ulay sheramaz beamro "me asita lanu" kodem "me chatati lach" lirmoz lo ma tova asita lanu ugemalticha raa shebbead ze heveta vegomer, vehakkavvana leheyot sheen adam mitchayyev ra baolam kimshallem raa tachat tova, laze ramaz lo shello yaspik asotam lo leavraham raa laasot lahem ma sheasa sheratza leabbedam min haolam, veen metziut ra baolam sheyyihye ze tashlumo, keamro "maasim asher lo yeasu" vegomer zulat im kadam laasot lahem tova vehem gemaluhu raa, vechol hakkatuv hu divre tochecha al ma sheasa.

rashi: Yitzchak li. yismach alay. umia harebe akarot nifkedu immah, harebe cholim nitrappeu vo vayyom, harebe tefillot naanu immah, verov sechok haya vaolam:
Vayyashkem. nizdarez lammitzva (fesachim 4):
Vayyachavosh. hu veatzmo, velo tzivva leechad meavadav, shehaahava mekalkelet hashshura:
Et shene nearav. yishmael veeliezer, sheen adam chashuv rashshay latzet ladderech belo 2 anashim (Bereshit Rabba), sheim yitztarech haechad linkavav veyitrachek, yihye hashsheni immo:
Vayvakka. targum vetzallach, kemo vetzalchu hayyarden (Shmuel 2 19), leshon bikkua, 345 109:
ohc: Vayyashkem avraham babboker. tamo shel avraham mishshum sheamar hakkatuv (Vayikra 7:38) "beyom tzavvoto vegomer lehakeriv" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (zevachim tzach.) sheen makrivin ballayla, velaze halach bizman shehu kasher lehakeriv, sheim yizdammen lo hammakom lo yihye chaser zeman. vahagam shehannevua gam ken hayta bayyom velo haya lo lehitakkev ad yom machar, ulay shello haya zeman beoto yom lehachin velalechet el hammakom asher amar lo Adonai, gam ledabber lesara bederech shello targish baddavar, velo mippene hitrashshelut chas veshalom, vehaed "vayyashkem avraham babboker".

rashi: Ki ven hayiti leavi. im tomar: shelomo haya sone habberiyyot, shehizhiran al haggazel veal haarayot, davar shennafsho shel adam mitavva lahem, lechach neemar: ki ven hayiti vegomer rach veyachid vegomer. shehaya ohev oti yoter:
targum: Metul divra havet leabba mefanek vichida kodam imi:

rashi: Shov ashuv. lo vissero hammalach sheyyashuv elav, ella vishlichuto shel makom amar lo, kemo vayyomer lah malach Adonai hareba arbe, vehu en beyado leharebot, ella bishlichuto shel makom, af kan bishlichuto shel makom amar lo ken (bera). elisha amar lashshunammit lammoed hazze kaet chayya at choveket ben vattomer al adoni ish haelohim al techazzev beshifchatecha, otan hammalachim shebbisseru et sara amru lammoed ashuv, amar lah elisha otam hammalachim shehem chayyim vekayyamim leolam amru lammoed ashuv, aval ani vasar vadam shehayyom chay umachar met – ben chay uven met lammoed hazze vegomer:
Kaet chayya. kaet hazzot lashshana habbaa, ufesach haya, ulefesach habba nolad yitzchak, middela karenan keet ella kaet:
Kaet chayya. kaet hazzot shettehe chayya lachem, shettihyu kullechem shelemim vekayyamim:
Vehu acharav. happetach haya achar hammalach:
ohc: Vayyomer shov vegomer. dibber bilshon yachid, ki echad hu hamevasser ki hashshenayim kol echad ba limlachto. vetzarich latet lev lamma bashsheela al sara shaalu shenayim, veulay ki leheyot sheggam nitkavvenu lishol bishlomah al yede balah, laze shaalu shelashtam mishshum hilchot derech eretz.

Shov ashuv vegomer. taam kefel shov ashuv, gam amro tevat vehinne, yechavven lomar al derech amram zichronam livracha keshennolad yitzchak lo haya rauy leholid, ki ba missitra denukeba, uvemaase haakeda zacha lenefesh harauy leholid, vehu sheramaz bemaamar hammalach shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya vehinne ven lesara perush missitra denukeba, vedayyek lomar "vehinne", perush hammizdammen kodem hu geder ze, veamar ashuv perush paam sheniyya yashuv elav, perush livchinat avraham shehu alma didchura, veze haya baakeda dichtiv (Bereshit 22:11) "vayyikra elav malach Adonai min hashshamayim" vegomer. vehem shete pekidot: pekida achat sheyyihye baolam yitzchak, sheniyya shettihye lo nefesh hayyoledet, vetaam sheasa Adonai kacha lesibbat amro (Bereshit 17:19) "lu yishmael" uchemo shekkatavti sham veyesh sodot.

Od yirtze beamro velsara ven lefi peshuto al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 94): leolam zecharim teluyim binkevot unekevot bizcharim, dichtiv (divrei hayamim 1 4:18) "veishto hayehudiyya yalda et yered", (Bereshit 22:24) "ufilagsho ushemah vegomer vatteled" vegomer, (Vayikra 12:2) "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar" ad kan. gam anu mosifin limnot ben lesara vegomer.

Vesara shomaat. modia hakkatuv ki habbesora lesara bisseru kemaamar Adonai bashshelichut, vehu amro vesara shomaat vegomer vehu hamevasser acharav. veraiti bammidrash ki af al pi chen nityasser hammalach al asher lo dibber habbesora mippiv eleha vedibber leavraham, vehammalachim yeanshu al hashshogeg veal shinnuy kol shehu:

targum: Vaazalat milvateh vaagafat dasha beappaha uveappe venaha inun mekarvin lah manaya vehi merika mishcha:
Archata dechachmeta aleftach vehalechtach bishvile teritze:
Vahava yoma vaavar elisha leshunem vetaman itteta dachalat chetin veatkifat beh lemechal lachma vahava bizman meidohi mitpene letaman lemechal lachma:
Vaamar ma den at azalta levateh yoma den la yerach vela shabbeta vaamarat shelam:
Nabed kean aliyat katla zeera unetaken leh taman atar arsa ufetora vechuresaya umenarta vihe bemetohi levatana yitpene letaman:
Ureva ravya vahava yoma unefak levat avuhi levat chatzdaya:
Levatta deelaha bevattehon derashie umaamadhon detzadike yevarech:
Vaamar laavuhi reshi reshi vaamar leulema savhi ovileh leimeh:
Vaamar leh emar kean lah ha asekta lana yat kol iska hada me lemebad lich hafitgam it lich lemalala im malka o im rav chela vaamarat bego iske ami ana mesovara:
Vaamar uma lemebad lah vaamar gechazi bekusheta bar let lah uvaalah siv:
Vaamar lezimna haden beidan deattun kayamin tehe mechabbeka vera vaamarat bevau ribboni neviya dayya la yitkadev pitgamach veamtach:
Vezarezat atana vaamarat leulemaha devar veezel la tidchok alay lemirkav elahen kad emar lach:
Vahava kemishlam manaya vaamarat livrah keriv li od mana vaamar lah let od mana ufesak mishcha:
Kean rehut kean lokodamutah vaamar lah hashelam lich hashelam levaalich hashelam leravya vaamarat shelam:
Vaamar legechaze ulemeh keri leshunamita hada ukera lah vekamat kodamohi:
Shema beri vekabbel mini venisgeyun shenaya dechayach:
Vaamar kere lah ukera lah vekamat betara:
Vaamar ezili sheili lich manin min bara min kol shevavaychi manin rekanin la tazirin:
Vaazalat vaatat levat neviya dayya letur karmela vahava kad chaza neviya dayya yatah mekovel vaamar legechazi ulemeh ha shunamit dechi:
Vahava yoma veal letaman vezar leilita ushechiv taman:
Veadiat itteta viledat bar lezimna haden keidan dehi kayama di malel imah elisha:
Vetahachin vetagifin dasha veappich uveappe berach uterikin al kol manaya hailen umana deitmeli tesalkin:
Venasveh veovileh leimeh vitev al birkaha ad idan tihara umit:

Veitteta chada minshe talmide neviyaya metzavcha kodam elisha lememar avdach ovadya vaali mit veat yedaat are avdach hava dachil min kodam Adonai kad katlat izevel yat neviyaya dayya devar minhon mea gavrin veatmerinun chamshin chamshin gavrin bimarta vahava yazif umochel lehon bedil dela leochala yathon minichsohi deachav min kodam deinun onsa uchean rashya ata lemidbar yat teren bene leh leavdin:
Vaamar lah elisha ma abed lich chavi li ma it lich veveta vaamarat let leamtach kol midaam beveta elahen mana demishcha:
Kene chachmeta kene veyuna la tinshe vela tiste min maamare fumi:
Uselekat veashkavteh al arsa dinviya dayya veagafat beappohi unefakat:
Ukerat levaalah vaamarat shadar kean li chad min ulemaya vachada min atnaya veitmete levat neviya dayya veatuv:
Vaamarat levaalah ha chean yedana are neviya dayya kadisha hu mitpene levatana tedira:
Vaatat vechaviat linviya dayya vaamar ezili zabbini yat mishcha veshalmi lemare chovtich veat uvenayich titparnesin midyishtar:

bart: Haav zakkay vevitto. bekatnutah uvenaarutah:

Bekiddusheha bakkesef. shekkesef kiddusheha shello, dichtiv baama haivriyya (Shemot 21) veyatza chinnam en kasef, vedarshinan, en kesef leadon ze, kelomar laadon shekkenaah sheyyatza meitto chinnam besimane naarut, aval yesh kesef leadon acher, umannu, av, shekkesef kiddusheha shello afillu keshehi naara ad shettibbager:

Bashshetar uvabbia. shemmekabbel shetar kiddushin aleha umosrah levia leshem kiddushin lemi sheyyirtze, dichtiv vehayta, ittakkush havayot lahadade, ma kesef shehu echad min hahavayot, birshut aviha, af kiddushe shetar uvia birshut aviha:
Bimtziatah. mishshum eva:
Uvemaase yadeha. dichtiv (Shemot 21) vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama, ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah, af bat maase yadeha leaviha:
Uvahafarat nedareha. dichtiv (Bamidbar 30) binureha bet aviha:
Umekabbel gittah. dichtiv (Devarim 24) veyatza vehayta, ittakkash yetzia lahavaya, keshem shehaav mekabbel kiddusheha bekatnutah venaarutah, kach mekabbel gittah:
Veeno ochel perot bechayyeha. im naflu lah karkaot mibbet avi immah, en aviha ochel perotehen bechayyeha, ella im ken meta vehu yorshah:
Yater alav habbaal. shehu zoche bechol hashshenuyim lemala shehaav zakkay bevitto, veochel perot hannechasim shennaflu lah birushsha mishshennisset lo:
Uvefirkonah. im nishbet chayyav lifdotah:
Bikvuratah. shechachamim tikkenu kevuratah tachat yerushatah shehu yorshah im meta:
Mishshene chalilim. lehesped:
Rashe shurot haomer shekkenegdo mochiach. lekamman besamuch mefaresh la:

Anusim hayinu. ones nefashot shemma yahargennu. aval ones mamon shemma yikkach mamono [mamonenu], vechol shekken im amru bishvil rov mamon shennatan lanu, enan neemanin, deen adam mesim atzmo rasha, deadam karov etzel atzmo veeno neeman al atzmo lo lizchut velo lechova. vechen pesule edut hayinu, mechamat kurva. aval mechamat avera enan neemanim:
Yotze mimmakom acher. chatumim bishtar acher shehuchzak bevet din, uva oto shetar lefanenu im ze, uchetav chotman domin ze leshel ze:
Laggafa. geder avanim sedurot zo al zo belo tit:
Velakkelim. kele hammacharesha:

Bet shammay omrim eno shichcha. pelugetayhu devet shammay uvet hillel beomer shehechezik bo leholicho lair unetano betzad haggafa o vetzad haggadish ushechacho sham, shebbet shammay omrim eno shichcha shehare zacha vo:

Uvet hillel omrim shichcha. veha ditnan lekamman bematnitin haomer shehechezik bo leholicho lair ushechacho modim bet hillel levet shammay sheeno shichcha, zehu keshello hinnicho etzel haggafa o etzel haggadish. perush acher, bet shammay omrim eno shichcha, afillu beomer shello hechezik bo kelal lo have shichcha, dehoil vehinnicho etzel davar hammesuyyam atid lezachro, uvet hillel omrim shichcha kol zeman shello hechezik bo. umodim bet hillel sheim hechezik bo veachar kach shechacho sheeno shichcha, kidamrinan besamuch:
Lechovaot. laasot mehen kemin kova barosh, shekkach hayu regilin laasot atarot shel shibbolin velasum barosh:
Lechumsaot. enam gevohim uvoltim lemala kechovaot, ella nichpafim lematta, sheeno nire kol kach, kema detema (Devarim 32) halo hu kamus immadi:

Velacharara. katzar meat veimmer, kede legalgel issa laasot charara ketanna al gabbe gechalim. perush acher, yesh shekkotzrim hattevua umagdishim otah bemakom echad ad shettitassef, veaz nosim otah lemakom sheddashim hattevua, umekom haddisha nikra goren, uma shemmagdishim al gabbe karka nikra kovaot, kidmut kova shemmesimin barosh, uma shemmagdishim bachafira baaretz nikra kumsaot, leshon kamus immadi, uma shemmagdishim baagulla kidmut even harechayim nikra charara, al shem shehacharara agulla:
Veloomarim. asa omarim ketannim, vesofo laasot mishshenayim ushelosha omer echad:

En lo shichcha. kelomar ma sheshshachach bassade beshaa shemmolich leechad min hammekomot hallalu eno shichcha, dichtiv (sham 29) ki tiktzor ketzircha besadecha veshachachta omer bassade, ma katzir sheen acharav katzir, af immur sheen acharav immur, yatza ellu sheyyesh acharehen immur:
Mimmennu velaggoren yesh lo shichcha. hammolich meachat mehammekomot hallalu laggoren veshachach omer beachat min hammekomot hallalu, have shichcha:
Hameammer laggadish. verotze sheyyishshaaru beoto makom vesham yadush otam, yesh lo shichcha:
Mimmennu velaggoren. veim nimlach alehem achar kach umolicham lemakom acher ladush otam, en lo shichcha:

Umode rabbi yehoshua. af al gav dilel beferek kamma gabbe hi omeret mishsheerastani neenasti paleg rabbi yehoshua arabban gamliel veamar delo mehemninan laishsha bemay deamra mishsheerastani neenasti ufasla atzmah min hakkehunna bemiggo dei baya amra mukkat etz ani vehayta keshera lakkehunna, hane mile hecha deikka issur vehetter lifsol lakkehunna o lehacheshir, beha paleg rabbi yehoshua arabban gamliel veamar delo mehemninan lah bemiggo, aval hecha delekka issur vehetter ella derara demamona, kegon haomer lachavero sade zo shel avicha hayta ulekachtiha mimmennu, mode rabbi yehoshua lerabban gamliel devichhay gavna mehemninan leh bemiggo dei bae amar shelli hi veamar shel avicha hayta ulekachtiha mimmennu neeman:

Veim yesh edim shehi shel aviv eno neeman. baggemara mefaresh deha matnitin ata leashmoinan kegon shello achalah ella shete shanim bifne haav veshana achat bifne habben, kevan delo shalmu lo shalosh shene chazaka bechayye haav, hashshana sheachalah bifne habben eno ole leminyan shene chazaka:

Haav eno chayyav bimzonot bitto. bechayyav. deillu leachar mita nizzonot habbanot minnechasav mittenay ketubba. uvitto lav davka, dehu haddin beno, sheen haav chayyav lazun lo vanav velo venotav keshehem ketannim, ella im hu gavra deamid, kelomar shehu ish ashir, bet din notlim mimmennu beal karcho kederech shekkofin kol shear bene hair al hatztzedaka umefarnesim bah banav uvenotav hakketannim, veim eno gavra deamid bet din mecharfim oto umodiim oto sheachzariyyut hi lo im lo yefarnes et banav, veshehu pachut min hachayyot hammidbariyyot shehem merachamin al benehem, aval en yecholin lechofo al ze, ben shehabbanim zecharim ben nekevot. vedavka shehabbanim ketannim, aval ketanne ketannim vehem happechutim mibbene shesh, bet din kofin et haav umotziim miyyado beal karcho kede lefarnes banav shehem ketanne ketannim, echad zecharim veechad nekevot:
Bakkerem. al shem shehayu yoshvim shurot shurot kecherem:
Habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu. mittenay ketubba, shehabbanim zecharim yirshu ketubbat imman vehabbanot nekevot yizzonu minnechasav:
Ma habbanim. zecharim:
En yorshin. ketubbat imman ella leachar mitat avihen:
Kach habbanot enan nizzonot. minnichse haav mikkoach tenay ketubba ella leachar mitat avihen:
Ellu nearot. sheaf al pi shehen pesulot yesh lahen kenas. im anas adam achat mehen noten leaviha chamishshim kesef:
Hannetina. min haggivonim. veal shem shennetanam yehoshua chotve etzim veshoave mayim nikraim netinim. vehem asurim lavo vakkahal:
Veal hakkutit. hay tanna savar kutim gere arayot hem uchegoyim hem chashuvim:
Pechutot mibbat shalosh shanim. divchezkat betulot hen, sheaf al pi shennivalu bashshivya o vegeyyutan, betulehen chozrim:
Veal eshet achiv veal eshet achi aviv. shennitkaddesha leechad mehen venitgarsha min haerusin, vaadayin betula hi:

Sheaf al pi shehen behikkaret en bahen mitat bet din. vecharet eno foter min hattashlumin. vehane mile, shello hayta sham hateraa. aval im hayta sham hateraa patur min hakkenas, dekayma lan kol chayyave keretot shehitru bahen lokin, veen adam loke umeshallem:
Ketubbatah shel av. ketubbatah shehi gova mishshene erusin hallalu. vekasavar yesh ketubba laarusa. uvime naarut vekatnut kaamar:
Ketubbatah shellah. demishshehissiah paka reshuto, uvatar govayna azlinan, vegovayna batar hachi hu. velo azlinan batar ketiva lomar hoil veharishona nichteva beodah birshut haav teheve deav:
Harishona shel av. dekasavar rabbi yehuda batar ketiva azlinan, vehoil uchetubba rishona nichteva lifne hannissuin beod shehabbat birshut haav, haveya deav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Haomer pittiti et bitto shel peloni. lo mibbaya haomer anasti sheeno pogem otah kol kach, sheen laaz shel anusa gadol kol kach, difshita dimshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo, ella afillu haomer pittiti, defagim lah tefe, shellaaz shel mefutta gadol vesalka datach amina delo mehemninan leh lehachazik hallaaz, ka mashma lan denicha lah ledidah lehachazik hallaaz kede lehistakker hammamon:
Veeno meshallem kenas. demode viknas patur, deamar kera (Shemot 22) asher yarshiun elohim, perat lammarshia et atzmo:
Hemit shori et peloni. vahareni chayyav bakkofer, meshallem al pi atzmo, dekasavar kufra mamona:
Avdo shel peloni. vahareni chayyav sheloshim sela, patur, diknas ninhu, sheafillu eno shave sela noten sheloshim:

Ose makom bekofitz. garsinan. uvaggemara [daf ko] mefaresh, tane lekofitz, kelomar letzorech mekomo shel kofitz tolesh sear shel tzavvar. veen kan mishshum lo tagoz bechor tzonecha, ditlisha bayyad lav geziza hi. aval bichli vadday asur:
Vechen muttar litlosh et hassear. vaafillu lechattechilla, lehareot bo lechacham mekom hammum. vahalacha kerabbi yose ben meshullam:
Im mishshennisset. lo nisset mammash, ella im mishshehittiruha linnase bau edim shennishbet:
Lo tetze. mehetterah harishon, vetinnase lechattechilla. aval im bau edim shennitmet, afillu hayu lah kamma vanim, tetze:

Oved kochavim shekkatzar et sadehu vechulei. dichtiv gabbe leket ufea uvekutzrechem perat leshekketzaruha ovde chochavim, vegabbe shichcha ketiv (Devarim 24) ki tiktzor ketzircha veshachachta omer, mikkan amru oved kochavim shekkatzar sadehu veachar kach nitgayyer patur:

Sheen hashshichcha ella bishat immur. uvishat immur miha ger haya vechayyav bechol hammitzvot. verabbanan savre hoil veikka shichcha baomer veikka shichcha bakkama kedichtiv (sham) veshachachta omer bassade, lerabbot shichchat kama, et sheyyeshno beshichchat kama yeshno beshichchat omer, vehay oved kochavim shekkatzar shello haya beshichchat kama deotah shaa oved kochavim haya, af al pi sheachshav nitgayyer eno beshichchat omer. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shenayim shehitchilu meemtza shura. shel omarim, ze hafach panav letzafon veze hafach panav ledarom:
Veshachchu lifnehem. leachar shehitchilu leammer dillegu omer ushechachuhu, have shichcha, dekarinan beh lo tashuv lekachto (Devarim 24):

Uleacharehem eno shichcha. im keshehafchu penehem ze letzafon veze ledarom vehitchilu leammer nishar omer echad benehem ushechachuhu, eno shichcha. lefi sheshshenehem samchu ze al ze umittoch kach nishkach:
