Yachid shehitchil merosh hashshura. hasheta mefaresh leha ditnan leel rashe shurot haomer shekkenegdo mochiach. kegon sheyyesh kan eser shurot shel eser eser omarin mesuddarin beshurot mitztzafon ledarom vehitchil leammer berosh shura achat veshachach omer echad leacharav, have shichcha, kevan sheavar mimmennu veimmer omer hassamuch lo karinan beh lo tashuv lekachto, aval im shachach omer echad o shenayim besof hashshura, dehaynu lefanav, vehinnicham vechazar vehitchil leammer mittechillat shura sheniyya, lo have shichcha, delo karinan beh lo tashuv, sheani omer dato laasot shura acheret meotam shehinniach mimmizrach lemaarav. vehayenu ditnan haomer shekkenegdo mochiach, shehoomarim [shel] shurot acherot mochichim al ellu shehinniach shello shechachan, sheruyin lehitchashshev immahen beshura acheret:

Rabbi eliezer omer zacha lo. pelugta derabbi eliezer verabbanan beashir shellakat pea lizkot bah leani. derabbi eliezer savar amrinan tere miggo, miggo dei vae mafkar lenichseh vahave ani vechaze leh, hasheta nammi chaze leh, umiggo dei vae zache lenafsheh zache nammi lechavreh. verabbanan savre chad miggo amrinan, tere miggo lo amrinan. aval meani leani, divre hakkol zacha lo:
Shel oved kochavim chayyav bemaasrot. dehoil veen haoved kochavim chayyav beleket shichcha ufea havo lehu kishar tevua shel oved kochavim shechayyevet bemaaser:
Ella im ken hifkir. laaniyyim velaashirim, dehefker patur min hammaaser. umatnitin rabbi meir hi deamar en kinyan leoved kochavim beeretz yisrael lehafekia min hammaaser. veen ken halacha:

Kama ufada omarim petura. demikkera dimmaatinan ketzir ovde kochavim memaatinan nammi ketzir hekdesh, delav ketzircha hu. uleinyan shichcha pelige rabbi yehuda verabbanan behikdish kama ufada omarim, ki hechi diflige beoved kochavim shekkatzar sadehu veachar kach nitgayyer:
Hechashud al habbechorot. kohen hechashud lehattil mum babbechor:
Besar tzevaim. sheadom hu umachalif bivsar egel, vezimnin dimzabben bechor egel tamim veomer shebbesar tzevi hu, deen lachush livchora:
Velo orot sheenan avudim. aval avudim zavninan minneh, dei ita divchor hava lo hava tarach beh, savar shame ve rabbanan umafsede leh minnay:

Lokchim mimmennu orot shel nekeva. demeda yedie. vetanna kamma deasar, savar dilma chatech lezachruteh vaavid beh kemin nakvut, vechi meshayyele leh ma chittuch ze shebbimkom nakvut, omer achbarim achaluhu. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Melubban vetzoi. pershu vaggemara dimlubban mitztzoi kaamar, kelomar meruchatz mitztzoato. velo amrinan i divchor hu lo mafsid tircheh velo melabben leh desavar shame rabbanan umafsede leh minnay, dechevan detircheh zuta hu tarach umelabben leh velo kafed aleh:
Aval lokchin mimmennu tavuy uvegadim. dei divchor hu chulle hay lo tarach behu, dekafed attircheh dilma mafsede leh minneh:
Tavuy uvegadim. lav begadim mammash kaamar. dehashta tavuy gereda lokchin mimmennu, begadim arugim mibbaya. ella vegadim hayenu levadim asuyim mitztzemer sheenan tevuyin:
Haones noten et hatztzaar. sheeno dome nivelet beones lenivelet beratzon, vehamefutta en lah tzaar, shehare neemar innuy battora etzel ones velo neemar innuy etzel mefutta:
Haones noten miyyad. leaviha af al pi shekkonsah:

Lichsheyyotzi. kelomar lichshello yichnos. sheim yichnos eno noten kenas, kedichtiv (Shemot 22) mahor yimharenna veim maen yemaen kesef yishkol. aval gabbe ones ketiv (Devarim 22) venatan chamishshim kesef velo tihye leishsha:
Shote vaatzitzo. bichli maus shebbachar bo, kelomar al karcho yissaenna:

Bet shammay omrim hevker laaniyyim. mi shehifkir laaniyyim velo laashirim din hefker yesh lo, ufatur min hammaaser, dichtiv beleket ufea (Vayikra 19) leani velagger taazov otam, ma talmud lomar taazov otam, limmed al aziva acheret dehaynu hefker, shehi kazo, ma zo laaniyyim velo laashirim, af ma shenneemar bemakom acher laaniyyim velo laashirim:

Af laashirim kashshemitta. dichtiv (Shemot 25) vehashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah, ma talmud lomar unetashtah, limmed al netisha acheret, dehaynu hefker, shehi kashsheviit, ma sheviit laaniyyim velaashirim, af hefker laaniyyim velaashirim:
Leolam hi virshut haav. im bat yisrael meoreset lechohen hi enah ochelet batteruma, vaafillu higgia hazzeman shekkavu lannissuin velo nisset shehabbaal chayyav bimzonoteha enah ochelet batteruma:
Ad shettikkanes lachuppa. leshem nissuin, shettehe mesura lirshut habbaal:
Masru sheluche haav. sheppagu sheluche haav bishluche habbaal umesaruha lahem:
Shechiv mera. hashshochev al mittato mechamat choli:

Shiyyer karka kol shehu. kol hanne shiyyer karka kol shehu. ditnan bematnitin mikkan vead sof pirkin, lav davka karka, dehu haddin mittaltelim kol shehen. ella ayde detana resha gabbe pea uvikkurim uferozbul karka kol shehu, tana bechol hanach nammi karka kol shehu:
Mattenato kayyemet. im kanu miyyado al hammattana, af al pi sheamad mechalyo eno yachol lachazor bo, hoil veshiyyer leatzmo kol shehu galle dateh delav mechamat mita katav hammattana:
Lo shiyyer karka kol shehu. leatzmo, missetama lo shavik inash nafsheh artilai, veim lo shehaya choshev vadday sheyyamut lo haya noten kol nechasav, hilkach im amad chozer, vaafillu kanu miyyado:

Vechatav leishto karka kol shehu ibbeda ketubbatah. bishchiv mera mayre, shemmechallek nechasav levanav, vechatav leishto chelek ben habbanim, veshama ihi veshatka velo amra ketubbati ani gova o kayyotze vaze, ibbeda ketubbatah:

Rabbi yose omer im kibbela aleha. shettehe shuttefet ben habbanim, afillu lo kanu miyyadah, vehu lo tzivva sheyyichtevu kach befaneha, ibbeda ketubbatah veshuv enah yechola lachazor bah. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Ani haya beotah shaa. ufatur milleshallem. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shalosh avayot bayyom. shalosh peamim mitgalle baal habbayit venire betoch sadehu kede sheyyikchu haaniyyim pea. avayot leshon gilluy, nivu matzpunav (Ovadya 1) metargeminan iggalyan matmerohi:
Bashshachar. mippene hammenikot shebbenehem yeshenim bashshachar veaz yesh lahem penay lilkot:
Uvachatzot. mippene hattinokot sheddarkan latzet bachatzot veholchim lilkot pea:
Uvammincha. mippene hazzekenim haholchim al mishantam veen maggiim lassade ad sheat hammincha:
Shello yifchatu. mishshalosh ittim hallalu. vahalacha sheen notnin pea ella beshalosh ittim hallalu, en pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehem:

Shel bet namer. shem makom, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 32) et bet nimra. koshrim chevel betzad hakkama vekotzrim veholchim ad sheyyichle hachevel, umannichim pea lechol hachevel, vechozrim vekoshrim umannichim pea, vehayenu mikkol umman veumman, kelomar mikkol shura veshura, veal ze mazkirin otan leshevach:

Yetoma shennitarsa venitgarsha haones chayyav vehamefatte fatur. dechevan ditoma hi ukenasah shellah hu, ha achilteh gabbeh, demiddatah nitpatteta lo, ufatur. velo yetoma bilvad, ella kol naara shennitarsa venitgarsha ones chayyav umefatte patur kitoma, deha kenasah leatzmah kidamar rabbi akiva leel, vechen halacha:
Shete nashim shennishbu. sheyyesh edim shennishbu:
Shemmeidot zo et zo. kol achat omeret chaverti tehora:

Hare ellu neemanot. devishvuya hekellu lehacheshir ed echad vaafillu eved vaafillu ishsha vaafillu katan mesiach lefi tummo. uvilvad sheyyaid haed shello ferash mimmenna mishshaa shennishbet ad sheyyatza mershut haggoyim:

Hammocher sadehu. shemmachar lo sade vekamatah. aval machar et hakkama bilvad veshiyyer hassade leatzmo, shenehem asurim beleket shichcha ufea, sheetzel ze ani kore sadcha veetzel ze ani kore ketzircha:
Hammocher muttar. beleket shichcha ufea im hu ani:
Al menat sheyyelakket beno acharav. sheal yede chen happoel menakke lo min hassechirut, venimtza porea chovo mishshel aniyyim:

Al tasseg gevul olim. kelomar al tikre olam ella olim, it dimfarshe ellu ole mitzrayim, shello teshanne haazharot shebbattora shennittena leyotze mitzrayim, veit dimfarshe olim ellu bene adam sheyyardu minnichsehem, vekare lehu olim leshon kavod, kederech shekkorin leivver saggi nahor:
Natal. echad min haaniyyim miktzat pea shellikket kevar vezarak lo al hashshear kede liknot:
En lo vah kelum. afillu bema shellikket, dekonsin oto umotziin mimmennu hattalush vehamechubbar:

Nafal lo aleha vechulei. af al gav dearba ammot shel adam konot lo besimta uvetzidde reshut harabbim, hacha bisde chavero lo takkinu leh rabbanan sheyyiknu lo arba ammotav. i nammi kevan denafal aleha galle dateh devinfila nicha leh dilkene, bearba ammot lo nicha leh dilkene:
Hannosher bishat hakketzira. shibbolim hannoflim bishat hakketzira:
Hikkahu kotz. kol hecha denosher mechamat ones eno leket, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) veleket ketzircha, en leket ella mechamat katzir:

Toch hayyad. annashar kae, kelomar toch hayyad venashar, toch hammaggal venashar, dehannosher mittoch hayyad umittoch hammaggal laaniyyim. aval hannosher meachar hayyad minnidnud yado umeachar hammaggal mikkoach tenuat hammaggal, levaal habbayit, deen ze bederech ketzira:
Rosh hayyad. kesheyyado melea veyesh shibbolim ben rashe etzbeotav lefas yado, hannosher mishsham, vechen hannosher merosh hammaggal:
Rabbi yishmael omer laaniyyim. dedame letoch hayyad uletoch hammaggal:
Verabbi akiva omer levaal habbayit. dimdamme leh leachar hayyad uleachar hammaggal. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Enan neemanim. litten lahem teruma:
Uvizman shehen meidin ze al ze. shekkol echad omer ani vachaveri kohen:
Haishsha shennitarmela o nitgarsha. vetovaat ketubbatah:
Hu omer. kae annitgarsha. vei annitarmela, hayyorshim omrim almana nesaach avinu veen lach ella mane:
Hinnuma. ikka man deamar chuppa shel hadas sheosim labbetulot. veikka man deamar tzaif shennotnim al haenayim umitnamnemet bo:
Veroshah parua. saarah al ketefah. kach hayu nohagim lehotzi habbetulot mibbet avihen levet hachatuna:

Af chilluk kelayot. bimkomo shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hayu nohagim lechallek kelayot benissue habbetulot. vei lekka sahade sheasu venissueha keminhag nissue habbetulot, ushetar hakketubba avad, baal meheman veenah gova ella mane:

Hannotel sachar ladun dinav betelim. dichtiv (Devarim 4) ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai, ma ani bechinnam af attem bechinnam. uverabbane ashkenaz raiti shaaruriyya bedavar ze, shello yevosh harav hannismach rosh yeshiva littol asara zehuvim kede lihyot chatzi shaa al ketivat unetinat get echad, vehaedim hachotmim al hagget shene zehuvim o zahuv lechol happachot lechol echad, veen ze harav beenay ella gazlan veannas, lefi shehu yodea sheen notnim beiro get shello virshuto, venoten hagget beal karcho tzarich sheyyitten lo kol cheftzo. vechoshesh ani leget ze shehu pasul, deha tenan bematnitin hannotel sachar ladun dinav betelin. lehaid eduto betela:
Lehazzot. mimme chattat al teme met:
Lekaddesh. learev efer chattat bemayim chayyim el keli:
Efer mikle. efer kira keruya efer mikle. kelomar efer bealma sheen bah kedushsha:

Aval im haya. ze roe habbechorot, o ze haddayyan o haed o hamekaddesh, kohen, veheeviro hammolicho immo bimkom tuma vetimmeahu mitterumato, umafsido shetztzarich liknot chullin veleechol udeme chullin yekarim middeme teruma, shehachullin reuyin lakkol uteruma enah reuya ella lechohanim tehorim:
Maachilo. ze hammolicho, umashkehu vesacho:

Venoten lo secharo chefoel. im haya ragil bimlacha cheveda vekasha umarviach bah harebe, omdim kamma adam kaze rotze littol pachot mimma shehaya marviach bimlacha cheveda ulehitassek bimlacha zo shehi kalla, vechach noten lo. vechen muttar lechol dayyan littol sechar battala keshehabbattala nikkeret umefursemet, velokeach mishshene vaale haddin beshave. veyoter mizze asur:
Gadish shello lukkat tachtav. mi sheasaf vehigdish et hoomarim lemakom echad betoch hassade sheadayin lo laktu sham haaniyyim et halleket:
Kol hannogot baaretz laaniyyim. diknasuhu rabbanan lefi shehigdish al gav halleket, vaafillu higdish chittim al gabbe leket shel seorim have kol hannogea min hachittim baaretz laaniyyim:
Haruach sheppizzera et hoomarim. al gabbe halleket:

Kede nefila. kede shiur sheragil lippol bishat ketzira, shehem arbaa kabbin lechor zera, vehakkor hu sheloshim sein. umishshum deamar tanna kamma omdim kamma leket reuya laasot, ka mashma lan rabban shimon ben gamliel en haddavar tzarich omed, shekkevar katzuv veomed kede nefila, bishloshim sein shel zera ragil lippol mimmennu bishat ketzira arbaa kabbin, vechach yitten laaniyyim:

Kol makom sheyyesh mecher. laav bevitto, dehaynu bekatnutah, en lo vah kenas, deen kenas liktanna. velet hilchata keha matnitin, deha matnitin rabbi meir hi deamar ketanna en lah kenas. aval chachamim omrim ketanna yesh lah kenas, vahalacha kachachamim. uketanna leinyan ze hi mibbat shalosh ad shetem esre shana veyom echad vetavi shete searot:
Kol makom sheyyesh kenas. mishshehi naara. vehi keshettihye vat shetem esre shana veyom echad vehevia shete searot, shezzo yesh lah kenas:
En macher. sheen adam mocher et bitto keshehi naara:
Habbogeret. mibbat shetem esre shana veshishsha chodashim veyom echad vehevia shete searot hi hannikret bogeret, veen aviha yachol lemachrah, veen lah kenas:
Afillu mayim umelach. mishshum kenas:
Kol sheyyesh bo zikkat terumot. kol davar shetteruma noheget bo. vechol, laatoye kirve dagim shemmearvin bahen shemen zayit, sheyyesh bo zikat teruma. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:

Al yede mamon mutteret levalah. shemmefachadin lehafesid mamonam velo mafkere lah. vedavka kesheyyad yisrael takkifa al haovde chochavim, az mutteret levalah afillu balah kohen, velo dami lishvuya, mishshum demirtete lehafesid mamonan. aval kesheyyad haovde chochavim takkifa, afillu al yede mamon asura levalah im balah kohen. veim balah yisrael mutteret bechol inyan, deeshet yisrael shenneensa mutteret levalah:
Al yede nefashot. shehayta niddonet lemavet, asura afillu levalah yisrael, dechayshinan shemma nivala beratzon leechad mehen:
Karkom. targum matzor, karkoma:

Pesulot. asurot lechohen, deeshet kohen asura keshenneensa. veim yesh bair machavoa achat sheyyechola ishsha achat lehechave sham, kol achat veachat minneshe hair neemanot lomar bammachavoa nechbeti velo nitmeti, umittoch sheyyechola lomar nechbeti, neemenet gam ken kesheamra lo nechbeti velo nitmeti:
Hammaon hazze. shevua hi:

En adam meid al yede atzmo. veim heid adam al shevuya shehi tehora, hare ze lo yissaenna im hu kohen, mippene hachashad. veim pada otah min hashshevi bemamono, hare ze meid aleha venosah, delo shade enash zuze bichdi, veim lo yada shehi tehora lo natan mamono aleha:

Hakkol lefi hamevayyesh. adam benoni hamevayyesh, bashto kasha meadam bazuy umeadam chashuv. kach matzati beferushe rabbotay. uveferek hachovel matzati deadam kal shebbiyyesh, bashto merubba. vechen ikkar:
Vehammitbayyesh. lefi chashivuto bashto:

Keillu hi shifcha. omdin kamma adam rotze litten ben shifcha betula leshifcha beula lehassiah leavdo sheyyesh lerabbo korat ruach hemennu. uvaggemara parech menalan denoten boshet ufegam vatzaar, ema chamishshim kesef amar rachamana lechol mile. umetaretz, amar kera (Devarim 22) venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kesef, hanaat shechiva levad hi chamishshim kesef, chutz mehabboshet vehappegam vehatztzaar:
Hallokeach. ez bat shenatah. sheyyalda vetoch shenatah:
Vadday. oto havvalad lakkohen, dekodem lachen lo yalda:
Safek. yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyeachel bemumo labbealim. veim sefek peter chamor hu, mafrish tale vehu shello:

Tinnuf. avabuot shel dam sheppoletet habbehema. umarim otan leroe chacham umakkir bahen im hen mechamat herayon shehippila veshemma tinnefa vetoch shenatah dahave sefek valad veniftera min habbechora, hilkach afillu ez bat shenatah safek hu:
Shilya. kemin kissuy al haubbar shehaubbar munnach bah:

Shafir. lemala min hashshilya kerum sheyyesh bo dam nikrash vehu karuy shafir. verabbotay pershu, chaticha shel basar sheyyesh bah tzurat adam. veyesh omrim lefichach nikret shafir, lefi sheasuya chishfoferet:
Sheshshafa chararat dam. shehippila chaticha dam:
Hare zo tikkaver. lehodia shenniftera min habbechora. sheharoe shekkovrim otah yodea shehabba acharav eno kadosh babbechora. vahalacha kerabbi akiva ucherabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

Mumche. hu shennatal reshut min hannasi o mibbet din shel eretz yisrael lehattir bechorot. veaf al gav divalma mi shellamad battora [shebbichtav v]shebbeal pe veyodea lisbor ulehakkish ulehavin davar mittoch davar hu hannikra mumche, ucheshehu nikkar veyadua veyatza tivo etzel anshe doro hu mumche larabbim, vehu yachol ladun yechidi, veaf al gav delo nakat reshuta merosh gola, leinyan hetter bechorot eno karuy mumche, veeno yachol lehattir bechorot ella achar sheyyittol reshut mibbet din hassemuchim beeretz yisrael, veen reshut rosh haggola moil baze:

Vishallem mibbeto. ucheshehu meshallem lakkohen noten revia damav im hi vehema dakka, vachatzi damav im hi gassa. umishshum hachi meshallem mechetza, demamon hammuttal besafek cholkim, deikka lememar afsedeh, dei lo hava share leh hay hava ate mumche gamur veshare leh vahava achil leh vehasheta vae kevura, veikka lememar lav midi afsedeh, dedilma lo hava veh muma, umumche gamur lo hava share leh, veshemma lo hava nafel beh mum kavua leolam ad sheyyamut. vehay delo meshallem palga ledakka chemo legassa, mippene sheyyesh torach gadol legaddel behema dakka veze shehittir habbechor hitztzilo lakkohen min hattorach haggadol shehaya lo lehittappel bah, deshemma im herahu leacher lo haya mattiro vehaya lo vo tippul merubbe ad sheyyippol bo mum, lehachi nagu vah delo meshallem ella revia. verambam pershah beinyan acher. veze ikkar:
Ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto. leman dedain dina degarme chayyav leshallem mibbeto bishvil sheggaram hefsed lachavero. uman delo dain dina degarme mefaresh matnitin davka shennasa venatan bayyad.
Zikka et hachayyav. mashkachat la kegon shehaya lo mashkon lammalve veze patar et hallove venatal et hammashkon beyado miyyad hammalve vehecheziro lallove.

Vetimme et hattahor. nammi mashkachat la shennasa venatan bayyad, kegon sheheviu lefanav tohorot lishshael alehen veamar temeot hen venatal sheretz echad vehiggio vahen kede shello yehe vahen od safek veyaamdu devarav.
Vetiher et hattame. kegon shellakach perot tehorot veervan im perot ellu shettiher hu shello chaddin vetimmean:
Veim haya mumche levet din. shennatal reshut mibbet din:
Patur. delo matze lememar leh ammay daynat leh hoil velo vekiat bedine:
Haem shellah. rechem shellah:
Veheechilah rabbi tarfon lichlavim. sheshshaalu lo aleha veamar terefa veheechilah lichlavim:

Shello teled. mippene shepparot vachazirot shellahen meullin meod umochrim otan beyoker, verotzim shello yeldu bemalchut acheret kede sheyyihyu tzerichim lahem, vechotchim haem shellah veenah meta, hilkach lav terefa hi:
Halcha chamorcha tarfon. hifsadta chamorcha, sheatta tzarich lemachro kede leshallem deme happara livaleha:

Shemmumche atta. chada veod kaamar leh, chada detoe bidvar mishna hu, dematnitin hi beellu terefot nittela haem shellah keshera, vekayma lan detoe bidvar mishna chozer haddin vedanin oto charauy veeno meshallem. veod, i nammi beshikkul haddaat taita deissurecha issur velo matzet lemihdar venimtza sheatta hifsadto, afillu hachi patur atta, lefi sheatta mumche. veshikkul haddaat, hayenu chegon tere tannae o tere amorae diflige velo ittemar hilchata lo chemar velo chemar, vesugeyan dealma kechad minnayhu, vaazal hu vaavad keidach, ma sheasa asuy umeshallem mibbeto:
Kol shenem asar chodesh. mishshennolad:
Leachar shenato. kegon bazzeman hazze detzarich lekayyemo ad sheyyippol bo mum:
Eno rashshay lekayyemo ella ad sheloshim yom. miyyom shennafal bo hammum:
Vezinneta. min haerusin vehi naara:
Hare zo bechenek. vaafillu nitgayyera pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim divchezkat betula hi. dechi ketiva sekila benaara meorasa bevat yisrael ketiv, dichtiv (Devarim 22) ki asta nevala beyisrael:
Velo mea sala. im nimtza habbaal shakran. dechullah parasha beyisrael ketiva:

Veledatah bikdushsha hare zo viskila. deamar kera (sham) usekaluha baavanim vameta, sheen tzarich lomar vameta ella lerabbot horatah shello vikdushsha. umihu liknas lo merabbinan lah, dilmita nitrabbet velo liknas:
Yesh lah av. beyisreelit kamayre:
Veen lah petach bet av. kegon sheen laav bayit:

Kol pesule hammukdashin. kadashim shennafal bahem mum, im mochrin otan beyoker, tovat hanaa lahekdesh hu. hilkach nimkarim baitliz, dehaynu shuk shemmochrim bo shear besar chullin vesham nimkar beyoker:
Venishkalin belitra. lehimmacher kederech shehakkatztzavim mochrim besar chullin. demittoch sheyyecholim limkor beyoker mosifim baddamim kesheppodim otam min hahekdesh:

Chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. sheim nimkarim beyoker hanaatan labbealim. bechor hanaato lakkohen, divsar bechor neechol lechol adam vehakkohen mochro venotel damav, velakkohen kare bealim shel bechor. umishshum hanaat hedyot lo mezalzelinan bakkadashim linhog bahen minhag chullin lemachran baitliz, ella beveto, veaf al pi shello yikpetzu alehem bene adam kol kach. veen nishkalim belitra ella veomed, veim yafsid let lan bah:

Veshoklin mana cheneged mana babbechor. sheim yesh lo chatichat besar chullin shennishkela belitra yachol lishkol besar bechor kenegdah. aval maaser en shoklim mana keneged mana, demechaze cheillu mochro, uvehemat maaser asur lemachrah kelal mishshum delo chetiv bah lo yippade kederech shekkatuv babbechor ella lo yiggael, veshaninu besifri bechor shenneemar bo lo yippade, hu nimkar, maaser shenneemar bo lo yiggael eno nimkar lo chay velo shachut velo tamim velo vaal mum:
Naara. vehatztzaar battefusa. vehatztzaar nammi leaviha baanusa:
Met haav. mishsheamda vaddin benaarutah, ben bagra kodem mita ben lo vagra, hare hen shel achin, dechevan deamda vaddin zacha vahen av:
Lo hispika laamod baddin vechulei. kevan delo amad baddin lav mamon hu lehorisho levanav:

Rabbi shimon omer. af al pi sheamda baddin lo have mamon deav lehorisho levanav ad demate lideh, dichtiv (Devarim 22) venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef, lo zikketa tora laav ella mishsheat netina. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Maase yadeha. sheasta bechayye aviha, af al pi shello gavta, kegon sechar peulla:

Umetziatah. baggemara parech, metziatah mimman gavya. umeshane, hachi kaamar, maase yadeha kimtziatah, ma metziatah bechayye haav laav achar mitat haav leatzmah, kelomar sheen haachim zochim bema shemmatza habbat leachar mitat haav, kach maase yadeha bechayye haav laav, vezachu vahen haachim af al pi shello gavta sechar peullatah. aval maase yadeha shelleachar mitat haav leatzmah, veen laachin zechut bemaase yede habbat sheosa leachar mitat haav:

Rabbi yehuda mattir. bemumin shebbaayin mode rabbi yehuda deasur, mippene shehen mishtannim leachar mita, shemmippene tzaar mita haayin mishtanna, veaf al gav dehashta mitchaze mum kavua i hava chaze leh mechayyim hava mitchaze over, velo share ella vemumin shebbagguf sheenan mishtannim. verabbi meir savar gazrinan mumin shebbagguf sheenan mishtannim attu mumin shebbaayin shehen mishtannim. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Yeterot al benot shalosh shanim. dechevan diruyot levia bechezkat hefker hen, venivalot begeyyutan, vehashshevuya beshivyatah:
Hare hi vikdushshatah. veenah bechezkat beula af al pi shennishbet keshehi gedola. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh. ha im yihye ason beechad mishshene ellu haanashim hammerivin, shenneherag echad mehen, lo yeanesh hahoreg bemamon, shehare hu chayyav mitat bet din kevan sheharago laze. veen hefresh baavera shechayyavin aleha mitat bet din ben shogeg lemezid, leolam patur mittashlumin. aval baavera shechayyavin aleha karet o malkot, eno patur min hattashlumin ad sheyyihye sham edim vehateraa veyilke, veaz eno meshallem:
Ad shello vau leonat hammaasrot. hayenu meruach, keshehu mashve pene hakkeri berachat, im beotah shaa hayu beyad haggizbar peturim, veim lav en hahekdesh potran:
Ugemaran haggizbar. shennigmeru beodan beyad haggizbar:
Akavya ben mahalalel mattir. hatztzemer bahanaa lakkohen:

Vachachamim osrim. dei sharet leh tzemer hannosheret mechayyim ate leashhoye labbechor kede shettashshir tzimro kol shaa, veate vah lide takkala sheyyigzoz veyaavod bo, ufesule hammukdashin asire vegizza vaavoda dichtiv tizbach veachalta basar, tizbach velo gizza:

Lo vaze hittir akavya. kelomar lo vaze akavya mattir vachachamim osrim, devishchato divre hakkol share, demiggo dimhanneya shechita latztzemer hamechubbar bo lehattiro leachar shechita mehanneya nammi letalush umunnach bachallon. velo nechleku ella vemet, deoto tzemer hamechubbar bo taun kevura, akavya mattir latztzemer shennashar mimmennu keshehu bachayyim, vachachamim osrim, gezera shemma yashhennu kede lehanot batztzemer shennosher mimmennu kol shaa veate lemeevad beh gizza vaavoda. ufesak hahalacha, daafillu leachar shechita tzemer shennashar mimmennu bachayyim asur:
Tzemer hameduvlal. shello nitlash legamre aval mechubbar hu im hatztzemer veeno nofel:
Et shennire im haggizza. kesheyyishchatennu vegozzo leachar shechita, vihe hatztzemer hameduvlal nivlal im shear haggizza veeno nire chemufrash mimmenna, muttar kishar haggizza:
Vesheeno nire im haggizza. sheyyatza chutz yoter midday venikkar lakkol (shamedabelal) [shemmuvdal] min haggizza:
Asur. kemi shennashar legamre kodem shechita. usetama cherabbanan diflige aleh daakavya dehilchata chevatayhu:
Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan kulei. vechol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman. hanach tarte bave perashnu leel bemassechet chullin:
Hallokeach ubbar parato. af al pi sheeno rashshay. limkor lo behema gassa:
Kechamesh selaim shel pidyon habben. dechayyav beacharayuto:

Kefidyon maaser sheni. deim avad eno chayyav beacharayuto. dehahi kesef chayyeveh rachamana leechol birushalayim veha azal leh. vetaama derabbi eliezer, shekken matzinu shehikkish hakkatuv peter chamor livchor adam, shenneemar ufeter chamor tifde vese vegomer‏ vechol bechor banecha tifde. vachachamim omrim ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde, lifdiyya hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher:
Sheen kan lakkohen kelum. sheen chayyav beacharayuto, kerabbanan. vechen halacha:
Met peter chamor. leachar shehifrish happidyon, vaadayin lo netano lakkohen:
Rabbi eliezer omer yikkaver. dehoil vehu chayyav beacharayut hattale, keman delo afresheh dame:
Umuttar. yisrael bahanaato shel tale kemi shello hifrisho:
En tzarich lehikkaver. demeiddana deafresheh lattale kam leh birshut kohen vehufkea kedushshato shel peter chamor. vechen halacha:
Ze chetav yado shel abba. umekayyemin hashshetar al piv, shekkiyyum shetarot derabbanan vehemnuhu rabbanan bidrabbanan:
Sheyyatzta vehinnuma veroshah parua. venotelet ketubba matayim. veaf al gav delo mafkinan mamona ella beedut berura, hacha shane, hoil verov nashim betulot nissaot, gilluy milleta bealma hu:
Veshehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer. keshehayinu lomdin tinokot bevet rabban:

Leechol batteruma. veal pi edut zo maachilin leh teruma derabbanan, kegon teruma shemmotziin meatzitz sheeno nakuv vechayyotze vaze. aval teruma deorayyta en maachilin al pi edut kaze. velo chayshinan shemma eved kohen haya, sheasur lelammed et haeved tora:
Veshehaya cholek immanu al haggoren. velo chayshinan shemma eved kohen haya, sheen cholkim teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo:
Veshehammakom hazze bet happeras. hachoresh et hakkever hare ze ose bet happeras mea amma, shekkach shiaru shehammacharesha molechet atzmot hammet. vetumat bet happeras derabbanan:
Vead kan hayinu vain beshabbat. ditchumim derabbanan:
Maamad umisped. makom haya lo kan lehasepid metav velaasot maamadot umoshavot shehayu osin lammet, beha lo meheman, shehu davar shebbemamon vetzarich edut gemura:
Ad kamma. lehittappel bivchor. lehitassek begiddulo kodem sheyyittenehu lakkohen:

Bedakka ad sheloshim yom uvegassa ad chamishshim. baggemara yalfinan la middichtiv (Shemot 22) meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher bechor banecha titten li, usemich leh ken taase leshorcha letzonecha, veraminan shorcha hammukdam bammikra limleatcha vedimacha shehu mukdam, vetzonecha hameuchar livchor banecha shehu meuchar, umeleatcha vedimacha shehem habbikkurim kerevim lachamishshim yom, shehattevua mevushshelet befesach veen meviin bikkurim ad atzeret dichtiv (sham 23) vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha, uchemo sheatta ose limleatcha vedimacha sheencha meviam ella lesof chamishshim yom, ken taase leshorcha shello teviennu ad chamishshim yom, uchederech sheatta ose livchor banecha dichtiv beh (Bamidbar 18) ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde, ken taase letzoncha shello teviennu ad sheloshim yom:
Bedakka shelosha chodashim. lefi shettippulah merubbe, sheshshinneha dakkot veenah yechola leechol esev, veim lo tihye im immah tamut. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Lo yitteno lo. dechevan deal yisrael ramya letappel bo chamishshim yom veamar lo chohen betoch zeman ze tenehu li veerennu, dome chemi shessochro, shehu matztzilo min hattorach al menat sheyyittenennu lo velo lechohen acher, vedome lechohen hamesayyea bevet haggeranot ladush velizrot kede sheyyittenu lo hatterumot, vetanya chohanim uleviyyim hamesayyeim bevet haggeranot en notnin lahem terumot umaasrot. aval im haya baal mum veamar lo ten li sheochlennu, hoil vachazi leh lo have kechohen hamesayyea bevet haggeranot:

Ben tamim ben baal mum. ben bizman hammikdash uven achshav, kol shana dideh rashshay lekayyemo. uvechor baal mum yalfinan shehu nittan lakkohen veochlo vemumo middichtiv (sham) uvesaram yihye lach, leshon rabbim, echad bechor tam veechad bechor baal mum:
Rachel sheyyalda chemin ez. af al gav detarvayhu minim chayyavim babbechora, afillu hachi im eno dome leimmo patur min habbechora. dichtiv ach bechor shor, ad sheyyehe hu [shor] uvechoro shor:
Veim yesh bo miktzat simanim. sheddome leimmo ad shehu nikkar bahen shehu meoto hammin, chayyav:
Hare ellu neemanim. deha ikka tere sahade al kol ketav uchetav:
Tzerichim letzaref immahem acher. sheal ketav yadan hen meidin lo al mane shebbashshetar. vetzarich tere sahade al kol ketav uchetav:

Vachachamim omrim enam tzerichin letzaref immahem acher. sheal mane shebbashshetar hem meidim, ucheshezze omer ze chetav yadi veze omer ze chetav yadi nimtzeu shene edim al mane shebbashshetar. vahalacha kachachamim:
Chore hannemalim. derech hannemalim lichnos tevua bechorehen:
Shebbetoch hakkama. ad shello hitchilu liktzor:
Shel baal habbayit. sheen laaniyyim bakkama kelum:

Shelleachar hakkotzrim. leachar shehitchilu liktzor chayshinan shemma heviu sham hannemalim min halleket. hilkach hachittim haelyonim shebbachorim o shibbolim haelyonim laaniyyim, deyesh sham min halleket, aval chittim hattachtonim levaal habbayit, demin hakkama haya. veelu hen elyonim, kol shehen levanim. veelu hen tachtonim, hayerukim shennotim lehashechir venikkarim shehem yeshanim:
Rabbi meir omer hakkol laaniyyim. shei efshar laggoren belo yerakon, veshemma ellu hayerukim min hattevua chadasha shekkatzru achshav sheyyesh bah chelek laaniyyim:
Shessefek leket leket. dichtiv (sham) leani velagger taazov hannach lifnehem mishshellecha. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Happea nittenet bimchubbar. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) leani velagger taazov, hannach lifnehem vehem yavozu:
Bedalit. gefen hammudlet al gabbe etzim o al gabbe ilanot:
Morid umechallek. dichtiv (sham) taazov otam, otam sheen bahem sakkana atta ozev lifnehem vei atta ozev otam sheyyesh sakkana baaliyyatam, ella morid min hailan umechallek lahem:
Bachalike egozim. al shem sheilanot shel egozim chalakim veen bahem kesharim kishar ilanot keruyin chalike egozim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Afillu tishim vetisha. aresha kae, befea hannittenet bimchubbar:

En megalgelin betofeach. min kitnit dak, shekkorin lo baaravi 96. verambam peresh shehu min zera shekkorin lo 405 vedome lisorim. veomer rabbi meir sheen megalgelin ze hammin im shear mine zeraim, liktzor otam beyachad, ki halleket shehaya rauy lippol mishshear mine zeraim yippol mizze hammin haggarua, venimtza mafsid laaniyyim:

Vachachamim mattirim mippene sheefshar. sheyyippol leket mishshear zeraim kemo min hattofeach. vahalacha kachachamim. perush acher en maalin mayim baggalgal min habbor lehashekot et hassade o leharebitzah ad sheyyehe mashke tofeach aleha beshaa shehaaniyyim baim bishvil halleket, mippene shehu mafsid laaniyyim. vachachamim mattirin, mippene sheefshar sheyyashumu hahefsed shel aniyyim baze veyitten baal hassade kefi hashshuma sheyyashumu alav, ulerabbi meir deamar en megalgelin, shamin levaal habbayit hefsedo venotel min haaniyyim:
Velo shechacho vaal habbayit. kegon devaal habbayit bassade, dekae gabbeh vezache veh. aval baal habbayit bair have shichcha af al gav delo shechacho baal habbayit:

Hamekabbel tzon barzel min hannachri. sheshsham lo hannachri behemotav bedamim ketzuvim velatet lo otan damim ad eser shanim ben metu ben huzelu, veotan veladot sheyyihyu lahen ad oto zeman yehu venehen:

Veladot peturin. min habbechora. valdotehen shel otan tzon kesheyyigdelu vivakkeru yippatru min habbechora. dei lo yahev zuze lannachri tafes behema, vei lo mashkach behema tafes veladot, ishtakkach deshaycha yad nachri bavveladot. hilkach veladot bechorot sheyyihyu leotan veladot peturot min habbechora, dechol deshaycha yad nachri beimmo hu patur min habbechora. aval ma sheyyevakkeru valde veladot, dehaynu revii letzon barzel, yittenu lakkohen, dechulle hay lo shaycha yad nachri lemitpas valde veladot:

Hachi garsinan heemid veladot tachat immotehen valde veladot peturin valde valde veladot chayyavim. heemid veladot tachat immotehen, sheppatach lo petach lannachri lihyot lo koach bavveladot veamar lo im yamutu habbehemot tittol veladot hammaggiot lechelki, hasheta allima yad nachri tefe veshaycha bedor echad tefe mishshel harishon. hilkach valde veladot shel behemot tzon barzel keshebbikkeru peturot min habbechora, hoil veshaycha yad hannachri bedidhu. uvalde veladot shel veladot kesheyyevakkeru, dehaynu chamishi letzon barzel, yinnatnu lakkohen:
Sheacharayutan lannachri. dilolam kol ma demashkach nachri tafes. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Rabbi yehuda omer en maalin lakkehunna al pi ed echad. afillu hecha delekka gomlin, vechol shekken hacha deikka lemechash legomlin, haed atta alay vaani alecha:
Orrin. shekkorin alav shem pesul. veen irur pachot mishshenayim:
Maalin. hecha delekka gomlim. vehayenu deikka ben rabbi eliezer letanna kamma derabbi yehuda:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer maalin lakkehunna. baggemara parech, rabban shimon ben gamliel hayenu rabbi elazar. umassik, divmitztarfin leedut kamippalge, kegon demuchzak lan baavuha dehay dechohen hu, venafak aleh kala deven gerusha o ven chalutza hu veachtineh, veata ed echad veamar yadana veh dechohen hu veaskineh, veatu ve tere veamre ben gerusha o ven chalutza hu veachtineh, veata ed echad veamar yadana veh dechohen hu, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer maalin lakkehunna al pi ze haed haacharon mippene shemmetzarfin oto im haed harishon shebbittel hakkol veamar yadana veh dechohen hu, veaf al pi shello heidu edutan bevat achat edutan mitztarefet, veamrinan oke hane tere deamre kohen hu lahade tere deamre deven gerusha hu, veoke gavra achezkatteh. ulerabbi elazar lo massekinan leh ad sheyyaidu shene edim bizman echad dechohen hu. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel shehaedim mitztarfin af al pi shello heidu edutan keechad:
Rabbi yose haggelili omer en lah kenas. deamar kera (Devarim 22) asher lo orasa, ha orasa paam achat shuv en lah kenas:
Rabbi akiva omer yesh lah kenas ukenasah leatzmah. dedarshinan asher lo orasa, leaviha, ha orasa, leatzmah. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Eno chashud al hammaasrot. velokchim mimmennu tevua bishar shene hashshavua, veen measserin mehen vadday ella demay. vetaama dechashud al hashsheviit en chashud al hammaasrot vechashud al hammaasrot en chashud al hashsheviit, lefi sheyyesh bechol echad mehen chomer sheeno bachavero, sheviit enah tzericha leheachel lifnim mechomat yerushalayim, umaaser sheni eno neechol ella lifnim min hachoma, hilkach ikka dachamir leh onesh maaser meonesh sheviit. umaaser it leh pidyon, usheviit kevan shenneesra en lah pidyon, hilkach ikka dachamir aleh sheviit mimmaaser:
Hechashud al ze veal ze. kevan dechashud addeorayta kol shekken dechashud al hattohorot, demidderabbanan hu sheyyehe adam ochel chullin betohora:
Veyesh shechashud al hattohorot. derabbanan, veeno chashud lishviit umaasrot. deman dechashud adderabbanan lo chashud addeorayta:
En shochatin al piv. dedilma mishshum agra ka share leh:
Keila. shem chacham haddar beyavne. vechasid haya velo necheshad bechach. uven amar lehu tamim uven amar lehu baal mum haya notel kol secharo:
Arba issarot bivhema dakka uvegassa shishsha. gassa nefish tircha, lehashelichah laaretz velichpotah velivdok mumah, hilkach secharah merubbe:

Ben tamim ben baal mum. veaf al gav dechi amar leh tam hu lo ahane leh velo midi, notel secharo, dei lo shakel agra atu lemichshedeh ki amar baal mum hu. umikkan dan harambam al hashshochatim larabbim, sherauy lahem o shello yittelu sachar kelal o sheyyittelu sachar al hannimtzaot nevela o terefa kemo al hannimtzaot keshera, dumeya deroe mume habbechor:
Hutzene fishtan. kemo shenneekar happishtan min hassade nikra hutzene, sheomed kemo hutzin:
Shene gargerim. anavim:

Ellu kedivre vet hillel. vetaamayhu mishshum dichtiv (Vayikra 19) leani velagger taazov otam, chad leani vechad lagger, hare shenayim. uvet shammay amre shelosha laaniyyim vearbaa levaal habbayit, dichtiv (Devarim 24) lagger layyatom velaalmana yihye, hare shelosha laaniyyim:
Hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo. shekkatav kol nechasay netunim lifloni avdi, hare haeved bichlal hannechasim venatan lo et atzmo. veha dekaamar avdi hayenu avdi shehaya kevar:

Shiyyer karka kol shehu lo yatza ven chorin. dechol hecha denachit leshiyyura amrinan ledideh nammi shiyyer, vechi amar kol nechasay lecha ashshear nechasim kaamar velachanufe leh kaate, velo shichrereh, kevan delo amar leh atzmecha unechasay. vaafillu en lo shum nechasim ella haeved vehakkarka sheshshiyyer, mikkol makom lo yatza lecherut, dechevan deen mitkayyem dibbur kol nechasay deha ata chutz uvatel leh, delo palginan dibbura, vahave batel legamre velo kana lo atzmo velo nechasim:

Rabbi shimon omer leolam hu ven chorin. ben en lo nechasim acherim ella haeved vehakkarka sheshshiyyer, uven yesh lo nechasim acherim, leolam hu ven chorin. umokminan dibbur kol nechasay baeved levaddo kesheen lo nechasim acherim, velo amrinan divma sheamar chutz bittel dibburo sheamar kol nechasay, defalginan dibbura, umekayminan leh baeved, veyatza ven chorin:

Chutz meechad meribbo. velo feresh mahu meshayyer, dehatam amrinan deechad meribbo dekaamar hayenu eved, veihu lo chashiv leh ella keechad meribbo binchasim, veaf al gav deshave tefe. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Velo chatav lah kol nichsim kulei‏ chayyav. lihyot kol nechasav acharain lah. velo yachol lememar en lich ella sade hakketuva lich bichtubbetich:
Hammachalif im haaniyyim. noten tevua o perot leani bechilluf ma shellikket:
Shello patur. min hammaaser. ma shennatan lo heani shehu shel leket shichcha ufea:
Veshel aniyyim chayyav. ma shennatan baal habbayit leani mittevuato, vechayyav leasser kodem sheyyitten oto leani:
Shenayim shekkibbelu et hassade. vehem aniyyim:

Baarisut. lemechetza lishlish velirvia, vehem naasim kevaal habbayit, uvaal habbayit ani asur beleket shel sadehu dichtiv (Vayikra 19) lo telakket leani, azhara leani shello yelakket halleket shello, vechayyav lehaferish masar ani velatet oto leani acher. vedavka kol echad al chelko naase kevaal habbayit, velo al chelek chavero. hilkach muttarin litten ze laze masar ani:

Shekkibbelah mimmennu lemechetza. shezzacha bimchubbar. aval im amar leh [shelish] ma sheatta kotzer, en lo chelek ella battalush, vechiyyuv leket shichcha ufea hakkol al baal hassade, veaf al pi sheshshichchat hoomarim battalush bishat immur, mikkol makom kan patur delo karinan beh ketzircha hoil velo zacha ella battalush. veger shennitgayyer leachar ketzira dechayyav beshichcha leel lerabbi yehuda, hayenu mishshum dekarinan beh sadcha. umikkol makom mehay taama lo mechayyevinan ger beleket, meachar sheikkaro bimchubbar:

Shibbolet shebbakkatzir. shiyyer biktzirato shibbolet achat shello katzar, verosh otah shibbolet maggia lakkama, im otah shibbolet niktzeret im hakkama hare hi shel baal habbayit, shehakkama matztzilatah, delo karinan bah lo tashuv lekachto (Devarim 24):

Measser shibbolet achat venoten lo. lefi shechayyav litten lo davar metukkan kemo shehayta shibbolet shel leket diftura min hammaasrot, veaf al pi sheadayin lo nitmareach chal shem maaser alav, kemo maaser rishon shehikdimo bashshibbolin shechal alav shem maaser af al pi sheadayin lo nitmareach. vechetzad hu ose, mevi shete shibbolim miggadish ze shennitarva vo shibbolet shel leket, veomer al achat mehen, im zo leket mutav, veim lav hare maasroteha kevuim bezo hashshenit, venoten lo et harishona. uvayrushalmi parech venechush shemma zot hashsheniyya shekkava aleha hammaasrot shel leket hi, vechevan shehi petura min hammaaser en hammaasrot kovim bah sheen mafrishin min happatur al hachiyyuv, umeshane shellokeach shibbolet shelishit veomer im hashsheniyya shekkavati bah hammaasrot hi leket veenah yechola lihyot maaser, hare zo hashshelishit maaser al harishona:

Amar rabbi eliezer vechi heach heani hazze machalif davar shello va virshuto. rabbi eliezer ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu, ledidchu defalgitu alay (leel 84 49) beashir shellakat pea leani sheani omer zacha lo veattun amritu delo zacha lo, heach heani hazze machalif davar shello va virshuto, deha en baal hassade yachol lezakkot lo et halleket lefi divrechem, venimtza deleket ze lo va virshuto shel ani, ella ledivrechem mezakke et heani bechol haggadish al menat lehachazir, demattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana, venimtzet otah shibbolet shehi leket baa leyad heani veyachol lehachelifah beacheret. verabbanan amre, hacha asu et sheeno zoche kezoche, vechashvinan lehay shibbolet shel leket keillu baa leyado shel ani, af al gav delo zacha vah, leinyan ze sheyyachol lehachelifah beacheret. vahalacha kachachamim:

En choshshin shemma venah shel acheret haya. sheyyehe habba acharav bechor safek denema hach behema lo yalda meolam ella sheahava et ze ben chavertah, vei mishshum deit lah chalav, ha ikka miuta decholvot af al pi sheenan yoldot, ha vadday lo amrinan, ella venah hu ufetura min habbechora:
Mavkirot. bachurot shello yaldu ad achshav:

En choshshin shemma venah shel zo va lo etzel zo. delechush lechullehu bisfek bechorot, ella vadday otan hakkeruchin achar hammavkirot havu bechorot vaddain, vehakkeruchin achar sheen mavkirot havu peshutin vaddain. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Kofitz. sakkin gadol kemin garzen katan shehakkatztzavim mechattechim bo basar:
Veorfo. hayenu shechotech rosho mimul arpo:
Vekovro. lefi sheasur bahanaa leachar arifa:
Mitzvat yeida. baama haivriyya:

Barishona shehayu mitkavvenim leshem mitzva. vehayu omrim hameyabbem leshem noy leshem mamon have pogea baerva shello vimkom mitzva. veen ken halacha, ella hoil ufaka issur eshet ach minna keshemmet achiv belo vanim hare huttera lo legamre vaafillu yibbemah leshem noy uleshem mamon:
Mitzvat geulla baadon. hammatpis behema levedek habbayit, mitzvat pediyyatah baadon kodem lechol adam, shehu mosif et hachomesh:
Yotze dofen. shennikrea immo vehotziu haubbar derech dafnoteha:
Vehabba acharav. hannolad acharav derech harechem:

Yiru ad sheyyistaavu. dimsappeka leh lerabbi tarfon i vechor lavveladot kaddish af al pi sheeno vechor larchamim, kegon yotze dofen shehu harishon shennolad af al pi shello patar hu et harechem, i vechor larchamim kaddish af al pi sheeno vechor lavveladot, kegon habba achar yotze dofen shehu harishon sheppatar et harechem aval eno vechor lavveladot shehare yotze dofen kedamahu. umissefeka shenehem yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu bemuman labbealim, deshemma tarte vainan, bechor lavveladot velarchamim, veen shum echad mehen kadosh, vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. verabbi akiva peshita leh detarvayhu vainan veen shum echad mehen kadosh. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Bedalit uvedekel. shemmitzvatan betalush:
Shenneemar hazzecharim laAdonai. hazzecharim mashma shenayim:
I efshar. letzamtzem sheyyetzu shene rashehen keechad, ella haechad yatza techilla velo yadinan he minnayhu:
Borer lo et hayyafe. demissetama hayyafe vehabbari nafak beresha:

Meshammenim benehen. habbealim vehakkohen en lahem yitron ze al ze bachalukkatan ella hashshumman, shehayyisrael notel hashshamen umeniach hakkachush lakkohen, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Vehashsheni. shennishar leyisrael, yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veachar kach yeachel, disfek bechor hu, hilkach eno nishchat tamim. uveoto shel kohen lo tzarich lememar, devadday eno shochato ad sheyyehe vo mum, devazzeman hazze kamayre:
Vechayyav bammattanot. hayyisrael kesheyyishchatennu yitten lakkohen hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva. mimma nafshach, i vechor hu chullo lakkohen, i lav bechor hu chayyav bammattanot:

Verabbi yose poter. dahave cheillu zacha vo chohen vehiggia leyado ucheshennafal bo mum netano leyisrael, venimtza shehu patur min hammattanot, hoil vechashvinan leh keillu va miyyad kohen leyisrael. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Rabbi tarfon omer yachaloku. dehadar beh rabbi tarfon mimmay deamar leel dechohen borer lo et hayyafe, vesavar demechayyim nammi shamin et shenehem bedamim vecholkim et haddamim. delishnehen yesh chelek bishnehem, hilkach met echad mehem yachleku et hachay:
Rabbi akiva omer hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Zachar unekeva en lakkohen kelum. deshemma nekeva yatzata techilla vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vehacha afillu rabbi tarfon mode, dehatam hu deka faleg mishshum devadday have chad lakkohen hilkach yafe kocho lachalok beshave, aval hacha hura kocho deshemma lo shaycha bechora chelal. umihu yire ad sheyyistaev veachar kach yochlennu, desafek hu:
Mukkat shechin. metzoraat:
Hechashud al hashsheviit. lizroa o laasot sechora bisfiche sheviit:
Sarak. metukkan bemasrek. dechevan detircheh zuta lo kafed:
Arig. lav arig mammash. dehashta tavuy share arig mibbaya, hare va lichlal tavuy kodem lachen. ella arig hayenu cheen sharsherot sheosin mippishtan shello nitva meolam:
